text.title: 融入暗影
text.objectives: 回到暗影大厅，与乔拉齐·拉文霍德公爵见面。
text.description: 我们应该回去与议会的其他成员见面，告诉他们我们今天的战绩。你有空时回来一下吧。我们会等你的。
text.completion: We've been discussing your recent success, $n. We walk the shadows, and that often goes taken for granted. But without us, the Armies of Legionfall would have a great many more powerful demons to deal with.$B$BWe do not need the fame. We reap the rewards.

english.title: Meld Into the Shadows
english.objectives: Return to the Hall of Shadows, and meet Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
english.description: We should meet back up with the rest of the council and tell them of what we have achieved this day. At your leisure, return to us. We shall be waiting.
english.completion: Мы как раз обсуждали твои недавние успехи, $n. Мы действуем тайно, и наша работа на первый взгляд не видна. Но если бы нас не было, Армии погибели Легиона противостояло бы куда больше могущественных демонов.$b$bСлава нам не нужна. Нам достаточно результатов.

text.title: 阿尔甘岗哨
text.objectives: 与阿尔甘岗哨的驯龙者海德克谈一谈。
text.description:
你想巩固一下小岛上的这个泥水坑，对吧？好的。这样的话，我们就得与外围的各个营地取得联系，伙计。

我认识一个叫海德克的家伙，爱打架，非常乐在其中。他带着自己的那群幼龙跑到东面的海滩去了。

去见见他吧。别忘了告诉他，他还欠我一两杯酒呢！
text.completion: Chambers sent you? He can down a tankard with the best of 'em, I'll give him that. But if he says I owe him anything, he's a liar!$B$BDon't you worry, my drakes and I will hold the point here. But more of this shore will need to be secured before your campaign can find victory.

english.title: Aalgen Point
english.objectives: Speak with Heidirk the Scalekeeper at Aalgen Point.
english.description:
You wanna hold territory on this chunder puddle of an island, right? Right. That means linkin' up with camps on the outskirts, mate. 

I know this bloke called Heidirk. Scrappy fella, loves to get into the thick of it. Headed out to the eastern coast with those drakes of his.

Have a look for him. Remind him he owes me a pint or two!
english.completion: Тебя прислал Чеймберс? Да, перепить его мало кто может, надо отдать ему должное. Но он говорит, что я ему что-то там должен, это неправда!$b$bМы с моими драконами удержим здесь позиции – можешь не волноваться. Но чтобы твоя кампания увенчалась успехом, нужно укрепиться на всем побережье.

text.title: 卡扎杜姆一世
text.objectives: 从卡扎杜姆的回响身上取得阿古尼特钥石。
text.description: 阿古尼特矩阵为玛凯雷的这部分地区提供能量，但它被一只巨兽打乱了。我们从来没有见过像他那种东西。$b$b他叫卡扎杜姆，是燃烧军团忠诚的仆从。他自愿加入改造实验，成为了一种全新的恶魔。他的出现结束了这场战斗。$b$b他从破碎的矩阵中取走了阿古尼特钥石，作为他的战利品。取回钥石，让我们彻底终结这场杀戮。
text.progress: Please, they should not be made to suffer any longer.
text.completion: I cannot right every wrong that happened here, but this is a comfort nonetheless.$B$BThank you, $n.
text.giverWindow: 卡扎杜姆第一个接受了可怕的改造，他获得了当时的艾瑞达无法想象的力量。

english.title: Khazaduum, First of His Name
english.objectives: Retrieve the Argunite Keystone from the Echo of Khazaduum.
english.description: The Argunite Matrix that powered this part of Mac'Aree was shattered by a hulking beast. We had never seen another like him.$b$bHe was called Khazaduum and he was a most faithful servant of the Legion. He volunteered to undergo an experimental transformation to become the first of his kind. His arrival was the end of this battle.$b$bAs a prize he took the Argunite Keystone from the shattered matrix. Take it back and we can finally end this bloodshed.
english.progress: Прошу тебя, не заставляй этих духов страдать еще больше.
english.completion: Я не могу исправить того, что здесь уже произошло, но все-таки на душе у меня стало спокойнее.$b$bСпасибо тебе, $n.
english.giverWindow: Khazaduum was the first to undergo a horrific transformation, granting him strength unlike any known to the Eredar at the time.

text.title: Whispers of a Frightened World Tracking

english.title: Whispers of a Frightened World Tracking

text.title: 来自黑暗
text.objectives: 与大主教图拉扬同行。
text.description: 我担心我们的潜入被发现只是时间问题。$B$B我们必须立刻开始准备。
text.completion: So it begins.

english.title: From Darkness
english.objectives: Walk with High Exarch Turalyon.
english.description: I'm afraid it's only a matter of time before our presence is known.$B$BWe must begin our preparations at once.
english.completion: Итак, начнем.

text.title: 永不为囚
text.objectives: 从安尼赫兰熔池中救出$oa名堕暗奴隶。
text.description:
哈顿的人民经历了长久的苦难。他们的数量在不断减少，许多人被抓到了高墙的另一侧，成为不远处的深渊领主们的仆从，遭受无尽的奴役和折磨，直到死亡。

找到这些俘虏，将他们从束缚中解放出来，让我们的盟友知道，我们可以团结一致，共同抵抗燃烧军团。
text.completion: Hatuun's people will greatly appreciate what you've done for them.

english.title: Prisoners No More
english.objectives: Rescue $oa Darkfallen Slaves from the Annihilan Pits.
english.description:
Hatuun's people have endured arduous times. Their numbers dwindle as those ripped from beyond the walls of their sanctuary become servants to the annihilan lords in the pits just beyond, sentenced to a life of labor, torture and ultimately, death.

Seek out these captives, release them from their bonds and show our allies we stand as one against the Burning Legion.
english.completion: Собратья Хатууна будут очень благодарны тебе.

text.title: 减缓威胁
text.objectives: 消灭安尼赫兰熔池的卡尔兹、泽斯塔尔和玛戈拉洛斯。
text.description: 哈顿和他的人民迟早会放下怨恨，成为我们宝贵的盟友。但我们必须赢得他们的信任。$b$b他说他们的村子正被一伙以阿苟纳为首的残忍恶魔侵扰。$B$B我们必须先清理掉这群恶魔，才能着手寻找奥蕾莉亚和其他人的下落。$B$B酋长把他的号角借给了我们，我负责开路杀向阿苟纳的巢穴，你可以用这个号角来召唤破碎者，将他们复仇的怒火倾泻到这只恶魔副官的头上。
text.completion: Now that their lords have been reduced to ash, we may strike at the heart of their power.
text.completed: 在毁灭王座与图拉扬见面。

english.title: Threat Reduction
english.objectives: Slay Kar'aaz, Xeth'tal, and Magraloth in the Annihilan Pits.
english.description: In time, Hatuun and his people will set aside their bitterness and become valuable allies. But their trust must be earned.$b$bHe says their village is beset by a demon called Aggonar and his cruel kin.$B$BWe need these fiends out of the way before we can seek out Alleria and the others.$B$BThe chieftain lent us his horn. Use it to call down his people's vengeance upon the demon lieutenants while I carve a path to Aggonar's lair.
english.completion: Теперь, когда командиры демонов обращены в прах, мы можем нанести последний решительный удар.
english.completed: Meet Turalyon at the Seat of Annihilation.

text.title: 直击要害
text.objectives: 消灭阿苟纳。
text.description: 这片深渊长期以来都是我们这些新盟友的心病所在。恶魔把他们当作猎物，并且以折磨这些可怜人为乐。$B$B<图拉扬厌恶地摇头，目光始终盯着他面前的野兽。>$B$B是时候了，让他们为自己的暴行付出代价，并为这个圣光遗忘之地重塑希望吧。$b$b只要你一声令下，我们就会出击，$n。
text.completion: This victory is only the first link in a long chain, Archdruid.

english.title: A Strike at the Heart
english.objectives: Slay Aggonar.
english.description: These pits have long been a blight upon the lives of our new allies. The demons hunt them down and torture the poor souls for sport.$B$B<Turalyon shakes his head with disgust, fixing his gaze upon the beast before him.>$B$BIt is time to make them pay for their cruelty and restore hope to this Light-forsaken place.$b$bWe strike on your mark, $n.
english.completion: Эта победа – лишь первое звено в цепи предстоящих сражений, |3-6($ct).

objectiveDetails.description: 与图拉扬交谈以开始战斗

text.title: 回到维迪卡尔
text.objectives: 回到维迪卡尔。
text.description: 那头深渊领主再也不会困扰我们的新盟友了。$b$b<图拉扬眉头紧锁。>$b$b当然，除非又来了一位继任者。如果说我在与军团无止尽的战斗中学会了一件事，那就是应该尽情享受胜利。$b$b来吧，让我们到你的飞船上小聚片刻。能和我们的儿子团圆，我和奥蕾莉亚已经为这一刻等待了很久。
text.completion: Our absence has wounded Arator. We knew it would. But we had to know that he was safe while we fought the Legion.$B$BNow that we are reunited, I will not let us be separated again.

english.title: Return to the Vindicaar
english.objectives: Return to the Vindicaar.
english.description: That pit lord won't trouble our new allies any longer.$b$b<Turalyon's brow furrows.>$b$bUntil another takes its place, at least. If there's one thing I've learned in our endless war against the Legion, it's to savor victories as you find them.$b$bCome, let us take a moment to regroup back at your vessel. Alleria and I have been waiting a long time for a reunion with our son.
english.completion: It was very difficult for Arthur to bear separation from us. We expected it. But we only wanted him to be safe while we fight the Legion.$b$bNow we're back together and we're not breaking up anymore.

text.title: Cathedral of Eternal Night: Mistress of Blades

english.title: Cathedral of Eternal Night: Mistress of Blades

text.title: 复仇岗哨
text.objectives: 挫败燃烧军团对复仇岗哨的围攻，并向伊扎尔·白月报到。
text.description:
我在来这里的路上碰到了一队恶魔猎手。他们朝西北边的复仇岗哨去了。毫无疑问，军团肯定会想方设法阻止他们在那里建立前哨站。

我跟一个叫伊扎尔·白月的精灵谈过。她说话的态度不怎么友善，但是我很肯定，如果你愿意向伊利达雷伸出援手，她一定会很感激你的……不管她嘴上承不承认。
text.completion: The Illidari don't waste time on congratulations. There is more to do, and you're the one to do it.$B$BGet a move on.

english.title: Vengeance Point
english.objectives: Defeat the Legion siege on Vengeance Point and report to Izal Whitemoon.
english.description:
On my way here, I ran across a squad of demon hunters headed northwest to Vengeance Point. You can bet the Legion will try to stop them from establishing a forward position.

I spoke to an elf named Izal Whitemoon. Not the friendliest sort, but I'm sure she'd be grateful if you lent the Illidari a hand... whether she admits it or not.
english.completion: У иллидари не принято тратить время на поздравления. Еще многое нужно сделать – и сделать это предстоит тебе.$B$BПоторопись.

text.title: 孤狼传说
text.objectives: 在怒风兽穴外面找到戈德林。
text.description: 戈德林没花什么时间就从这里离开了，是吗？$b$b我们看看他在不在外面。
text.completion: We must warn the Dreamgrove of what is happening.

english.title: The Wolf's Tale
english.objectives: Find Goldrinn outside of the Stormrage Barrow Dens.
english.description: Goldrinn sure didn't take any time getting out of here, did he?$b$bLet's go see if we can find him outside.
english.completion: We must warn the Dreamgrove of what is happening.

text.title: 森提纳克斯之影
text.objectives: 把损坏的森提纳克斯信标带给救赎岗哨的战斗法师凯丝琳。
text.description: 看来这个装置的用途是把信息传递给上面的大型恶魔战舰。不幸的是，它已经开裂了，对操作没有反应。$b$b也许救赎岗哨会有人对这种信标有更多了解。
text.completion: The Legion uses these beacons to communicate with their fleet up above. If we were to find more of these...

english.title: The Shadow of the Sentinax
english.objectives: Bring the Broken Sentinax Beacon to Warmage Kath'leen in Deliverance Point.
english.description: This device appears to be used to relay messages to the large demon ship up above. Unfortunately, it is cracked and unresponsive.$b$bPerhaps someone at Deliverance Point will know more about these beacons.
english.completion: С помощью этих маяков Легион поддерживает связь со своим флотом. Было бы неплохо найти побольше образцов для исследования...

text.title: 独处深渊
text.objectives: 与大技师罗姆尔谈谈，从维迪卡尔降落到阿古斯。
text.description: 勇士，如果军团朝我们发射那台地狱火武器的话，我们就会遭受和圣光军团一样的命运。$B$B趁现在还有机会，我们必须降落到下方的攻城营地并将其摧毁！
text.completion: Welcome to Argus, homeworld of the Burning Legion.
text.completed: 与堕暗岭的先知维伦见面。

english.title: Alone in the Abyss
english.objectives: Speak to Grand Artificer Romuul to disembark the Vindicaar.
english.description: Champion, we will suffer the same fate as the Army of the Light if the Legion fires that infernal weapon upon us.$B$BWe must descend into the siege camp below and destroy it while we still can!
english.completion: Welcome to Argus, the home world of the Blazing Legion.
english.completed: Meet Prophet Velen at Darkfall Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 目击维伦和伊利丹逃跑

text.title: Using Lost Knowledge
text.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
text.description:
I'm not sure you realize what this tome could mean for us. We can find even more knowledge on your artifacts to help the war effort!

Let's begin immediately. On your command, we stand by to begin researching again.

english.title: Using Lost Knowledge
english.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
english.description:
I'm not sure you realize what this tome could mean for us. We can find even more knowledge on your artifacts to help the war effort!

Let's begin immediately. On your command, we stand by to begin researching again.

text.title: 前方道路
text.objectives: 召唤一座光铸道标。
text.description: <维伦久久盯着竞技场。>$b$b我们必须继续前进，但直觉告诉我，我们在玛凯雷的任务还远未结束。我们应该好好利用一下这段相对安全的时间。$b$b我会放置一座道标，让维迪卡尔可以锁定我们的位置。需要时，罗姆尔会将回到维迪卡尔的方法发送给我们。
text.completion: The way forward is clear, and we have the Army of the Light at our side.

english.title: The Path Forward
english.objectives: Call down a Lightforged Beacon.
english.description: <Velen stares beyond the arena for a time.>$b$bWe must continue on, but I feel Mac'Aree is far from finished with us. We should take advantage of this relative safety while we still can.$b$bI will place a signal beacon that will allow the Vindicaar to lock onto our location. Romuul will send us our means of returning to the Vindicaar if there is a need.
english.completion: Путь вперед расчищен, и с нами Армия Света.

text.title: 扔到熔炉里……
text.objectives: 把角斗士的破烂斗篷带到达拉然的抑魔金熔炉，并使用熔炉拆解它，然后把得到的东西带给风行者圣殿的维奥莱特·影愈。
text.description: 这斗篷已经破烂不堪，没法穿戴，但是可以在达拉然的抑魔金熔炉那里拆解掉。
text.progress: Visit the forge recently, have we?
text.completion: If you find any other unwanted spoils of war, obliterate them at the forge and I can help you find something more desirable.

english.title: To the Forge It Goes...
english.objectives: Take the Gladiator's Tattered Cloak to the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran and use the forge to obliterate it, then take the result to Violet Shadowmend in Winderunner's Sanctuary.
english.description: This cloak is too tattered to be usable, but can be obliterated at the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.
english.progress: Visit the forge recently, have we?
english.completion: If you find any other unwanted spoils of war, obliterate them at the forge and I can help you find something more desirable.

objectiveDetails.description: 拆解角斗士的破烂斗篷

text.title: 议会的召唤
text.objectives: 在达拉然的紫罗兰城堡寻找六人议会。
text.description:
很抱歉我没有及时为你讲解当前的局面。之前我们掌握的情报还不足以用作行动计划的凭据，所以就没有告知你。

六人议会一直在调查破碎海滩之外还有哪些地面面临军团的威胁。我相信这个卷轴就是我们所需的最后一份信息。

到达拉然的紫罗兰城堡来见我。我们需要六人议会的其他成员。
text.completion: <Khadgar gives you a knowing nod.>$B$BI'm glad you came, Archdruid.

english.title: The Council's Call
english.objectives: Seek out the Council of Six in the Violet Citadel.
english.description:
I'm sorry that I haven't kept your apprised of the situation. We needed more actionable information before bringing the matter before you.

The Council of the Six has been investigating Legion threats outside of the Broken Shore. I believe this scroll to be the final piece of information we need.

Meet me in Dalaran at the Violet Citadel. We will need the other members of the Council.
english.completion: <Cadgar nods welcome to you >$B$BI'm glad you came; |3-6($ct).
english.end: Seek out the Council of Six.

text.title: 恢复萨满祭司：鲑鱼溪调查
text.objectives: 前往瓦尔莎拉的鲑鱼溪。
text.description:
我们从破碎海滩找到了一些伪造的指令。这些指令上有邪能魔法，让阅读它的生物不知不觉地听命。它命令黑鸦堡垒攻击一个位于他们城墙南侧的“恶魔领地”。这所谓的领地只可能是鲑鱼溪！

这些指令真的可能让亡灵攻击鲑鱼溪吗？你必须立刻前往那里，要么警告他们，要么援助他们。

|cFF660000专精：恢复萨满|r
text.completion: A bit late for the warning, eh? Still, I appreciate that we haven't been forgotten.

english.title: Restoration: The Bradensbrook Investigation
english.objectives: Go to Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
english.description:
We have uncovered forged orders from the Shore. They have a fel influence about them. They guide the reader to believe they are legitimate. It orders Black Rook Hold to attack a "demonic enclave" just south of their walls. There's only one enclave they could be talking about, Bradensbrook!

Is it possible these would be able to convince the undead to attack Bradensbrook? You should head there immediately and either warn them, or render aid.

|cFF660000Specialization: Restoration Shaman|r
english.completion: A bit late for the warning, eh? Still, I appreciate that we haven't been forgotten.

text.objectives: 前往瓦尔莎拉的鲑鱼溪。
text.description:

text.title: 防护圣骑士：伊利达雷的援手
text.objectives: 在达拉然街道上找到考瓦斯·血棘。
text.description:
还好，在揭穿燃烧军团潜入城市的阴谋这件事上，我们并不是在孤军奋战。$b$b伊利达雷的考瓦斯·血棘正独自在城市街道中巡逻，想找出最近几次袭击的幕后主使。$b$b我并不是很信任这些“恶魔猎手”，但得承认他们至少还对得起这个名号。我建议你去找考瓦斯，看看她发现了些什么线索。绝对不能让燃烧军团再次发动攻击。

|cFF660000专精：防护圣骑士|r
text.completion: You - I've seen you out on the isles.$B$BWe need to move quickly!

english.title: Protection: Aid of the Illidari
english.objectives: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn in the streets of Dalaran.
english.description:
Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city.$B$BKor'vas Bloodthorn of the Illidari has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks.$B$BI do not entirely trust these 'demon hunters', but they have at least proved adept at their namesake. I suggest you find her and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.

text.objectives: 前往达拉然的魔术旅馆寻找卡兰姆·法师之矛。
text.description:
我的一位老友卡兰姆·法师之矛请我帮忙寻找他的兄弟莱斯特。卡兰姆担心莱斯特涉足了黑暗之力，希望能够阻止他。

莱斯特最早是在肯瑞托接受训练，但他过于渴望力量，因此转而研究起了禁忌的通灵法术。他的行为暴露后，就被肯瑞托开除了。

去魔术旅馆找卡兰姆，看看有什么可以帮忙的。

text.completion: You come from the Kirin Tor? So you'll help me find my brother?

english.description:
I have a request from an old friend, Karam Magespear, to help find his brother, Raest. Karam fears that Raest is dealing with dark powers, and wishes to stop him.

Originally Raest trained with the Kirin Tor, but such were his aspirations of power that he turned to the forbidden art of Necromancy. He was discovered and expelled from our order.

Find Karam in the Legerdemain Lounge and see if you can lend a hand.

text.objectives: 前往达拉然的魔术旅馆寻找卡兰姆·法师之矛。
text.description:
我的一位老友卡兰姆·法师之矛请我帮忙寻找他的兄弟莱斯特。卡兰姆担心莱斯特涉足了黑暗之力，希望能够阻止他。

莱斯特最早是在肯瑞托接受训练，但他过于渴望力量，因此转而研究起了禁忌的通灵法术。他的行为暴露后，就被肯瑞托开除了。

去魔术旅馆找卡兰姆，看看有什么可以帮忙的。

|cFF660000专精：暗影牧师|r
text.completion: You come from the Kirin Tor? So you'll help me find my brother?

english.title: Shadow: The Twisted Twin
english.objectives: Meet with Karam Magespear at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
english.description:
I have a request from an old friend, Karam Magespear, to help find his brother, Raest. Karam fears that Raest is dealing with dark powers, and wishes to stop him.

Originally Raest trained with the Kirin Tor, but such were his aspirations of power that he turned to the forbidden art of Necromancy. He was discovered and expelled from our order.

Find Karam in the Legerdemain Lounge and see if you can lend a hand.

|cFF660000Specialization: Shadow Priest|r

text.title: 恶魔学识术士：蔑潮的命运
text.objectives: 搜索贾德维克，寻找卷轴中提到的维库人。
text.description:
风暴峡湾的一名斥候昨天报告了一个重大发现——这些古代卷轴。卷轴中描述了一个瓦尔基拉预言，说的是一个新的维库统治者，这个人将会让蔑潮部族与军团对抗。

但是这个维库人其实可能是斯科瓦尔德的后裔，这样一来事情就麻烦了。

拿上卷轴，找到这个后裔，把她带到瓦尔基拉那里。我想，卷轴中提到的流亡者就是贾德维克的维库人，从那里开始找比较好。

|cFF660000专精：恶魔学识术士|r
text.completion: Yes, outsider? What business do you have here?

english.title: Demonology: Fate of the Tideskorn
english.objectives: Search Jandvik for the vrykul mentioned in the scrolls.
english.description:
A scout from Stormheim arrived yesterday with a significant discovery - these ancient scrolls. Within they contain a Valkyra prophecy of a new vrykul ruler - one who could turn the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It complicates matters that this vrykul may in fact be Skovald's heir.

Take the scrolls, find the heir, and bring her to the Valkyra. I think the outcasts they refer to are the vrykul of Jandvik, so that would be a good place to start.

|cFF660000Specialization: Demonology Warlock|r
english.completion: $gStranger: Stranger! What brings you here?

text.title: 火焰法师：莱维娅·劳伦斯的窘境
text.objectives: 在城里打听莱维娅·劳伦斯的情报。
text.description:
莱维娅·劳伦斯曾是肯瑞托的成员。由于涉足暗影魔法，她被赶出了达拉然。但她对这里的街道太熟悉，我们很难长期阻止她进入这座城市。

莱维娅失踪了，我对此极为关注。她的研究可能已经引起了燃烧军团的注意。这种事以前也发生过。如果她的知识落入了燃烧军团的手中，情况就会很危险。

她最后一次出现是在铭文师的殿堂。去那里打听一下，看看能不能找到她的去向。

|cFF660000专精：火焰法师|r
text.completion: So it seems that Levia has fallen under the spell of a succubus' seduction. I fear her time alone as an outcast must have left her vulnerable to such tactics. I cannot help but feel some guilt for her turning down this path.$B$BIn any case, Levia is in great danger. She must be found!

english.title: Fire: The Folly of Levia Laurence
english.objectives: Ask around the city for information on Levia Laurence.
english.description:
Levia Laurence was once a member of the Kirin Tor. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous if her knowledge fell into their hands.

She was last seen at the Scribe's Sacellum. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

|cFF660000Specialization: Fire Mage|r

text.title: 圣洁之地
text.objectives: 修复执政团之末下方的阿古尼特矩阵。
text.description: 我们已经有了所需的一切。$b$b在下方的壁龛可以找到破碎的阿古尼特矩阵。换上钥石后可以将其完全修复。$b$b然后，你启动的晶塔就可以击退那些仍在猎杀我人民的敌人。这场战斗终将结束。$b$b我希望他们能从中获得一丝安宁。
text.completion: <Velen peers at you, troubled.>

english.title: Consecrating Ground
english.objectives: Repair the Argunite Matrix beneath Triumvirate's End.
english.description: We have everything we need.$b$bIn the alcove below you will find the shattered remains of the Argunite Matrix. Replacing the Keystone will restore it to full capacity.$b$bThe pylons you activated will then be able to repel those who still hunt my people. At long last this battle will be over.$b$bI hope it brings them peace.
english.completion: <Velen looks at you, but he's obviously restless. >

text.title: 寻找失落的知识
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩的几处暗夜精灵废墟里使用这本书。
text.description:
我们的部队在这次的突袭中发现了一本古代暗夜精灵之书。这本书居然能在这样严酷的环境下保存这么久，这真是出人意料。

书上的魔力因为年代久远已经有些消散了。但是我感觉到这本书有点……饥饿，仿佛想要到暗夜精灵许多年以前练习魔法的地方去。

把这本书带到附近的各个废墟，或许就能揭示某些秘密。在对抗军团的时候，我们可以利用这些秘密抢占先机。
text.progress: How's it going with the night elf ruins?
text.completion: This tome is fascinating! It appears to seek out any and all knowledge that it does not already possess.$B$BI'd wager an experienced researcher could direct it to locate specific knowledge.$B$BHmm, that gives me an idea...

english.title: Seeking Lost Knowledge
english.objectives: Use the tome at several night elf ruins on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
During the assault, our forces uncovered an ancient night elf tome. The fact that it survived so long in these harsh lands is quite remarkable.

Its enchantments have faded over the ages, but I sense the book is almost... hungry, as if reaching out to places where the night elves practiced magic long ago.

Bringing the tome to nearby ruins may reveal secrets that could give us an edge against the Legion.
english.progress: How's it going with the night elf ruins?
english.completion: Это просто поразительно! Фолиант способен обнаруживать и вбирать в себя любые знания.$b$bМогу поспорить, что опытный исследователь может направлять его силу на поиск конкретных знаний.$b$bХм, это наводит меня на одну мысль...

text.title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
text.objectives: Speak with the artifact researcher in your class order hall.
text.description:
The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.

I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.

I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!
text.completion: What have you brought today, Grandmaster?$B$B<Cho examines the ancient tome.>$B$BThis book... it changes everything!

这本古代暗夜精灵之书生来就是为了寻求知识。它可以成为你研究神器的利器。

我敢打赌，你职业大厅里的学者会发现它的巨大价值，甚至能解锁新的强化途径。

我建议你马上把书带给他们。为了击败燃烧军团，我们需要利用一切可以利用的条件！

text.title: 漫步回忆
text.objectives: 护送安度因国王前往破碎海滩的幽灵废墟。
text.description:
很高兴有你陪在我身边，$n。

我来到破碎海滩，是想亲眼见证我的父亲……见证联盟为了保护我们的世界而付出的代价。

如果我对我的人民遭受的痛苦和付出的牺牲熟视无睹，那我就永远无法领导人民走向和平。

时间不早了，我们要继续前进。
text.completion: This place is filled with indescribable horrors. To think... I was blind to all of this pain and suffering.

english.title: A Walk to Remember
english.objectives: Escort King Anduin to Soul Ruin at the Broken Shore.
english.description:
It's good to have you at my side, $n.

I've come to the Broken Shore to see, for myself, the price that my father... that the Alliance has paid to protect our world.

As long as I am blind to the suffering and sacrifices of my people, I will never be able to lead them to peace.

Time is short, we should move onward.
english.completion: In this place, even the air is saturated with unimaginable terror. I had no idea... How blind I was...

text.title: 阿坎恩的痛苦
text.objectives: 在奥罗纳尔陷坑杀死12名破碎者。
text.description: 黑暗包围着我们……圣光已经离开此地……$b$b<阿坎恩自言自语道，接着才注意到你在和他说话。>$b$b阿坎恩没能拯救他们，兄弟们，姐妹们，低语扭曲了他们，圣光看不到他们，它抛弃了我们。$b$b阿坎恩失败了。$b$b<阿坎恩出神地望着空气。>
text.completion: <The broken peers suspiciously at his surroundings, avoiding eye contact with you.>

english.title: Arkhaan's Pain
english.objectives: Slay 12 Broken in Oronaar Collapse.
english.description: Darkness envelops us... the Light has gone from this place...$b$b<Arkhaan mumbles to himself before noticing you are still talking to him.>$b$bArkhaan could not save them. Brothers. Sisters. Whispers twisted them. The Light cannot see them. It turns away from us.$b$bArkhaan failed.$b$b<Arkhaan stares off into space.>
english.completion: <broken is looked around suspiciously, avoiding the sight of you. >

text.title: 阿坎恩的祈祷
text.objectives: 收集5个祈祷者碎片。
text.description: <当你靠近雕像，一个阴沉的声音在你的脑海中响起。>$b$b“你必须抵抗暗影的拉拢，来找我吧，兄弟们姐妹们，团结在圣光之下。$b$b让阿坎恩指引你们回家。”$b$b<剩余的讯息已经错乱不清，而附近的破碎者们似乎在用牙啃着雕像的碎片。>
text.progress: Did you find anything interesting?
text.completion: What is this... a sermon? Fascinating.

english.title: Arkhaan's Prayers
english.objectives: Collect 5 Fragmented Prayers.
english.description: <As you near the statue, a somber voice fills your mind.>$b$b"You must resist the shadow's pull. Come to me, brothers and sisters. Be whole within the Light.$b$bLet Arkhaan show you the way home."$b$b<The rest of the message is garbled, though the nearby Broken seem to be gnawing on pieces of the statue.>
english.progress: $gFound:Found; something interesting?
english.completion: Это... это что-то вроде проповеди? Невероятно.

text.title: 神秘的信件
text.objectives: 在泽尼达尔周围寻找知悉密封的信件的人。
text.description: <你在遗体上找到了一封装饰着圣光骑士团印章的信件。$b$b既然有人杀死信使阻止邮件的递送，它的内容一定很重要。>
text.progress: Our fight goes on, champion. Argus must fall.$B$BWhat is that you've found?
text.completion: You've found one of our scouting reports? It was overdue, and I feared it had been intercepted by the enemy.$B$B<The captain looks over the letter.>$B$BYes, this is what I've been expecting. The Legion is planning something and this is the breakthrough we've been looking for!

english.title: The Mysterious Missive
english.objectives: Search near the Xenedar for someone with knowledge of the Sealed Missive.
english.description: <On the body, you find a missive emblazoned with the seal of the Army of the Light. $b$bIf the messenger was killed to prevent the letter's delivery, its contents must be of great import.>
english.progress: Наша битва продолжается, $gзащитник:защитница;. Аргус должен пасть.$b$bЧто ты $gнашел:нашла;?
english.completion: Ты $gнашел:нашла; один из отчетов нашей разведки? Мы должны были получить его раньше; я уже стала беспокоиться, что он попал в руки врага.$b$b<Капитан быстро просматривает письмо.>$b$bДа, это как раз то, чего я и ожидала. Легион что-то затевает, и эта информация очень нам поможет!

text.title: 被囚禁的大审判官
text.objectives: 前往维迪卡尔，向技师罗姆尔询问大审判官拉尔加的信息。
text.description: 该报告指出军团正试图释放一名被囚禁的军团审判官。他名为拉尔加，是阿古斯本地的一只恶魔。因为拥有一种独特的神秘魔法，他无法被杀死。$b$b于是他被关押在风暴要塞的禁魔监狱里。$b$b圣光之母告诉我们这座纳鲁要塞的存在，但我从未亲眼目睹它，$n。图拉扬提到维迪卡尔和风暴要塞存在某种联系。也许你飞船上的工程师能懂得更多。
text.completion: High Inquisitor Raalgar? A fearsome creature but he has been held securely in the Arcatraz at Tempest Keep for a very long time. $B$BIf the Legion plans to free him then they must know that he is particularly dangerous to us.

english.title: Imprisoned Inquisitor
english.objectives: Travel to the Vindicaar and ask Grand Artificer Romuul about High Inquisitor Raalgar.
english.description: This report states that the Legion seeks to free an imprisoned Legion inquisitor called Raalgar, a demon from here on Argus who cannot be killed because of a secret magic he alone possesses. $b$bBecause of his immortality, he is held in the Arcatraz in Tempest Keep.$b$bThe Light Mother told us of that naaru stronghold, but I've never set eyes upon it myself, $n. Turalyon mentioned the Vindicaar has some connection to Tempest Keep. Perhaps your ship's engineer knows more.
english.completion: Supreme Inquisitor Ralgar? He's a mighty enemy, but he's long been held at Arkatraz in the Storm Fortress. If the Legion intends to free him, then the demons believe he poses great danger to us.

text.title: 迷失之魂
text.objectives: 释放$1oa个迷失之魂。
text.description:
我这辈子都没有见过这样严重的破坏……这样悲惨的景象。连我们脚下的土地，也是用盟友的牺牲铺筑的。

即使是现在，我也能够看到联盟士兵们迷失的灵魂徘徊在废墟之间。

在让我们勇敢的士兵的灵魂得到安息之前，我不能离开这里。我们欠他们……我自己欠他们太多了。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. A peaceful rest is all we have to offer those who have made the ultimate sacrifice for the Alliance... for Azeroth.

english.title: Lost Souls
english.objectives: Release $1oa Lost Souls.
english.description:
Never in my life have I beheld such destruction... such misery. The very ground we walk on us paved with the bones of our allies.

Even now I can see the lost spirits of Alliance soldiers wandering the ruins.

I cannot leave this place without putting the souls of our brave soldiers to rest. We owe them... I owe them that much.
english.completion: Спасибо, $n. Это единственное, что мы можем сделать для тех, кто пожертвовал своей жизнью во имя Альянса... во имя Азерота.

text.title: 挫败军团越狱
text.objectives: 在军团释放大审判官拉尔加之前找到他。
text.description: 大审判官拉尔加和阿古斯本地的邪能间存在某种联系，这让他无法被杀死。很久以前，纳鲁把他关押在禁魔监狱。$b$b当凯尔萨斯·逐日者攻击这座要塞时，我们被迫乘坐埃索达逃离。$b$b而在燃烧军团上一次入侵艾泽拉斯期间，部分军团囚犯逃离了禁魔监狱，但拉尔加却没有。不要让他得到释放，我会研究并破解他的不死的奥秘。$b$b我能帮助你接近他，剩下的就靠你了。
text.completion: You did your best, $n, but the demons won this round.$B$BIt won't take Raalgar long to gather his power to attack us. But I have learned the source of his immortality while you were gone!

english.title: Foiling the Legion's Jailbreak
english.objectives: Find High Inquisitor Raalgar before the Legion frees him.
english.description: High Inquisitor Raalgar has some connection to the fel here on Argus that makes him unkillable. Long ago, the naaru imprisoned him on the Arcatraz. $b$bWhen the forces of Kael'thas Sunstrider attacked the citadel, we were forced to flee on the Exodar.$b$bSome Legion prisoners escaped the Arcatraz when last the Legion invaded Azeroth, but Raalgar did not. Stop them from freeing him and I will study the source of his immortality so it can be broken. $b$bI can get you close. The rest is up to you.
english.completion: I see you've done all you can, $n, but in this round, victory is for the demons. Ralgar will soon gather his strength to attack us. But while you were away, I managed to find out what the secret of his immortality lies in!

text.title: 抗魔联军勇士
text.objectives: 回到你的职业大厅并招募一名新的勇士。
text.description:
收复破碎海滩的战斗正在快速消耗我们的资源。但我们不能放弃，否则就等于是把我们努力获得的战果拱手让给燃烧军团。

你的组织成员已经付出了许多，但这还不够。

请集结你的勇士，并尽力扩充部队。这片土地上或许还存在我们没有利用到的力量，而这些力量可以让战局倒向我们这边。
text.progress: Ну что,$gнашел:нашла; новых союзников?
text.completion: Another powerful ally recruited to our cause!$B$BYou have bolstered our strength against the Legion once more, $n.

english.title: Champions of Legionfall
english.objectives: Return to your class order hall and recruit a new champion.
english.description:
The battle to reclaim the Broken Shore is straining our resources. We cannot afford to relent, lest the Legion undo all that we have accomplished.

The members of your order have given much, but more is needed.

Rally your champions and do what you must to bolster their ranks. There may be untapped power in this land that will turn the tide of war in our favor.
english.progress: Ну что,$gнашел:нашла; новых союзников?
english.completion: Теперь у нас есть еще один сильный союзник.$b$bТебе в очередной раз удалось повысить наши шансы в борьбе с Легионом, $n.

text.title: 森提纳克斯号印记
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个森提纳克斯号印记。
text.description:
森提纳克斯号在破碎海滩上散播恐惧，释放出了成群的恶魔，对我们的军队造成了很大威胁。这些敌人试图阻止我们攻下古墓。

他们必将失败。

把这支邪恶部队中最强大的恶魔引出来，然后把他们解决掉，并收集他们身上的印记。让军团在我们的力量面前颤抖吧！
text.progress: The Sentinax is well defended, but we will crush everything it sends against us.
text.completion: Even the mightiest demons unleashed by the Sentinax have fallen before you.$B$BGood. The Legion will be driven from our world, no matter what it takes.

english.title: Mark of the Sentinax
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Marks of the Sentinax.
english.description:
The Sentinax rains down terror upon the Broken Shore, unleashing hordes of demons that menace our forces. The fiends seek to stop us from taking the Tomb.

They will fail.

Lure out the strongest among their vile ranks. Slay them and seize the marks they bear. Make the Legion fear our strength!
english.progress: The Cerberax is well-defended, but everyone who gets off his board and attacks us will be destroyed.
english.completion: Even the most powerful demons from Cerberax fell before you. $B$bExcellent. The Legion will be expelled from our world, no matter what it costs us.

text.title: 与众不同
text.objectives: 赢得1场PvP乱斗。
text.description:
即使是最嗜血的争斗者，最终也会变得疲惫，逐渐远离永无休止的战争。他们想寻找一种新的方式来考验他们的勇气，并摧毁他们的敌人。

加入正在进行的乱斗，与你的敌人决一死战吧。这个活动抛弃了传统的规则，只在限定时间内才能参加。
text.progress: Ты можешь сражаться весьма необычными способами, $n.
text.completion: Even I didn't see that coming.

english.title: Something Different
english.objectives: Win a PvP Brawl.
english.description:
Even the most bloodthirsty combatants eventually grow weary and turn their backs to the unending struggle of war. They seek a new way to test their mettle and destroy their enemies. 

Join the Brawl in progress and fight your opponents in a limited time event that tosses traditional rules aside.

text.title: 搏动的疯狂
text.objectives: 驱散5个虚空具象。
text.description: 尽管并非完全清醒，但这名破碎者仍然保留了一些理智。$b$b我能感觉到附近存在虚空的力量，但仅限于小范围的几处。驱散这些虚空具象应该能够帮助我们的朋友澄清思绪。$b$b也许我们可以利用你发现的祈祷者碎片，因为它们依然蕴含少量的光明能量。$b$b与此同时，我会尽量试着去理解他的自言自语。也许我们可以了解到这里究竟发生了什么。
text.completion: I can feel the Void's influence retreating. Perhaps now we can find out what happened here.

english.title: The Pulsing Madness
english.objectives: Dispel 5 Void Manifestations.
english.description: This Broken still retains some of his sanity, though not all of it.$b$bI can sense some Void influence nearby, but it is isolated to small pockets. Dispelling these manifestations should help our friend here clear his mind.$b$bPerhaps we can use the prayer fragments you found, as they still contain some Light energy.$b$bI will try and make sense of his chattering in the meantime. Maybe we can learn something about what is happening here.
english.completion: Я чувствую, что влияние Бездны отступает. Возможно, теперь мы узнаем, что здесь случилось.

text.title: 姗姗来迟
text.objectives: 为维迪卡尔的火炮标记出阿古斯心泉，消灭燃烧军团的要塞，并且从大审判官拉尔加身上取回邪能之心。
text.description: 我了解到了很多信息。大审判官拉尔加去了山中燃烧军团堡垒附近的一个基地。他将阿古斯的邪能之心藏在那里，那正是他不朽生命的来源，由直接通往阿古斯核心的心泉提供能量。$b$b他正在准备发起攻击，所以你必须先发制人。标记出心泉的位置，我会用维迪卡尔的火炮对其发射神圣火焰。只要破坏了与阿古斯的邪能联系，就可以杀死拉尔加，拿到邪能之心。
text.progress: Have you dealt with High Inquisitor Raalgar yet?
text.completion: You are a true hero, $n. Even though the demons freed Raalgar and thought him immortal, he was no match for you! Perhaps the Fel Heart will be of use to you. It is now available in the Matrix Core.

english.title: Long Overdue
english.objectives: Mark the Argussian Heartwells for the Vindicaar's guns, kill the Legion garrison, and retrieve the Fel Heart of Argus from High Inquisitor Raalgar.
english.description: I have learned much. High Inquisitor Raalgar has moved to a base near the Legion citadel across the mountains. This is where he keeps the Fel Heart of Argus, the source of his immortality, and it is powered by wells leading directly to the core of Argus. $b$bHe is preparing to attack so you will strike first. Mark the location of the wells and I will rain holy fire upon them with the Vindicaar's guns. With that connection to the fel on Argus broken, Raalgar can be killed and the Fel Heart retrieved.
english.progress: Ты уже $gразобрался:разобралась; с верховным инквизитором Раалгаром?
english.completion: You are a true hero, $n. Even though the demons freed Raalgar and thought him immortal, he was no match for you! Perhaps the Fel Heart will be of use to you. It is now available in the Matrix Core.

text.title: 阿坎恩的计划
text.objectives: 跟随阿坎恩前往埃索隆。
text.description: 阿坎恩记得。他记得一些事情……这些东西……能够拯救我们。$b$b跟随阿坎恩。埃索隆在召唤！我们会向圣光祈祷。圣光会驱逐黑暗。$b$b<阿坎恩紧张地看着奥蕾莉亚。>$b$b阿坎恩会盯紧那一个的。
text.completion: I should have seen this coming.

english.title: Arkhaan's Plan
english.objectives: Follow Arkhaan to Isolon.
english.description: Arkhaan remembers. He remembers something that will... yes... will save us.$b$bFollow Arkhaan. Isolon calls! We will offer soft words to the Light. The Light will banish the darkness.$b$b<Arkhaan eyes Alleria warily.>$b$bArkhaan will watch that one closely.
english.completion: Мне следовало это предвидеть.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送阿坎恩前往埃索隆

text.title: 阿坎恩的危机
text.objectives: 进入虚空裂缝并解决阿坎恩。
text.description: 不管他的名字是什么，都肯定没有好意。我们必须追上他。$b$b我们进入传送门之前，$n……确保你已经做好了战斗的准备。虚空的影响一般都很狂暴。
text.completion: As I said, the Void's influence is rarely peaceful. We must press on.

english.title: Arkhaan's Peril
english.objectives: Enter the Void Tear and deal with Arkhaan.
english.description: Whatever called to him, it cannot have good intentions. We need to go in after him.$b$bBefore we step through this portal, $n... ensure you are prepared to fight. The Void's influence is rarely peaceful.
english.completion: Yeah, you can’t expect good from the Abyss. We need to move on.

text.title: 私人信息
text.objectives: 与先知维伦谈一谈。
text.description:
是时候了，我应该前往破碎海滩，亲眼看看我父亲牺牲的地方。

如果我要成为我父亲那样伟大的国王……暴风城需要的国王，我必须亲眼见证我的人民所面临的威胁。

请转告我的顾问，我去破碎海滩了。如果我自己去说的话，他们只会阻拦我。

我会在救赎岗哨等你。再会。
text.completion: <Velen listens closely to your words as you tell him of King Anduin's plan.>$B$BThe Broken Shore is a dangerous place... far too dangerous to travel alone. But perhaps this journey is necessary for Anduin to find peace.$B$BWhen the moment is right, I'll inform King Greymane of Anduin's departure. Until then, go and see that Anduin is not alone on the Broken Shore. I trust that you will return him safely.

english.title: A Personal Message
english.objectives: Speak with Prophet Velen.
english.description:
The time has come for me to travel to the Broken Shore and see, for myself, the place where my father died.

If I am to be the king my father was... the king Stormwind deserves, I must know firsthand the threat my people face.

Please tell my advisors that I've gone to the Broken Shore. If I told them myself they'd only try and stop me.

I'll wait for you at Deliverance Point. Farewell.
english.completion:
<Velen listens carefully when you talk about King Andrew's plans. >

A cleaved shore is a dangerous place... Too dangerous to go there alone. But perhaps it's the only way the Anduin can find peace in his soul.

When the time comes, I will inform King Sedogriv of the departure of the Andoine. And you go to the Cracked Shore with him and take care of his safety.

text.title: 虚空投影
text.objectives: 与奥蕾莉亚·风行者和双界行者一起调查幽影谷。
text.description: 那是双界行者。我对虚空的所有知识都是他教给我的，而且他还有更多东西可以教给我。$b$b如果他在这里，那么虚灵的据点对我来说就更有意思了。我本以为他是独一无二的，但如今我却看到了另一个与虚空有纠葛的家伙……$b$b来吧，我们如果想了解他知道的东西，就必须陪他玩这场游戏。他好像到北面的幽影谷去了。
text.completion: <Alleria seems momentarily speechless.>

english.title: Throwing Shade
english.objectives: Investigate the Umbra Hollows with Alleria and Locus-Walker.
english.description: That was Locus-Walker. He taught me all that I know about the Void, and he still has more to teach me.$b$bIf he is here, then the ethereals' presence only intrigues me further. I had thought him the only one of his kind, but now that I have seen another tangling with the Void...$b$bCome, we must play his game if we want to learn what he knows. He appears to have gone toward the Umbra Hollows to the north.
english.completion: <Alleria seems to have lost its voice for a moment. >

objectiveDetails.description: 与奥蕾莉亚和双界行者见面
在幽影谷与奥蕾莉亚见面

text.title: 黑暗之源
text.objectives: 关闭5个虚空收割器。
text.description: 我想我知道他要说的事了，$n。$b$b我感到前方正在累积能量湍流。他们一定是在培养虚空，并且把虚空召唤到这里。$b$b不能让他们使整个城市陷入暗影。找到源头，不惜一切手段将其切断。$b$b我和双界行者还有一些事情要处理。
text.completion: We buy time but nothing more.

english.title: Sources of Darkness
english.objectives: Deactivate 5 Void Harvesters.
english.description: I think I understand what he was trying to show us, $n.$b$bI feel a surge of power building ahead. They must be cultivating the Void, calling it here.$b$bWe need to stop them before they plunge this entire city into shadow. Find the source and cut it off by any means necessary.$b$bLocus-Walker and I have unfinished business to attend to.
english.completion: Мы выигрываем время – но не более того.

text.title: 影卫入侵
text.objectives: 杀死15个影卫虚灵。
text.description: 你现在肯定也知道了，我有些人民已经屈从于虚空的召唤，十分悲惨。$b$b我曾经想找到更多拥有足够意志力的人，却失望地发现这种人是如此稀少。$b$b对此我也无能为力。要想促成你我的目标，就必须消灭这些意志薄弱的生物。
text.completion: It is good to know we can share a common goal. Perhaps I will find some use for your kind yet.

english.title: The Shadowguard Incursion
english.objectives: Slay 15 Shadowguard Ethereals.
english.description: As you have surely gathered by now, a certain subset of my people have tragically succumbed to the call of the Void.$b$bI had hoped to find more who possess the necessary strength of mind. I am disappointed to find such an utter lack of resistance.$b$bIt cannot be helped. To advance your cause, and mine, we will need to eradicate these weak-willed beings.
english.completion: Отрадно сознавать, что мы с тобой преследуем общие цели. Возможно, твои сородичи смогут быть мне полезны.

text.title: 准备就绪
text.objectives: 消灭纳拉索斯并拿到他的心脏。
text.description: 经过一番深思熟虑，我决定再给奥蕾莉亚一次追求她自身命运的机会。$b$b我猜你很想知道那是什么意思，凡人。$b$b<双界行者大笑。>$b$b在前面的影卫营地的深处和我们汇合吧，我的弟兄们正在准备进行召唤，这次召唤可以为风行者提供足够的能量重新开始。$b$b你可以见证一下，驾驭虚空的能量时会出现什么情况。
text.progress: I see the path clearly, $n.
text.completion: <Alleria takes the heart in her hands.>$B$BThis is the next step, $n. Thank you for bringing me to this point.
text.giverWindow: 纳拉索斯虽然只是个半神，但他的气息依然萦绕在玛凯雷的黑暗角落。

english.title: A Vessel Made Ready
english.objectives: Defeat Nhal'athoth and collect his heart.
english.description: After some consideration, I have decided to allow Alleria another opportunity to pursue her destiny.$b$bI suppose you want to know what that means, mortal.$b$b<Locus-Walker laughs.>$b$bMeet us deep in the Shadowguard camp ahead- my brethren are preparing a summons that will provide adequate energy for Windrunner to begin again.$b$bWitness what happens when you harness the Void's power.
english.progress: Теперь я вижу свой путь, $n.
english.completion: <Allergy takes the heart in hand. >$b$bThis is our next move, $n. Thank you for $gHelping: Helping; I've had it all this time.
english.giverWindow: Though only a demi-god, Nhal'athoth's presence haunts the dark corners of Mac'Aree.

text.title: 黑暗中的道标
text.objectives: 把纳拉索斯残骸交给维迪卡尔的维伦。
text.description: 真是场…有趣的经历。$b$b<奥蕾莉亚摸了摸额头。>$b$b啊，我很难集中注意力。我需要你回到维伦那里，把这个交给他。$b$b<她把一件又冷又稠的东西放到你的手上。>$b$b我感觉仿佛应该交给他，但是我也不知道为什么。$b$b把我们知道的都告诉他。我相信罗姆尔一直关注着我们的进展。如果足够走运的话，一个道标应该朝我们这里来了。
text.progress: What is this? Such darkness...
text.completion: What is it you bring, $n?$B$B$B$BIntriguing...

english.title: A Beacon in the Dark
english.objectives: Take the Remnant of Nhal'athoth to Velen on the Vindicaar.
english.description: That was... an intense experience.$b$b<Alleria rubs her forehead.>$b$bIt is difficult to focus. I need you to return to Velen. Give him this.$b$b<She places something cold and dense in your palm.>$b$bI feel as though he should have it, though I am not sure why.$b$bTell him all that we have learned. I am sure Romuul will have been watching our progress. With any luck, a beacon is already headed our way.
english.progress: Что это? Какая глубокая тьма...
english.completion: Что это у тебя, $n?$b$b<Велен всматривается в холодный плотный предмет.>$b$bИнтересно...

text.title: 命运之手
text.objectives: 到暴风城港口和前往埃索达的护卫汇合。
text.description:
"$p,

我们已经赢得许多对抗燃烧军团的战斗，但这一次我们要彻底终结这场战争。

最后的准备工作已经就绪，准备向阿古斯出发。

快点赶去暴风城港口。那里有艘船正在等着你，将会把你和你的盟友带往秘蓝岛。"
text.completion: I'm glad you were among those called for the expedition to Argus. There will be plenty of fighting ahead.

english.title: The Hand of Fate
english.objectives: Meet your escort to the Exodar at Stormwind Harbor.
english.description:
$p,

We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all. 

Final preparations have begun to depart for Argus.

Make haste to Stormwind Harbor. A ship awaits you there to grant you and your allies passage to Azuremyst.
english.completion: Хорошо, что ты тоже отправляешься на Аргус. Впереди нас ждет немало сражений.

objectiveDetails.description: 在暴风城港口与护送者见面
（可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往暴风城

text.title: 海上潜行
text.objectives: 与温蕾萨·风行者谈谈以启航前往埃索达。
text.description:
萨格拉斯之墓只是个开始。如果不彻底摧毁燃烧军团，他们依然会回来，而且会更强大。

我们要从海上前往秘蓝岛，避免引起不必要的注意。我们的进攻留给燃烧军团反应的时间越短越好。

准备好出发后就下令吧。
text.completion: May the Light protect us all this day.

english.title: Two If By Sea
english.objectives: Speak to Vereesa Windrunner to set sail for the Exodar.
english.description:
The Tomb of Sargeras was only the beginning. If we do not destroy the Legion utterly, they will return even stronger.

We will travel to Azuremyst by sea to avoid drawing unnecessary attention. The less time the Legion has to react to our assault, the better.

Just say the word when you are ready to depart.
english.completion: May the Light keep us all this day.

text.title: 圣光逃亡
text.objectives: 在埃索达的圣光穹顶与先知维伦见面。
text.description:
先知维伦和其他人已经齐聚在下面的圣光穹顶。这条路的前方有个入口。

我们必须马上找到先知，不要拖延进攻的时间。
text.completion: Thank the Light you have arrived.
text.completed: 与圣光穹顶的先知维伦见面。

english.title: Light's Exodus
english.objectives: Meet Prophet Velen in the Vault of Lights in the Exodar.
english.description:
Prophet Velen and the others have gathered within the Vault of Lights below. There is an entrance just down this path.

We should find the Prophet at once so that we do not stall the invasion.
english.completion: Хвала Свету, ты здесь.
english.completed: Meet Prophet Velen in the Vault of Lights.

text.title: 维迪卡尔
text.objectives: 登上维迪卡尔。
text.description:
我们突袭的准备都已经就绪。只需要建立道标，然后把我们传送到船上。

等道标到来后，把你的手放在道标的表面，然后登上复仇的工具维迪卡尔。
text.completion: I have waited many years for this day.$B$BBehold the triumph of the draenei, the Vindicaar!
text.completed: 在维迪卡尔与先知维伦见面。

english.title: The Vindicaar
english.objectives: Board the Vindicaar.
english.description:
Everything is prepared for our assault. We need only establish the beacon to transport us to the vessel.

Once the beacon arrives, place your hand upon its surface to board the Vindicaar, the instrument of our retribution.
english.completion: It took me a long time to wait for this glorious day. $B$BBefore you "Vindicar", the greatest achievement of drainage!
english.completed: Meet Prophet Velen on the Vindicaar.

text.title: 执政团之座
text.objectives: 找到知识桂冠。
text.description: 即使已经有了启迪印记，在得到完整的执政团之冠之前，它还是拯救不了我们。$b$b所以，即使明知鲁拉在那里等着我们，我们也必须进入执政团之座。$b$b这次任务非常艰险，但如果不是势在必行，我是不会开口的。$b$b我们会一起下去。来吧。
text.completion: This is grave news indeed. It would be wise to follow Alleria's lead from here.

english.title: The Seat of the Triumvirate
english.objectives: Seek the Crest of Knowledge.
english.description: Even with the Sigil of Awakening in hand, the Crown cannot save us until it is whole.$b$bThat is why we must enter the Seat of the Triumvirate, even knowing that L'ura awaits us there.$b$bThis is a dire task, one that I would not ask if it were not completely necessary.$b$bWe will descend together. Come.
english.completion: Ужасные новости. Что ж, значит, будем действовать по плану Аллерии.

text.title: 有趣的时代
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛的精神谷与历史学家吉帕见面。
text.description:
$n，我不想小题大做，但我们可能遇到了某种……时空干扰。

你有没有听说过“希望你不会往事缠身”这句话？

来精神谷找我，我们详细谈谈。
text.completion: $n, you're here. You must have received my letter.

english.title: Interesting Times
english.objectives: Meet with Historian Ju'Pa in the Valley of Spirits of Orgrimmar.
english.description:
$n, I don't mean to alarm you, but we may be experiencing some... temporal disturbances.

Have you ever heard the phrase 'I hope the past doesn't come back to haunt you?'

Come visit me in the Valley of Spirits and we can speak more.
english.completion: $n, you're here. You must have received my letter.

text.title: 有趣的时代
text.objectives: 在暴风城的皇家图书馆与历史学家勒洛尔见面。
text.description:
$n，我不想小题大做，但我们可能遇到了某种……时空干扰。

你有没有听说过“希望你不会往事缠身”这句话？

来暴风城的皇家图书馆找我，我们详细谈谈。
text.completion: $n, you're here. You must have received my letter.

english.title: Interesting Times
english.objectives: Meet with Historian Llore in the Royal Library of Stormwind.
english.description:
$n, I don't mean to alarm you, but we may be experiencing some... temporal disturbances.

Have you ever heard the phrase 'I hope the past doesn't come back to haunt you?'

Come visit me in the Stormwind Royal Library and we can speak more.
english.completion: $n, you're here. You must have received my letter.

text.title: 原汁原味
text.objectives: 击败诅咒之地的卡扎克、艾萨拉的艾索雷苟斯，以及某一座翡翠梦境传送门附近的梦魇之龙。
text.description:
很久以前，巨大的恐怖之物在我们的土地上横行，即使是最弱小的人，也不得不进行英勇的抵抗。

我指的当然就是卡扎克、艾索雷苟斯和梦魇之龙。

传说，有很多人青睐他们的财宝，以至于会有狩猎大军在他们出没之地连夜驻扎。

我们察觉到时光之路中出现了扰乱，恰巧位于这些巨大的怪物曾经出没的地方。

你是否愿意为我们调查一下？每年这个时候都会发生奇怪的事情。
text.completion: Let us use this moment to reflect upon the past, lest we forget the lessons it teaches us, and doom ourselves to repeat it once more.

english.title: The Originals
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands, Azuregos in Azshara, and the Dragon of Nightmare at one of the portals to the Emerald Dream.
english.description:
Long ago, great terrors walked our lands, and drove even the smallest to flights of heroism.

I speak, of course, about Lord Kazzak, Azueregos, and the Dragons of Nightmare.

Legends have it that so sought after were their treasures, that armies would camp overnight to hunt them down.

We have felt disturbances in the timeways, coincidentally located where these giants once roamed. 

Would you mind investigating for us? Strange things happen during this time of year.
english.completion: Let us use this moment to reflect upon the past, lest we forget the lessons it teaches us, and doom ourselves to repeat it once more.

text.title: 原汁原味
text.objectives: 击败诅咒之地的恶魔领主卡扎克、艾萨拉的艾索雷苟斯，以及翡翠梦境传送门里的梦魇之龙。
text.description:
很久以前，我们的大地笼罩在一片恐怖之中，即使最渺小的生命也必须挺身而出。

我指的当然就是恶魔领主卡扎克、艾索雷苟斯和梦魇之龙。

传说它们留下了巨额的宝藏，引来无数人通宵达旦地寻找。

我们察觉到时光流中出现了扰乱，恰巧位于这些巨物曾经徘徊过的地方。

你是否愿意为我们调查一下？每年这个时候都会发生奇怪的事情。
text.completion: Let us use this moment to reflect upon the past, lest we forget the lessons it teaches us, and doom ourselves to repeat it once more.

english.title: The Originals
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands, Azuregos in Azshara, and the Dragon of Nightmare at one of the portals to the Emerald Dream.
english.description:
Long ago, great terrors walked our lands, and drove even the smallest to flights of heroism.

I speak, of course, about Lord Kazzak, Azueregos, and the Dragons of Nightmare.

Legends have it that so sought after were their treasures, that armies would camp overnight to hunt them down.

We have felt disturbances in the timeways, coincidentally located where these giants once roamed. 

Would you mind investigating for us? Strange things happen during this time of year.

text.title: 维迪卡尔矩阵核心
text.objectives: 将圣光裁决者链接到维迪卡尔矩阵核心。
text.description: 阿古斯上发生的很多事都让我担心不已，而泽拉的命运最让我忧心。有的时候我会想，我们做的事情是否正确？$b$b但我们必须坚持下去。我可以操纵给维迪卡尔提供能源的矩阵核心，你在这个星球上行动时，如果有需要，可以召唤我们火炮的力量。$b$b前往我们飞船中心舱室的矩阵核心。链接成功后，不管是现在还是将来，只要是给核心提供能量的东西，都可以为你所用。
text.completion: Light's Judgment will now fire on your command when you use the Matrix Uplink. $B$BPerhaps you will find more objects that we can link into the Matrix on your travels. I have routed enough energy to that part of the Core to handle anything that you can link into it. $B$BGo well, my friend.

english.title: The Vindicaar Matrix Core
english.objectives: Link Light's Judgment into the Vindicaar Matrix Core.
english.description: Much has happened on Argus that concerns me but none moreso than Xe'ra's fate. I wonder sometimes if we are doing the right thing? $b$bBut we must carry on. I can rig the Matrix Core that powers the Vindicaar to allow you to call on the power of our guns when you have need of them on the planet. $b$bGo to the Matrix Core in the room at the heart of our ship. Once linked, whatever powers the core has installed now and in the future will be at your disposal.

图拉扬自然想听到点好消息，但我恐怕没有。如果我们现在朝燃烧军团的心脏进军，只会令我们灰飞烟灭。

There must be another way. I do not know what it is, but I trust that we will find it.

$n，你总是这么准时。

先说好消息吧，反正对我来说，不管什么消息都是同时发生的。多亏你在过去和未来发现的多个时空扭曲物体，我们终于弄清了如何检测新出现的时空扭曲。  

坏消息是，我们之所以知道我们的技术管用，是因为黑暗神殿里发生了某种变化，它正在对整个时空造成巨大破坏！我们需要你去确保那次意义重大的突袭以和之前完全相同的结局收场，并且解决时空混乱的根源。

The bad news is, we know our technique works because something has changed in the Black Temple, and it's wreaking havoc across the timescape! We need you to ensure the fateful raid turns out exactly like it did before, and to remove the source of this disturbance.

text.title: 克罗米的死期
text.objectives: 与克罗米对话，然后穿越未来，查明她为什么会死。
text.description:
哦，$n！我正想到你呢！这就是所谓在对的时间来到对的地方吧！

我刚在回顾时光流中的某些偏差，正巧发现了一些……意料之外的情况。一些令人不那么愉快的情况。

我将在不久的将来死去。时运不济啊。

我想穿越未来，查明我为什么会死，怎么死的，以及死在谁手里……但我觉得最好还是和你这样的$r一起去比较安心。你愿意和我一起吗？

Oh, $n! I was just thinking about you! Talk about being at the right time in the right place!

I was just reviewing some aberrations in the timeways, when I discovered something... unexpected. Something not-so-great.

I'm going to die in the near future. Bad times.

I was just about to jump ahead and see if I can figure out why, how, who... but I'd feel better with |5$r like you by my side. Care to join me?

总之，不管是谁想弄死我，他的运气都挺差的。我可是造诣非凡的时光流大师！我们可以反复尝试，一次不够就多来几次，直到我不死了为止。
