text.title: 微光时光碎片
text.objectives: 把微光时光碎片带到龙眠神殿，解锁一个时光传送门。
text.description: 这块水晶碎片闪烁着金属的光泽。根据克罗米的反应判断，它或许可以把你连接到另一个时间地点。
text.completion: Hand over that chronoshard, $n. If you don't mind.

english.title: Gleaming Chronoshard
english.objectives: Bring the Gleaming Chronoshard to Wyrmrest to unlock a time portal.
english.description: This shard of crystal glitters with a metallic sheen. Based on Chromie's reaction, it may be used to connect you to another time and place.
english.completion: Hand over that chronoshard, $n. If you don't mind.

text.title: 冰封时光碎片
text.objectives: 把冰封时光碎片带到龙眠神殿，解锁一个时光传送门。
text.description: 这块水晶碎片被包裹在一片薄薄的永冻冰层中。它还散发出巫妖那标志性的气味。
text.completion: I hate when they get all chilly like this.

english.title: Frozen Chronoshard
english.objectives: Bring the Frozen Chronoshard to Wyrmrest to unlock a time portal.
english.description: This shard of crystal is encased in a thin, frigid layer of permafrost. It still has that distinctive lich smell to it.
english.completion: I hate when they get all chilly like this.

text.title: 正义之怒
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa个军团灭绝者。
text.description: 灭绝者正在轰击我们，阻止我们前进。我只能保护我们不受爆炸的伤害。$B$B勇士，你必须突破他们的防线，消除那个保护灭绝者的屏障。$B$B如果你能摧毁维持护盾的锚，我就可以从远处净化他们。
text.completion: We may yet stand a chance.
text.completed: 与毁灭之冠的先知维伦见面。

english.title: Righteous Fury
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Legion Devastators.
english.description: The devastators bombarding our forces prevent us from advancing any further. I can only protect us from their blasts for so long.$B$BChampion, you must pierce their lines and remove the barriers protecting the devastators.$B$BIf you can destroy the anchors that maintain the shields, I can cleanse them from afar.
english.completion: We may still have a chance.
english.completed: Meet Prophet Velen at the Crown of Destruction.

text.title: 想买灯吗？
text.objectives: 从格里伏塔处购买可疑的灯具。
text.description: 嘿，想买灯吗？你不会后悔的。
text.progress: I promise ya don' regret dis.
text.completion: See, I told ya it be a great idea!

english.title: Wanna Buy a Lamp?
english.objectives: Purchase the Dubious Lamp from Griftah.
english.description: Ey dere, wanna buy a lamp? You be not regrettin' it.
english.progress: I promise ya don' regret dis.
english.completion: See, I told ya it be a great idea!

text.title: 钻石般闪亮
text.objectives: 从格里伏塔处购买一个权威认证有机灯具抛光工具包，用它给肮脏的灯具抛光。
text.description: 哦，抱歉。那个灯好像需要擦擦。我这正好有工具。
text.progress: I'm sure dis will all be worth it.
text.completion: Ooh, ooh, lemme see!

english.title: Shine Bright Like a Diamond
english.objectives: Purchase a Certified Organic Lamp Shining Kit from Griftah and use it to shine the Grimy Lamp.
english.description: Oh, I be sorry. Dat lamp look like it could use some shinin'. I happen to have just da ting.
english.progress: I'm sure dis will all be worth it.
english.completion: Ooh, ooh, lemme see!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用权威认证有机灯具抛光工具包

text.title: 这些我要了，谢谢！
text.objectives: 为格里伏塔获取10000枚空气硬币。
text.description: 你说这些硬币会变成空气？听起来不错，我刚好知道该把它们给谁。
text.progress: Oh man, I can't wait to use these. I be thankin' you.
text.completion: Dis be da best day. I'm going ta fleece dat Baron so hard his eyes be covered in more wool than a flock of sheep.

english.title: I'll Take Those, Thanks!
english.objectives: Obtain 10,000 Coins of Air for Griftah.
english.description: These coins, dey be vanishin' inta air ya say? Dat be soundin' perfect, as I have jus the fella ta give dem to.
english.progress: Oh man, I can't wait to use these. I be thankin' you.
english.completion: Dis be da best day. I'm going ta fleece dat Baron so hard his eyes be covered in more wool than a flock of sheep.

text.title: 我拿它们没用，但我还是要买
text.objectives: 为格里伏塔收集10000枚空气硬币。
text.description: 如果你想再多收集些，格里伏塔没有意见。话虽这么说，我现在没有以前那么需要这些东西了，所以我出的价钱也会降低点。
text.progress: Another batch, huh? You be really enthusiastic about dese.
text.completion: Be you sure ya wanna do dis? I got other wares that be much more interestin' and next week I be needin' more of these.
text.end: 为格里伏塔收集9999枚空气硬币。

english.title: I Don't Need Them, But I'll Take Them
english.objectives: Collect 10,000 Coins of Air for Griftah.
english.description: If you wanna collect more, Griftah not gonna argue with dat. Dat bein' said, I don't need dem as much anymore, so I be givin' you less for dem.
english.progress: Another batch, huh? You be really enthusiastic about dese.
english.completion: Be you sure ya wanna do dis? I got other wares that be much more interestin' and next week I be needin' more of these.
english.end: Collect 9999 Coins of Air for Griftah.

text.title: 神秘而伟大的阿尔阿巴斯
text.objectives: 与阿尔阿巴斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我看见你了，渺小的凡人！感谢你照顾我的灯！
text.progress: The very world trembles, trembles with the weight of magic. Their pockets are full of it.
text.completion: You really don't see it? I can sense the magic in their pockets!

english.title: The Mysterious, Magnificent Al'Abas
english.objectives: Speak to Al'Abas.
english.description: I see you, puny mortal! I appreciate your concern for my lamp!
english.progress: The very world trembles, trembles with the weight of magic. Their pockets are full of it.
english.completion: You really don't see it? I can sense the magic in their pockets!

text.title: 魔法之地
text.objectives: 再……跟阿尔阿巴斯谈谈吧。
text.description:
我懂了。你那双小眼睛基本上就是个摆设，看不到那些精灵散布在这片土地各处的灌魔装饰品。他们一直都佩戴着珠宝，而你却看不见。 

我提议我们合作，我的新朋友。我的灯目前正缺漂亮的装饰，实在是太过寒酸。我提议我们来做笔交易。由我来揭开这道阴险的面纱，而你则要把找到的宝物交给我。
text.completion: Fantastic, simply fantastic. This will be a profitable partnership, my puny associate.

english.title: In the Land of Magic
english.objectives: Speak to Al'Abas... again.
english.description:
I think I see the problem. Your puny eyes are too weak to detect the mana-infused finery that these elves have spread throughout the land. They've been wearing jewelry the entire time, and you simply couldn't see it.

I propose a partnership, my newly minted associate. My lamp currently suffers from an embarrassing lack of magic and could always use more beautiful decorations. I propose a trade. I shall pierce this sinister veil, and you shall give me the spoils of your theft.
english.completion: Fantastic, simply fantastic. This will be a profitable partnership, my puny associate.

text.title: 空气硬币
text.objectives: 再跟阿尔阿巴斯谈一谈。
text.description:
我对这里的居民口袋里的那些魔法小玩意儿很感兴趣，而且我愿意帮助你获得它们，$n。 

可惜，我无法用这个世界的货币来报答你。我只能给你一种临时性的货币——由纯净的空气构成的硬币。但这总比啥都没有强！

将我的灯带在身边。将你偷来的宝贝丢进来，我就会给你硬币。或许我这盏灯的前主人会用得着它们。
text.completion: I entrust you with my lamp. May our partnership be fruitful.

english.title: Coins of Air
english.objectives: Speak to Al'Abas yet again.
english.description:
I would be much interested in these magical trinkets that reside in the pockets of the denizens of this land, and humbly offer my services in helping you acquire them, $n. 

However, I sadly cannot pay you in the coin of this realm. What I can offer are ephemera - coins of purest air. They're better than nothing, though!

Carry my lamp with you. Drop the treasures you steal within, and I will grant you these coins. Perhaps the former owner of my lamp would have a use for them.
english.completion: I entrust you with my lamp. May our partnership be fruitful.

text.title: 忠诚就是最好的奖赏
text.objectives: 获得一千枚空气硬币。
text.description: 我有一个挑战要交给你，凡人。从我这里获得一千枚硬币。我相信到时候，我就能强化我的灯以及里面的幻象了。
text.progress: My goodness, already!?
text.completion: Yes, yes, YES! Do you see the power radiating from the lamp? I can sense objects of great power that were concealed even from my mighty eyes.

english.title: Loyalty Is Its Own Reward
english.objectives: Obtain a thousand Coins of Air.
english.description: I offer you a challenge, mortal. Obtain a thousand of my coins, and I believe that I can empower my lamp and the vision within.
english.progress: My goodness, already!?
english.completion: Yes, yes, YES! Do you see the power radiating from the lamp? I can sense objects of great power that were concealed even from my mighty eyes.

text.title: 奢华灯神
text.objectives: 在破碎群岛居民的口袋中找到稀有的宝物。
text.description: 有了我刚刚强化的灯，我能感应到距离更远、更加珍贵的物品了。它们就在这些精灵和恶魔的口袋里。去把它们给我弄来！
text.progress: Well, well, well. You continue to amuse and amaze, mortal.
text.completion: You've done it! My lamp has never shone brighter. I shall continue to grant you coins, but I shall have to find new uses for the magic you provide.

english.title: High Fash-Djinn
english.objectives: Find rare treasures in the pockets of the denizens of the Broken Isles.
english.description: With my newly empowered lamp, I sense further, more valuable trinkets in the pockets of these elves and demons. Fetch them for me!
english.progress: Well, well, well. You continue to amuse and amaze, mortal.
english.completion: You've done it! My lamp has never shone brighter. I shall continue to grant you coins, but I shall have to find new uses for the magic you provide.

text.title: 复仇
text.objectives: 摧毁毁灭之冠的攻城武器。
text.description: 圣光军团不会白白牺牲。$B$B在我们摧毁他们攻城武器的同时，我们的部队会对主营地发起攻击。$B$B这是我们复仇的开始。
text.completion: It seems we underestimated the Legion's cunning.

english.title: Vengeance
english.objectives: Destroy the siege weapon at the Crown of Destruction.
english.description: The Army of the Light will not have fallen in vain.$B$BOur forces will assault the main encampment while we destroy their siege weapon.$B$BThis will be but the beginning of our vengeance.
english.completion: Кажется, мы недооценили коварство Легиона.

text.title: 抵抗的迹象
text.objectives: 搜索抵抗的迹象。
text.description: 我们的部队在守卫维迪卡尔的时候承受了巨大的损失，$n。我们需要盟友的支援。$B$B圣光军团以吸收燃烧远征的幸存者，充实自己的力量而著称。我们也必须这么做。$B$B我感到附近有你释放的燃烧军团的奴隶。我猜他们已经开始对抗自己的主人。$B$B如果你能和我一起前去寻找就太好了，$p。
text.completion: This must be it.
text.completed: 与克罗库营地外的先知维伦见面。

english.title: Signs of Resistance
english.objectives: Search for signs of resistance.
english.description: Our forces sustained heavy losses defending the Vindicaar, $n. We require allies.$B$BThe Army of the Light was known to take in survivors of the Legion's crusade to bolster their ranks. We must do the same.$B$BI sense the presence of the Legion slaves you freed nearby. I suspect that they have carved out a resistance against their masters.$B$BI would appreciate your company, $p.
english.completion: Похоже, это то, что нам нужно.
english.completed: Meet Prophet Velen outside the Krokul Hovel.

text.title: 灵魂水晶
text.objectives: 找到隐藏在红玉巨龙圣地的大树内部的巫妖。
text.description:
<三个碎片整齐地拼成一块大型水晶。重组后，一个强大的巫妖的影像出现在水晶表面上。>

<巫妖说道：>

拖住红玉圣地守卫。我要从大树内部执行主人的进攻。
text.completion: I think this is the spot.

english.title: Soul Crystal
english.objectives: Seek out the lich hidden within the Ruby Dragonshrine's tree.
english.description:
<The three shards combine neatly into a large crystal. Once reassembled, the image of a powerful lich appears above the crystal's surface.>

<The lich speaks:>

Keep the Ruby Shrinewardens occupied. I shall carry out our master's attack from within the great tree itself.
english.completion: I think this is the spot.

text.title: 古树的智慧
text.objectives: 找到隐藏在翡翠巨龙圣地的萨特。
text.description:
三棵古树留下三个线索：

“……巨大的梦魇……”

“……去水边……”

“……巨龙之掌……”

或许攻击克罗米的人就躲在古树描述的地方？
text.completion: Based on the clues the ancients gave us, this must be the spot. It HAS to be!$B$BLet's do this, $n!

english.title: The Ancients' Wisdom
english.objectives: Seek out the satyr hidden in the Emerald Dragonshrine.
english.description:
The three ancients left three clues:

"...the great nightmare..."

"...by the water..."

"...within the dragon's palm..."

Perhaps Chromie's attacker lies in the place the ancients describe?
english.completion: Based on the clues the ancients gave us, this must be the spot. It HAS to be!$B$BLet's do this, $n!

text.title: 恶魔石核
text.objectives: 找到隐藏在黑曜石巨龙圣地的洞穴入口附近的恐惧魔王。
text.description:
<在恶魔石核的深处，一个恐惧魔王的影像说着不祥的话语：>

遵命，主人。我们会在你指定的时间搞定这件事的。那头青铜龙绝对预料不到。我只需要在黑曜石巨龙圣地外来一下就够了。
text.completion: I'm not a big fan of dreadlords, but I think you and I can handle one if we stick together. You ready, $n?

english.title: Demonic Corestone
english.objectives: Uncover the dreadlord hidden near the entrance to the Obsidian Dragonshrine's cave.
english.description:
<Deep within the demonic corestone, the image of a dreadlord speaks ominously:>

Yes, master. It shall be done, at the exact time that you specified. The bronze dragon will see nothing. One shot from outside the Obsidian Dragonshrine is all I require.
english.completion: I'm not a big fan of dreadlords, but I think you and I can handle one if we stick together. You ready, $n?

text.title: 虚空召唤者的卷轴
text.objectives: 找到隐藏在碧蓝巨龙圣地上空的虚空生物。
text.description:
<卷轴的碎片拼起来后，变成一段破烂、但能读懂的信息：>

时候到了。祈咒将在碧蓝圣地上空举行。虚空将会吞噬青铜龙。主人有令，我们万死不辞。
text.completion: I sense something... bad.

english.title: Voidcallers' Scroll
english.objectives: Seek out the creature of void hidden above the Azure Dragonshrine.
english.description:
<The scroll pieces combine to form a tattered, but readable message:>

The time is nigh. The invocation will take place above the azure shrine. The void will swallow the bronze dragon. Our master has spoken, and we obey.
english.completion: I sense something... bad.

text.title: 圣光之母
text.objectives: 在泽尼达尔内找到泽拉。
text.description: 我们必须确定圣光之母是否幸存下来了，$n。$b$b泽拉把她的心送到艾泽拉斯后被削弱了，但她是始祖纳鲁。她是圣光，不能熄灭。$b$b我们去泽尼达尔找她吧。愿圣光保佑，让她能回来继续指引我们。
text.completion: Light be praised! This was a dark day, and many lives were lost. $B$BBut the Army endures. The Light Mother's prophecy will be fulfilled.$B$BAll is as it was meant to be.

english.title: The Light Mother
english.objectives: Find Xe'ra within the Xenedar.
english.description: We must know for sure whether the Light Mother survived, $n.$b$bXe'ra was weakened by sending her heart to Azeroth, but she is the prime naaru. She is the Light, and she cannot fade.$b$bLet's head into the Xenedar and look for her. Light willing, she will return to guide us once more.
english.completion: Хвала Свету! Нынче был темный день, и мы потеряли очень многих. $b$bНо Армия все еще жива, и пророчество Матери Света будет исполнено.$b$bВсе идет, как должно.

text.title: 圣光回归
text.objectives: 与图拉扬谈一谈，返回维迪卡尔。
text.description: 泽拉获救了！我们赢得了一场重要的胜利。$b$b圣光之母应该回到了维迪卡尔上。很显然，她想要跟你谈谈。要解释的事情太多了……$b$b罗姆尔现在应该可以把我们传送回船上了。你准备好后就告诉我。
text.completion: The Army endures. The Light Mother's prophecy will be fulfilled.$B$BAll is as it was meant to be.

english.title: Light's Return
english.objectives: Speak with Turalyon to return to the Vindicaar.
english.description: Xe'ra has been saved! We have won an important victory here.$b$bThe Light Mother should be back on the Vindicaar. No doubt she will want to speak with you. There is so much to explain...$b$bRomuul should be able to teleport us back to the ship now. Let me know when you are ready.
english.completion: The army has survived. The prophecy of the Mother of Light will be fulfilled.$b$bEverything is going as it should.

text.title: 执政团之座：知识桂冠
text.objectives: 消灭鲁拉，获得知识桂冠。
text.description: 我们拥有了所需的一切，$n。$b$b奥蕾莉亚·风行者在执政团之座等着你的到来。$b$b不要单独行动，我的朋友。你需要和盟友一起行动才能取回知识桂冠……并面对如今的鲁拉。$b$b我会让维迪卡尔做好准备，等待你的归来。愿圣光为你照亮那片黑暗之地。
text.progress: It is a heavy burden I have placed upon you, $n. I have faith you will not fail.
text.completion: It is done. My heart mourns the loss of L'ura, but at least you brought her peace.$B$BOnce the Crown is in place, the Vindicaar will stand against the Legion's vile assault. Antorus will fall!

english.title: Seat of the Triumvirate: The Crest of Knowledge
english.objectives: Slay L'ura and retrieve the Crest of Knowledge.
english.description: We have all that we need now, $n.$b$bAlleria Windrunner awaits your arrival at the Seat of the Triumvirate.$b$bDo not go alone, my friend. You will need allies to recover the Crest of Knowledge... and endure what L'ura has become.$b$bI will prepare the Vindicaar and await your return. Light be with you in that dark place.
english.progress: Мне пришлось возложить на твои плечи тяжкое бремя, $n. Но я верю, что ты не дрогнешь.
english.completion: Свершилось. Мое сердце скорбит по Л'уре, но, по крайней мере, она обрела покой.$b$bКак только корона будет на месте, "Виндикар" начнет контрнаступление. Анторус должен пасть!

objectiveDetails.description: 将知识桂冠放入玛凯雷

text.title: 沙塔斯的适时召唤
text.objectives: 与沙塔斯的沃尔姆见面。
text.description: 炽热之星在这轮循环里构成了古怪的星象，在寰宇间发出呼喊。去找沙塔斯的贤者沃尔姆，帮她一把。
text.completion: Oh, is it time?

english.title: A Timely Summons from Shattrath
english.objectives: Meet with Vormu in Shattrath.
english.description: The blazing star holds a peculiar alignment this cycle, calling out across the heavens. Seek out the sage Vormu in Shattrath City, and lend her your aid.
english.completion: Oh, is it time?

objectiveDetails.description: 与沙塔斯的沃尔姆谈一谈
（可选）使用传送门前往外域的沙塔斯

text.title: 守门人的挑战：机智
text.objectives: 收集敏锐碎片、狡黠碎片和欺诈碎片，并将其组合成一个机智印记。
text.description: 阿克蒙德对他的学生期待很高。只有最富想象力和最机敏的智者，才能真正理解我们魔法最深处的奥秘。$b$b我怀疑你是否能理解。$b$b左边的道路会带你前往三个雕像。用它们可以收集机智印记。$b$b为了让这次试炼保持公正，我不会给出提示。如果真的有奇迹，而你居然能成功，那么我会正式认可你的……才华。
text.progress: Display the Mark of Cunning or leave me alone.
text.completion: Oh. You were successful.$B$BSurprising.

english.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Cunning
english.objectives: Collect a Fragment of Acuity, Wit, and Guile and combine them into a Mark of Cunning.
english.description: Archimonde expected greatness from his pupils. Only the most imaginative minds, the most adroit of intellects, could ever truly fathom the deepest reaches of our magic.$b$bI doubt you can relate.$b$bThe path to the left will take you to a set of three statues. Use them to collect a Mark of Cunning.$b$bTo preserve the integrity of this trial, I will not be able to provide hints. If you do, by some miracle, happen to succeed, I will formally recognize your... brilliance.
english.progress: Покажи мне метку хитрости – или ступай прочь.
english.completion: О! У тебя получилось.$b$bУдивительно.

text.title: 毫不低调的开端
text.objectives: 在奥秘学宫和大法师伊米拉见面。
text.description: 现在我们可以开始搜索执政团之冠了。先从阿克蒙德身上携带的碎片启迪印记开始。$b$b你可以在东方和北方找到阿古斯最伟大魔法学校的遗迹。阿克蒙德就是在那里学会了如何掌握奥术魔法。他的宝藏肯定藏在那里。$b$b毫无疑问，那里肯定有守卫。我们要利用法瑞娅部队的追踪技巧沿着这条线索追下去。
text.completion: This place has its share of secrets. Thankfully, I know enough of them to get us started.

english.title: Not-So-Humble Beginnings
english.objectives: Meet Archmage Y'mera at the Conservatory of the Arcane.
english.description: Now we may begin our search for the Crown of the Triumvirate. We will start with the fragment Archimonde carried: the Sigil of Awakening.$b$bTo the east and north you will find all that remains of the greatest school of magic on Argus. It was there that Archimonde gained his mastery of the arcane. I can think of no other place he would stow his treasures.$b$bIt will be guarded, no doubt. We will leverage the expertise of Fareeya's forces here to follow this trail.
english.completion: Это место таит немало секретов. По счастью, мне ведомы многие из них, так что нам не придется действовать вслепую.

text.title: 守门人的挑战：精通
text.objectives: 击败大宰相加拉苏姆、大执政官薇拉拉和高阶启迪者阿尔贡。
text.description: 阿克蒙德只是被追求力量的欲望所吞噬。只有那些能配得上他的欲望的人才能在他的手下顺利发展。$b$b你将会迎战阿克蒙德最强大的学生。这三个人曾经在自己的领域强大无比，学宫现在仍然铭记着他们。$b$b他们的回响会试图杀了你。$b$b如果能击败这三个人，而且自己还能毫发未损，那么我就会认可你的力量。
text.completion: I must admit, I am impressed.

english.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Mastery
english.objectives: Defeat Grand Vizier Jarasum, Arc-Consul Velara, and High Wakener Aargon.
english.description: Archimonde was an individual consumed by the pursuit of power. Only those who could match his lust would fare well under his tutelage.$b$bYou will fight what remains of Archimonde's greatest pupils. These three once held such power in their own disciplines that the Conservatory remembers them now.$b$bTheir echoes will try to kill you.$b$bBest all three with all your limbs intact and I will recognize your strength.
english.completion: I have to admit, I'm impressed.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败高阶启迪者阿尔贡

text.title: 入侵物种
text.objectives: 收集30个消化了一半的奥能。
text.description: 如果我对导体的看法是错的就麻烦了，所以我们最好再找一种备用的能量源。$b$b幸好我知道哪里可以找到。$b$b阿古斯当地的影豹是独居生物，但看来启迪者拥有的某种魔法吸引了很多影豹前来这里。$b$b没时间讲究环保了——影豹是靠吞噬能量为生的。$b$b杀掉它们，看看能否重新夺回一些它们吞噬的能量。
text.progress: There is always room for a backup plan. Did you find what we seek?
text.completion: I had not imagined the final product to be so... sticky.$B$B<Y'mera wipes her hands on her robes.>$B$BIt will do.

english.title: Invasive Species
english.objectives: Collect 30 Partially Digested Arcana.
english.description: We should seek out an alternate source of energy just in case I am wrong about the conduits.$b$bLuckily enough, I think I know where we can find one.$b$bThe panthara native to Argus are solitary creatures, but it seems whatever magic the Wakeners possessed has drawn them here in great numbers.$b$bThis is no time to be gentle with the environment--panthara devour energy to survive.$b$bSlay them and see if you cannot reclaim some of the power they have consumed.
english.progress: Always have a backup plan. Did you manage to find what we need?
english.completion: Не думала, что эта субстанция окажется настолько... липкой.$b$b<И'мера вытирает руки об одежду.>$b$bСгодится.

text.title: 守门人的挑战：坚韧
text.objectives: 完成坚韧试炼。
text.description: 我的主人阿克蒙德从来就不喜欢优柔寡断。$b$b他喜欢的教学方式是无尽的挫折和再三的惩罚。想要在他的手下获得成功，强大的信念是必不可少的。$b$b在学宫对面的尽头，你会看到一座大型建筑。进去后，你的目标就是克服面前的所有障碍。$b$b挣脱困境，我就相信你的意志足够强大，可以继续前行。
text.completion: You may be worthy of the Conservatory's secrets, if you survive that long.

english.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Tenacity
english.objectives: Overcome the Trial of Tenacity.
english.description: My master Archimonde was not known for his willingness to suffer indecision.$b$bHe preferred to teach by rewarding frustration with more frustration-- punishment with more punishment. Absolute conviction was required to succeed under him.$b$bAt the opposite end of the Conservatory you will find a large structure. Once inside, your goal is to overcome all the obstacles placed before you.$b$b Emerge unscathed and I will be forced to consider your will strong enough to proceed.
english.completion: If you can hold out long enough, perhaps you're really worthy; learn the secrets of the Conservatory.

text.title: 污染者的遗产
text.objectives: 击败阿克蒙德并获取启迪印记。
text.description: 看来你没有那么容易就被吓倒。很好。$b$b你的表现获得了寻找印记的资格。我得说清楚，我只是允许你继续前进。我并不保证你会成功。$b$b最大的挑战在前方等着你。$b$b你必须前往裁判所，面对阿克蒙德本人。只有击败学宫的主人，你才有资格获得印记。$b$b很少有人能战胜这个障碍。希望他不会把你打成一团烂泥。
text.progress: Archimonde himself... what have we gotten ourselves into?
text.completion: I have never felt power like this before...$B$B<Y'mera handles the shard cautiously.>$B$BWe should get this to Velen as soon as we can.
text.giverWindow: 阿克蒙德并不知道自己会成为污染者，但他对力量的追求也不是从萨格拉斯出现时才开始的。

english.title: The Defiler's Legacy
english.objectives: Defeat Archimonde and retrieve the Sigil of Awakening.
english.description: It seems you are not so easily deterred. Very well.$b$bYour deeds qualify you to seek the Sigil. To be clear, I am only permitting you to move on. This does not guarantee your success.$b$bThe greatest of your challenges lies before you.$b$bYou must go to the Praetorium and face Archimonde himself. Only by defeating the master of the Conservatory will you be worthy of the Sigil.$b$bFew have overcome this obstacle. I hope he does not make too much of a mess of you.
english.progress: Сам Архимонд... во что же мы ввязались?
english.completion: Никогда еще мне не доводилось ощущать такую силу...$b$b<И'мера осторожно вертит осколок в руках.>$b$bНужно как можно скорее показать Печать Велену.
english.giverWindow: Archimonde did not know he would become the Defiler, but his pursuit of power did not start when Sargeras arrived.

text.title: 先知亦非先知
text.objectives: 找到维伦。
text.description: 我确信维伦就在附近。如果他被抓了，我们肯定会知道。$b$b还是一样，我们不能磨蹭。他为抗击军团的事业付出了许多，燃烧军团肯定一心想要找到他。如果他们得手，后果不堪设想。$b$b所以我要和你一起去。$b$b我们必须找到维伦，并帮助他找回知识桂冠。我们必须信任他的想法，否则一切都将万劫不复。
text.completion: You came upon me in a moment of reflection.$B$B<Velen peers at you with a tired expression.>$B$BThere is no time for such sentiment. We must press on.

english.title: A Non-Prophet Organization
english.objectives: Locate Velen.
english.description: I have complete faith that Velen is nearby. We would know if he had been captured.$b$bAll the same, we must not delay. The Legion has a vested interest in finding him after all he has done to resist them. I shudder to think what they might do, given the chance.$b$bThat is why I am going with you.$b$bWe will find Velen and help him track down the Crest of Knowledge. We must have faith in his mission or all will be lost.
english.completion: Ты $gзастал:застала; меня в час раздумий.$b$b<Велен смотрит на вас усталыми глазами.>$b$bНо сейчас не время для сантиментов. Нужно двигаться дальше.

text.title: 诺莫瑞根马拉松
text.objectives: 奔向藏宝海湾。
text.description:
准备好参加今天的大赛了吗，$n？

每一年，来自世界各地的侏儒都会齐聚一堂，从诺莫瑞根跑向藏宝海湾！

这个活动会提醒我们，哪怕对我们来说，也没有够不着的目标！无论你跑得是快是慢，是独自前行还是与好友一起上阵，只要坚持到底，就能完成比赛！所以，抓紧时间热身吧，然后让世人看看我们侏儒的志气！

english.title: The Great Gnomeregan Race
english.objectives: Race to Booty Bay.
english.description:
Ready for the big race today, $n?

Every year, gnomes from near and far gather to run all the way from Gnomeregan to Booty Bay!

It reminds us that no goal is too tall, even for us!  Whether you run fast or slow, alone or with friends, you'll make it as long as you keep trying! So make sure to stretch, then get out there and show the world what we gnomes are made of!

objectiveDetails.description: Face the cannon towards Kil'jaeden's Ship

text.title: 艾格文之路
text.objectives: 从萨格拉斯之墓的戒卫侍女身上收集4个守护者封印残片（普通难度）。
text.description: 我们封印墓穴的时候，我把萨格拉斯的牢笼的最后一个碎片托付给了戒卫侍女。如果你拿到了碎片，你就可以在墓穴中自由移动。但我不知道守护者如今的状况，我担心情况有变。

english.title: Aegwynn's Path
english.objectives: Collect 4 Fragment of the Guardian's Seal from the Maiden of Vigilance in the Tomb of Sargeras on Normal Difficulty.
english.description: As we sealed the tomb, I entrusted the final piece of Sargeras' prison to the Maiden of Vigilance. If you had it you could move freely throughout the tomb, but I know not what became of the keeper and fear the worst.

text.title: 艾格文之路
text.objectives: 从萨格拉斯之墓的戒卫侍女身上收集4个守护者封印残片（英雄难度）。
text.description: 在我们封印墓穴时，我将禁锢萨格拉斯的最后一块封印残片交给了戒卫侍女。如果你能得到它，就能在墓穴中随意穿行了。但我不知道那位守护者怎么样了，你得做好最坏的打算。

english.title: Aegwynn's Path
english.objectives: Collect 4 Fragment of the Guardian's Seal from the Maiden of Vigilance in the Tomb of Sargeras on Heroic Difficulty.
english.description: As we sealed the tomb, I entrusted the final piece of Sargeras' prison to the Maiden of Vigilance. If you had it you could move freely throughout the tomb, but I know not what became of the keeper and fear the worst.

text.title: 艾格文之路
text.objectives: 从萨格拉斯之墓的戒卫侍女身上收集4个守护者封印残片（史诗难度）。
text.description: 在我们封印墓穴时，我将禁锢萨格拉斯的最后一块封印残片交给了戒卫侍女。如果你能得到它，就能在墓穴中随意穿行了。但我不知道那位守护者怎么样了，你得做好最坏的打算。

english.title: Aegwynn's Path
english.objectives: Collect 4 Fragment of the Guardian's Seal from the Maiden of Vigilance in the Tomb of Sargeras on Mythic Difficulty.
english.description: As we sealed the tomb, I entrusted the final piece of Sargeras' prison to the Maiden of Vigilance. If you had it you could move freely throughout the tomb, but I know not what became of the keeper and fear the worst.

text.title: 光与影之子
text.objectives: 与图拉扬谈一谈，开始复活泽拉。
text.description: 是时候了，$n。$b$b泽拉回到了我们身边。我们有了圣光之心。我们有了她的救世之星。$b$b来吧，我们来修复她吧。我们来开辟一条崭新的光明之路，和敌人战斗到底。$b$b你准备好开始后就跟我说。
text.completion: I did not expect this of Xe'ra. Nor could I have foreseen Illidan's reaction.$B$BWe must ensure these events do not crush the spirits of our allies.

english.title: The Child of Light and Shadow
english.objectives: Speak with Turalyon to revive Xe'ra.
english.description: It is time, $n.$b$bXe'ra is returned to us. We have Light's Heart. We have her Chosen One.$b$bCome, let us restore her. Let us forge a bright new path against our foes.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready to begin.
english.completion: Кто бы мог подумать, что Зе'ра сделает подобное... И реакция Иллидана была неожиданной.$b$bМы должны позаботиться о том, чтобы это не сломило боевой дух наших союзников.

text.title: 烟、肉、漂亮的花
text.objectives: 找到一些腌制鹿肉干、弗拉斯的特级烟丝和一捆金盏菊花束。
text.description: 城镇后面已经封锁了，孩子。没错，我有钥匙，但我不认识你。$b$b<埃姆雷小心翼翼地拍了拍口袋。>$b$b听好，我想帮你这个忙。你看起来是个诚实的人。帮我弄点鹿肉、烟草和一束黄色鲜花，我有可能会给你破个例。
text.progress: You're not in a hurry, are you?
text.completion: The smoke and the meat are for me. The flowers, on the other hand, are for the kids at the orphanage down the street.

english.title: Smoke, Meat, and Pretty Flowers
english.objectives: Obtain some Salted Venison Jerky, Fras' Special Pipe Blend, and a Marigold Bouquet.
english.description: Back of town's on lockdown, kid. And yes, I do have a key, but you're a stranger.$b$b<Emery pats his pocket gingerly.>$b$bListen, I'd like to help you out. You've got an honest look to you. Fetch me some venison, some pipe tobacco, and a bundle o' yellow flowers, and I might be able to make an exception.
english.progress: You're not in a hurry, are you?
english.completion: The smoke and the meat are for me. The flowers, on the other hand, are for the kids at the orphanage down the street.

text.title: 对，绝对是给孩子们的
text.objectives: 把金盏菊花束交给孤儿院长梅丽娜。
text.description: 我不知道你见没见过孤儿院长梅丽娜，她就像一位女神降临，令洛丹伦散发出夺目的光彩。她的头发，她的颧骨，她的……$b$b……总之，这些花要送给她孤儿院里的孩子们。告诉梅丽娜，这些花是我送的。送给孩子们。
text.progress: What's this?
text.completion: These are from Emery, I assume?$B$B<Meliana blushes.>$B$BThat dummy. Gotta admire his persistence, though...

english.title: Yeah, Definitely for the Kids
english.objectives: Deliver the Marigold Bouquet to Orphan Matron Meliana.
english.description: I don't know if you've ever seen Orphan Matron Meliana before, but she is a goddess come down to humble Lordaeron. Her hair, those cheekbones, and...$b$b...and anyhow, these flowers are for the kids at the orphanage where she works. Tell Meliana that they're from me. For the kids.
english.progress: What's this?
english.completion: These are from Emery, I assume?$B$B<Meliana blushes.>$B$BThat dummy. Gotta admire his persistence, though...

text.title: 躲藏好
text.objectives: 找到一把翻新的军用步枪、初级布绷带和腌制鹿肉干。
text.description: 你……你看见了吗？阿尔萨斯王子刚刚把那个人杀了！真残忍！就在大街上！$b$b<梅丽娜恢复了镇静。>$b$b我得保护孩子们。请你们帮帮我，外来者。我需要一把枪、绷带、还有一些鹿肉干。$b$b孩子们！大家都进屋去！
text.progress: The children are priority one.
text.completion: I don't know how long we'll need to stay holed up in the orphanage, but there's no way I'm letting the kids out while our prince walks the streets like some sort of madman.

english.title: Holing Up
english.objectives: Obtain a Refurbished Military Rifle, Basic Cloth Bandages, and Salted Venison Jerky.
english.description: Did... did you see that? Prince Arthas just struck that person down in cold blood! Right in the middle of the street!$b$b<Meliana regains her composure.>$b$bI need to protect the children. Please, help us, visitors. I need a gun, bandages, and some venison jerky.$b$bChildren! Everybody, get into the house!
english.progress: The children are priority one.
english.completion: I don't know how long we'll need to stay holed up in the orphanage, but there's no way I'm letting the kids out while our prince walks the streets like some sort of madman.

text.title: 以火攻毒
text.objectives: 找到一个燧石点火器和一段沉重的草绳。
text.description: 我还有最后一个要求，陌生人。我看到外面的情景了，我也听说过这场“瘟疫”的事情。我不想不经反抗就束手待毙。$b$b我的酒吧后面有很多朗姆酒，足够把整个酒馆点燃，但我没有能让我安全放火的工具。帮我找一块燧石和一段绳子，我就把斯坦索姆小巷的钥匙给你。
text.progress: Mad Prince or drooling zombie - nobody's going to take this bar away from me without a fight!
text.completion: This'll do, $C.$B$BTake this key. You've earned it.

english.title: Fight Plague with Fire
english.objectives: Obtain a Flinty Firestarter and some Heavy Straw Rope.
english.description: One final request of you, stranger. I've seen what's happening outside, and I've heard about this "plague". I don't want to go down without a fight.$b$bI have enough rum in the back of this bar to set this whole tavern on fire, but I don't have the tools to do it safely. Fetch me a flint and some rope, and I'll give you my key to the backstreets of Stratholme.
english.progress: Mad Prince or drooling zombie - nobody's going to take this bar away from me without a fight!
english.completion: This'll do, $C.$B$BTake this key. You've earned it.

text.title: FLAG - Fight Plague With Fire Complete

english.title: FLAG - Fight Plague With Fire Complete

text.title: 给埃姆雷
text.objectives: 把腌制鹿肉干交给埃姆雷·尼尔。
text.description: 不过，我们这里食物很充足。如果你有胆量上街，请把这些鹿肉交给酒馆里那个傻瓜。$b$b告诉他，是孩子们给他的。
text.progress: Say, what've you got there?
text.completion: From the kids, you say?$B$B<Emery struggles to conceal a smile as he pockets the jerky.>

english.title: For Emery
english.objectives: Deliver the Salted Venison Jerky to Emery Neill.
english.description: We do have plenty of food here, however. If you're braving the streets, please deliver this venison to that big dummy at the tavern.$b$bTell him it's from the kids.
english.progress: Say, what've you got there?
english.completion: From the kids, you say?$B$B<Emery struggles to conceal a smile as he pockets the jerky.>

text.title: 轻度烧烤
text.objectives: 使用圣光裁决者摧毁挡住泽尼达尔入口的石堆。
text.description: $n，能听到我说话吗？很好。$b$b圣光裁决者已经安装到维迪卡尔上了。我们应该马上就能使用它的力量。$b$b我们可以用它来清理挡住泽尼达尔的石堆，还能消灭敌人。$b$b对待任何新技术，我们都得先测试一下。要全面测试。我相信那里有足够多的目标。
text.completion: Excellent. The path is clear.

english.title: Lightly Roasted
english.objectives: Use Light's Judgment to destroy the rubble blocking the entrance to the Xenedar.
english.description: Can you hear me, $n? Good.$b$bLight's Judgment has been installed on the Vindicaar. We should be able to harness its power immediately.$b$bWe can use it both to clear the rubble blocking the Xenedar as well as destroy our enemies.$b$bAs with any new piece of technology, we should test it out. Thoroughly. I trust you have plenty of targets down there.
english.completion: Отлично. Путь расчищен.

text.title: 找到“神射手”的下落
text.objectives: 找到“神射手”巴拉特。
text.description: 想要解救泽拉，我们得需要更大的炮。$b$b炮就在靠近泽尼达尔的那些摧毁的碉堡里。如果是巴拉特在跟进这项任务，他肯定已经开始调查这片区域了。也许他已经找到了飞船的主炮。$b$b如果你去那边，请确保他还活着，好吗？
text.completion: We're under too much pressure here. And it's so close to us...

english.title: Locating the Longshot
english.objectives: Find Baraat the Longshot.
english.description: We're going to need a bigger gun if we hope to free Xe'ra.$b$bOne of the other bunkers crashed closer to the Xenedar. If Baraat was on it, he will have already begun surveying the area. Perhaps he's found the main cannon of the ship.$b$bIf you head over that way, make sure he hasn't died, will you?
english.completion: Мы здесь как между молотом и наковальней.

text.title: 炮火蔽日
text.objectives: 破坏部落攻城火炮。
text.description: 哦！是我！你是$n，对吧？我记得这里！$b$b我好像被困在部落和联盟的战斗之中，一般来说，这不是什么大事，只不过每当我想飞走，那台大炮似乎就瞄准我不放。$b$b你能帮我解决掉它吗？
text.completion: You did it! Now hurry along... if I remember this correctly, you don't have much time left!

english.title: Sky Ablaze With Cannonfire
english.objectives: Destroy the Horde Siege Cannon.
english.description: Oh! It's me! And $n, was it? I remember this!$b$bI seem to have found myself in the middle of a battle between the Horde and the Alliance, which wouldn't USUALLY be a big deal, except for that enormous cannon that seems to be trained on me anytime I try to fly away.$b$bThink you could take it out for me?
english.completion: You did it! Now hurry along... if I remember this correctly, you don't have much time left!

text.title: 我担心我的朋友

text.description: 我听说，黑龙的巨龙圣地出了点麻烦。我知道，我是青铜龙，不过那又如何！我偶尔也会担心他们！他们的脾气也不总是那么暴躁。$b$b如果你正好要过去的话，你能不能处理一下……在那边引发混乱的东西？
text.completion: It was a dreadlord? That's... unusual. I mean, I know we're in Northrend and everything, so risen skeletons aren't all that rare, but demons?$B$BOh well! Thanks for taking the time to calm my worries.

english.title: Worried About My Friends
english.objectives: Slay Zorathides at the Obsidian Dragonshrine.
english.description: I've heard about some trouble over at the black dragonshrine. I know, I'm a bronze dragon, but still! I worry about them sometimes! They weren't ALWAYS so grumpy.$b$bIf you're going there anyways, would you mind taking care of... whatever's causing so much of a disturbance?
english.completion: It was a dreadlord? That's... unusual. I mean, I know we're in Northrend and everything, so risen skeletons aren't all that rare, but demons?$B$BOh well! Thanks for taking the time to calm my worries.

english.completion: You have my thanks, $R.$B$BI know that you are here today in service to the Bronze Dragonflight. Perhaps this gift will aid you in your journeys.

"$p,

$p,

We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all.

text.description: 塔尔加斯。他曾经是我的盟友、朋友。$b$b离开阿古斯的时候，我还很信任他。我请求他找到那些愿意跟随我的人。$b$b我给了他所需的一切，他却背叛了我，杀害我的追随者。$b$b我不知道他内心深处的这种仇恨从何而来，但他的阴谋迫使我的人民从一个世界不断逃向另一个世界。他穿越宇宙不断追杀我们。$b$b这一切必须到此为止，$n。塔尔加斯必须死。

I asked him to call out to the others who would join me.$b$bI gave him all that he needed to betray me and slaughter my followers.$b$bI do not know what brought this hatred to lurk in his heart, but his machinations repeatedly forced my people to flee world after world. He made it his mission to hunt us across the universe.$b$bThis must end, $n. Talgath must die.

德莱尼人打造了一搜飞船，可以把我们安全地送到阿古斯。就在我们说话的时候，他们正在秘蓝岛聚集进攻部队。

我们会从海上过去加入他们的队伍。燃烧军团肯定会盯着他们世界的入口。我们必须出其不意。

你准备好了之后就跟我说。

english.description:
The draenei have crafted a vessel to take us to Argus safely. They are gathering the invasion force on Azuremyst Isle as we speak. 

We will join them there by sea. The Legion is no doubt keeping a close eye on the gateway to their world. We must retain the element of surprise.

Let me know when you are ready.

text.objectives: 稳定8个不稳定的能量导体。

text.completion: Yes, excellent. The conduits are back online.$B$BThe construct however is proving a little more difficult to awaken than I had hoped.

english.description: I have an idea. This construct will be of use to us. We simply need to jolt it awake.$b$bWe once stored great quantities of energy in conduits throughout the Conservatory. They are still functional, but only just.$b$bTake this.$b$b<Y'mera hands you a brightly glowing crystal.>$b$bIt will provide a small burst of magic that should help stabilize an erratic conduit. I think I have enough stored for eight or so.$b$bStabilizing a few should allow us to access the whole network.
english.completion: Очень хорошо. Проводники снова работают в штатном режиме.$b$bА вот пробудить голема оказалось сложнее, чем я предполагала.

text.title: 最漫长的守望
text.objectives: 唤醒守门人。
text.description: 还好我们找了两种能量源。即使这些导体激活了，构造体还是没有反应。$b$b它可能有很长一段时间没被启动过了，也许跟玛凯雷在阿古斯上方飘浮的时间一样久。$b$b它守卫的时光多么漫长而孤独。$b$b<伊米拉看着构造体，沉默了片刻。>$b$b去吧，把它刺激一下，再加上一点魔法的爆发，应该就会起作用了。

Perhaps as long as Mac'Aree has floated above Argus.$b$bWhat a long, lonely vigil it must have been.$b$b<Y'mera is silent for a moment as she peers at the construct.>$b$bGo ahead and jostle it a little. That combined with one last burst of magic ought to do the trick.
english.completion: Приготовься, $gнезнакомец:незнакомка;.

想要结束这场战争，我们就必须要利用一切能利用到的优势。你应该找到他的下落。

We need every advantage we can muster if we are to see this war through. You should seek him out.

text.title: 折磨的幻象
text.objectives: 激活圣石，和麦格尼一起观看幻象。
text.description:
来到阿古斯之后，我一直听到低语声。就像艾泽拉斯的低语一样，只不过……不是她的声音。

我很确定，阿古斯的泰坦想要和我们取得联系！

破碎者在附近藏有一个圣物。哈顿说他们是就是从那里听到低语的……我想它可能与阿古斯本身有着某种联系！

就在这个房间。看看我们能发现什么东西。
text.progress: I know, I know, it's too much to ask, but we need all the help we can get right now, Friend;!
text.completion: I don't know how Sargeras managed to raise Aggramar, but it's bad news for us, believe you me.

english.title: Visions of Torment
english.objectives: Activate the Sacred Stone to witness Argus' vision with Magni.
english.description:
I've been hearin' whispers ever since we got to Argus. They're just like Azeroth's, only... they ain't hers.

I'm convinced that Argus has a titan of its own that's reachin' out to us!

The broken have a relic stowed away that's darn near holy to 'em. Hatuun says they hear whispers from it... I think it might have some sort o' link to Argus itself!

It's just in this chamber. Let's see what we can learn.
english.progress: I know, I know, it's too much to ask, but we need all the help we can get right now, Friend;!
english.completion: Уж не знаю, как Саргерас умудрился воскресить Агграмара, но это не сулит нам ничего хорошего, уж поверь мне.

text.title: 坏消息
text.objectives: 返回维迪卡尔与图拉扬会面。
text.description: 艾泽拉斯送我们到这里来是对的，$n。我们必须阻止萨格拉斯的计划，否则最后我们可能连艾泽拉斯这个家都没有了。$B$B你应该回到图拉扬那里，把你看到的情况告诉他。我会呆在这里，看看能否找到其他能给我们提供帮助的东西。
text.completion: What did Magni have to show you?
text.completed: 向维迪卡尔的图拉扬复命。

english.title: Dire News
english.objectives: Return to Turalyon on the Vindicaar.
english.description: Azeroth was right in sendin' us here, $n. We have to stop whatever it is Sargeras is plannin', or we may not have a home left to save when this is all over.$B$BYe should go back to Turalyon and let him know what ye've seen. I'll stay here and see if I can't glean anything else that might help us.
english.completion: Что тебе показал Магни?
english.completed: Return to Turalyon on the Vindicaar.

text.title: 进攻堡垒
text.objectives: 前往命运角。
text.description:
我们已经在纳斯拉克斯要塞附近稳固了阵地。那应该是燃烧军团在阿古斯重要的军事要塞之一。

立即对其发动猛烈攻击，这可能是我们扭转战场形势的唯一机会。
text.completion: If we do not act quickly, the demons stationed here are more than enough to overwhelm us.
text.completed: 与命运角的图拉扬汇合。

english.title: Storming the Citadel
english.objectives: Travel to Destiny Point.
english.description:
We have already secured ground near Nath'raxas Hold. It is one of the Legion's chief military fortifications on Argus.

Striking it now, and hard, may be our only opportunity to tip the scales in our favor.
english.completion: If we delay, the demons based here will easily defeat us.

objectiveDetails.description: 与命运角的图拉扬汇合。

text.title: 伯特的机器人
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败伯特。
text.description:
如果我要清理诺莫瑞根，就必须准备好面对各种各样的老鼠、蟑螂，可能还有可怕的变异鼠蟑。

我想说的是，我得测试这些机器人！需要进行实地检测才行！

你的宠物准备好进行代码审查了吗？
text.completion: I'm going to have to go back to the drawing board!

english.title: Bert's Bots
english.objectives: Defeat Bert in a pet battle.
english.description:
If I'm going to clean up Gnomeregan, I've got to be ready to battle all manner of rat, roach, and potentially even the dreaded mutant rat-roach.

What I'm saying is that I need to put these bots to the test! A real, live-action field demo.

Are your pets up for a code review?
english.completion: I'm going to have to go back to the drawing board!

text.title: 保卫真正的未来
text.objectives: 在场景战役“克罗米之死”中一次性阻止来自黑曜石、红玉、碧蓝和翡翠巨龙圣地的攻击。
text.description:
我知道你在想什么，$n。我可不是因为怕死才请你帮忙的。

我请你帮忙是因为，我不应该这么死。我确实会死——我早就预见到了！但我的死期还早着呢。而且，为了私人原因而扰乱时间流——这违反了我们青铜龙军团的宗旨。

让我们阻止对全部四座巨龙圣地的攻击。这应该管用。
text.completion: We've stopped all four attacks from the dragonshrines - but the timelines are still incorrect. I'm still being assassinated, elsewhere, at the same time.$B$BLooks like our work isn't done yet, $n!

english.title: Preserve the True Future
english.objectives: Stop the attacks from the Obsidian, Ruby, Azure, and Emerald Dragonshrines in one attempt of the Deaths of Chromie scenario.
english.description:
I know how this looks, $n. I'm not asking for your help simply because I don't want to get killed.

I need your help because this isn't how I'm SUPPOSED to die. I will die - I've seen it! - but it happens much later than this. Besides, meddling with the timeways for personal reasons - well, it goes against pretty much everything my dragonflight stands for.

Let's stop all four of the dragonshrine attacks. That should do the trick.
english.completion: We've stopped all four attacks from the dragonshrines - but the timelines are still incorrect. I'm still being assassinated, elsewhere, at the same time.$B$BLooks like our work isn't done yet, $n!

objectiveDetails.description: 阻止所有四个巨龙圣地的攻击

text.title: 克罗米之死
text.objectives: 在场景战役“克罗米之死”中一次性阻止针对克罗米的全部八次攻击。
text.description:
看来我们得阻止针对我的全部八次攻击，而且要在十五分钟内完成。

就算是对我来说，这段时间也不算多。

可要是还有人能够做到的话，那就是我们了。你准备好了吗，$n？
text.completion: We've done it! The timelines are exactly as they're supposed to be again. With me, alive.

english.title: The Deaths of Chromie
english.objectives: Stop all eight attacks on Chromie in one attempt in the Deaths of Chromie scenario.
english.description:
It looks like we're going to have to stop all eight attacks on me. In one fifteen-minute span.

Even to me, that doesn't seem like a lot of time.

Still, if anybody can do it, it's us. Are you ready, $n?
english.completion: We've done it! The timelines are exactly as they're supposed to be again. With me, alive.

objectiveDetails.description: 阻止对克罗米的所有八次攻击

text.title: 阿古斯套羊手
text.objectives: 将$1oa头野生岩羊带给首席骑兵贾伊德。
text.description: 如果没有我们的岩羊，即使面对最低级的军团小队，我的战士也毫无胜算。如果你可以抓几头带回来，那么我的战士就能更好地保护人民了。
text.completion: With these new steeds our forces stand a chance.

english.title: An Argus Roper
english.objectives: Return $1oa Wild Cragscalers to Lead Rider Jerek.
english.description: My warriors stand no chance against even the smallest of the Legion's forces without our Cragscalers. If you can capture a few and bring them here, my warriors can better defend our people.
english.completion: С этими скакунами у наших бойцов будет хоть какой-то шанс.

text.title: 过往的伤痕
text.objectives: 找到一个符咒阵列、一件守备官装甲和一枚审判核心。
text.description:
圣光军团的战争机甲已在阿古斯获得过无数胜利。这些机甲虽然力量强大，但并非所有加入战斗的机甲都能平安归来。

我对这部机甲所做的调整应当能为我们提供所需的优势，但我目前仍然缺少几个关键的组件。

纳斯拉克斯还残留着过往战斗的残迹，我们可以加以利用。如果你找到我所需要的组件，军团就将再次承受我们的怒火。
text.progress: Do you have the components?
text.completion: Perfect! Thank you, $n.

english.title: Scars of the Past
english.objectives: Recover an Invocation Array, Vindicator Plating, and a Judgment Core.
english.description:
The Army of the Light's warframes have won countless battles on Argus. Despite their power, not all who descend into the fray return.

My modifications to this frame should give us the edge we need, but several critical components are still missing.

There are remains of battles past in Nath'raxas that we can still scavenge. If you can find the pieces I need, the Legion will feel our fury yet.
english.progress: Материалы у тебя?
english.completion: Отлично! Спасибо тебе, $n.

text.title: 预防措施
text.objectives: 使用先知护符，净化$1oa名阵亡的圣光军团战士。
text.description:
军团的邪恶无穷无尽。每打赢一场战斗，每攻占一个世界，都会为他们的战争机器贡献更多灵魂燃料。

他们还没腐化这座要塞里所有阵亡的战士，但那恐怕也只是个时间问题。拜托，请带着这枚护符进入要塞，用它净化你所遇到的尸体。

他们的命运不应如此悲惨。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Your actions deny the Legion power and grant the dead the peace they deserve.

english.title: Preventive Measures
english.objectives: Use the Talisman of the Prophet to sanctify $1oa fallen Army of the Light warriors.
english.description:
There is no end to the Legion's depravity. Every battle won, every world conquered, yields more souls to fuel their war machine.

They have not yet defiled all of the fallen warriors in the hold, but I fear it is only a matter of time. Please, take this talisman with you into the hold and use it to sanctify any corpses you encounter.

They deserve a better fate.
english.completion: Спасибо, $n. Ты $gлишил:лишила; Легион дополнительного источника силы и $gдаровал:даровала; мертвым заслуженный покой.

text.title: 混沌理论
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名纳斯拉克森裂肉者、纳斯拉克森末日射手或贪婪的猎魂犬，以及$2oa名纳斯雷兹姆怨毒领主。
text.description:
虽然力量强大、数量众多，但即使是燃烧军团也需要秩序。扰乱他们的秩序……他们就会化为乌合之众。

计划很简单。让他们的军队陷入混乱，胜利就属于我们了。
text.completion: Now that their forces are in disarray, let us proceed.

english.title: Chaos Theory
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Nath'raxxan Fleshcarvers, Nath'raxxan Doomshots, or Ravenous Soulhunters, and $2oa Nathrezim Banelord.
english.description:
Despite their strength and their numbers, even the Burning Legion requires order to fight. Disrupt that order... and they fall like the rabble they are.

The plan is simple. Let chaos reign in their ranks, and the day will be ours.
english.completion: Теперь, когда их силы в смятении, можно двигаться дальше.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭纳斯拉克森的部队

text.title: 末日使者
text.objectives: 击杀赫拉迪卡夫人和妖女阿波崔丝。
text.description:
我们发现了一个大好机会。

我们的侦察兵在西部的邪能之池中发现了两个破坏魔女祭司，她们正在强化军团的战争物资。

萨格拉斯的近臣从不离开安托鲁斯的高墙。如果能干掉她们，我们也许可以在那些最接近黑暗泰坦的人群中间散播恐慌。
text.completion: Impressive. Without the shivarra bolstering their strength we just might stand a chance.

english.title: Heralds of Apocalypse
english.objectives: Slay Lady Heretica and Mistress Apostriss.
english.description:
We've been presented with a rare opportunity.

Our scouts have spotted two shivarra priestesses in the western fel pools enhancing the Legion's war effort.

The inner circle of Sargeras' chosen never leave the walls of Antorus. If we take them out, we might be able to sow fear among those closest to the Dark Titan.
english.completion: Impressive. Now that we've gotten rid of the shivars, our chances are much better.

text.title: 一丝邪能
text.objectives: 收集一枚完美的邪能核心。
text.description:
我们的战争机甲就快完成了！现在只需要一股猛烈的电流就能重新激活它的系统。

下面那个池子里的术士正在用邪能灌注阿古斯的碎片，以打造活化攻城武器。如果你可以带一枚回来，我们就能用它启动战争机甲的审判核心！
text.progress: Remember - immaculate!
text.completion: Yes! This is it!

english.title: A Touch of Fel
english.objectives: Collect an Immaculate Felcore.
english.description:
Our warframe is almost operational! It just needs a good jolt to revitalize its systems.

Warlocks in the pools below infuse pieces of Argus with fel energy to create living siege weapons. If you can extract one, we can use it to jumpstart the warframe's Judgment Core!
english.progress: Помни – непременно безупречное!
english.completion: Yes! What you need!

text.title: 黑暗阴谋
text.objectives: 拆毁$1oa座哀伤尖塔。
text.description:
艾瑞达极其擅长操纵遍布这个世界的邪能。那些没在制造活化武器的恶魔制造出了其他武器，例如哀伤尖塔。

这些尖塔阻碍了我们的推进，就算是小型部队也无法抵达要塞主楼。我们必须拆毁一定数量的尖塔，清出一条道路后才能继续前进。
text.completion: No war is won by a single act, but without the spires protecting them the rest of the hold will fall as well.

english.title: Dark Machinations
english.objectives: Dismantle $1oa Spires of Woe.
english.description:
Eredar are adept at manipulating the fel that courses through this world. Those who do not shape it into living weapons build other armaments, like the Spires of Woe.

The spires will make it difficult for even a small force to penetrate the main stronghold. We must dismantle enough of them to clear the way before we advance upon it.
english.completion: Конечно, это не решающая победа, но без шпилей их крепость рано или поздно падет.

text.title: 正义黎明
text.objectives: 使用光铸战争机甲占领复仇者庭院。
text.description:
感谢你的努力，我们的敌人已陷入混乱，他们的防御工事也无法运作了。

我们必须在尖塔底座稳住脚步，然后收紧围绕在他们指挥官脖子上的铰链。

你的出色表现早已赢得了使用战争机甲的资格。通道清理完成后，我们将听从你的指挥。
text.completion: Well fought! Now for the commander.

english.title: Dawn of Justice
english.objectives: Use the Lightforged Warframe to take control of the Court of the Avenger.
english.description:
Thanks to your efforts, our enemy is in disarray and their defenses inoperable.

We must take the ground at the spire's base and tighten the noose around their commander's neck.

You have more than earned the honor to take the warframe into battle. We will follow your lead once the way is clear.
english.completion: Отлично! Теперь осталось только покончить с командиром.

objectiveDetails.description: 获得光铸战争机甲的控制权

text.title: 高塔之主
text.objectives: 击败领主纳斯拉克斯。
text.description:
作为许多年前将阿古斯献给燃烧军团的犒赏，领主纳斯拉克斯得以统治这座要塞。

毫无疑问，他非常强大，但久居高位的他也日渐刚愎自用。

尽可能利用他的傲慢和战争机甲的火力。我们很快就要突袭庭院了！
text.completion: By the Light...
text.completed: 在维迪卡尔与图拉扬见面。

english.title: Lord of the Spire
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Nath'raxas.
english.description:
Lord Nath'raxas rules over this hold as thanks for his role in delivering Argus to the Legion many years ago.

Make no mistake, he is powerful, but he has also grown overconfident in his seat.

Take advantage of his hubris and make use of the warframe's firepower while you can. We will storm the courtyard shortly!
english.completion: Свет милостивый...

text.title: 光明正大
text.objectives: 找到“神射手”巴拉特、大守备官索沃斯和剑圣特拉蒙。
text.description: 我的士兵们还在战场上，$n。$b$b我需要你去找到巴拉特、索沃斯和特拉蒙。军团突然出现在我们面前时，他们正在为维伦清理这片地区。$b$b去通知他们，现在的命令是立即回到先知身边。$b$b已经没时间小心翼翼了。一小股敌人正挡在我们之间。不必手下留情。$b$b圣光保佑你。
text.completion: Fareeya's forces are the best the Army of the Light has to offer. Our mission is that much more likely to succeed with them at our side.

english.title: Overt Ops
english.objectives: Locate Baraat the Longshot, Grand Vindicator Sorvos, and Blademaster Telaamon.
english.description: My soldiers are out there, $n.$b$bI need you to find Baraat, Sorvos, and Telaamon. They were in the process of securing this area for Velen when the Legion came down on top of our heads.$b$bInform them that their orders are to regroup with the Prophet at once.$b$bThe time for subtlety has passed. There is a small army between us and them. Do what you must.$b$bLight keep you safe.
english.completion: Pharaoh's fighters are the best in the entire Army of Light. If they fight with us, our chances of success will be greatly improved.

text.title: 补给有限
text.objectives: 前往石化森林，回收$1oa个用过的瓶子。
text.description: 你好，$n。很高兴能够再次见到炼金术师同行。$b$b我一直在为我们的营地提供对付恶魔所需的药水，但我的库存最近总是不太足。侦查兵们平时出去之后，都会带着空瓶子回来，但最近回收到的却很少。$b$b我已经在尽可能地重复利用了，所以你瞧，这些瓶子对我非常重要。如果你愿意去野外把我的瓶子找回来，我可以教你一种药水，在对抗恶魔的时候很有帮助。
text.progress: How goes the search? Any luck on finding my vials?
text.completion: You've found some! These will certainly be enough to get us by for a good while longer.$B$BAs promised, here is a recipe for one of the potions I brew to help in our fight against the Legion.

english.title: Limited Supplies
english.objectives: Go to the Petrified Forest and reclaim $1oa Used Vials.
english.description: Hello, $n. It's good to see a fellow alchemist again.$b$bI've been supplying our camp with necessary potions to deal with the demons, but lately I've been running low on supplies. Normally when scouting parties go out, they return with empty vials, but as of late fewer have been returning.$b$bI try to recycle as much as I can, so you see, those vials are precious to me. If you'd be willing to go out and retrieve them, I could show you what I've been making to help combat the demons.
english.progress: How goes the search? Any luck on finding my vials?
english.completion: You've found some! These will certainly be enough to get us by for a good while longer.$B$BAs promised, here is a recipe for one of the potions I brew to help in our fight against the Legion.

text.title: 反追踪
text.objectives: 消灭安尼赫兰熔池的$1oa头邪焰清道夫。
text.description: $n，我有没有跟你讲过我的追踪药水？我们的侦察兵用它追踪恶魔，尤其是他们的“魔犬”。$b$b那些怪物特别喜欢吞噬附近的星辰之耀，导致我们的草药库存一直无法补充。$b$b如果你能削减它们的数量，我们就不用去其他地方补充库存，那可就帮了大忙了。他们在安尼赫兰熔池附近大量徘徊。$b$b为了感谢你的帮助，我会将这种药水的配方送给你。
text.completion: You're an honorable ally, $n. Thank you for helping us.$B$BAs promised, here is the recipe for the potion.

english.title: Tracking the Trackers
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Feflame Scavengers at the Annihilan Pits.
english.description: $n, have I told you about my tracking potion? Our scouts use it to track demons, especially their "fiends".$b$bThose particular creatures tend to consume the astral glory in the area, making it difficult to replenish our stores of the herb.$b$bIf you could help thin their numbers out, it would greatly help us from having to search elsewhere for supplies. You can find many of them in the Annihilan Pits.$b$bI could also teach you the recipe for this potion for your effort.
english.completion: You're an honorable ally, $n. Thank you for helping us.$B$BAs promised, here is the recipe for the potion.

text.title: 提升炼金
text.objectives: 把$1oa株星辰之耀，$2oa个源生萨格里特以及一枚地狱火炼金石交给弗恩。
text.description: 我看到某些经过我们营地的炼金师携带着一种有趣的饰品。我记得他们好像称之为……“炼金石”？$b$b我能感觉到那些石头散发的力量，但它们似乎被邪能污染了。这颗星球上生长的草药尤其擅长净化腐蚀。我用它来净化那些经常出现在草药里的源生萨格里特。$b$b我敢肯定，如果我们对那些石头使用净化过的萨格里特，就能够提升其中蕴藏的力量。
text.progress: I know it's a lot of materials to ask for, but it's necessary.
text.completion: And there you have it! I believe this will be far more useful for you in your fight against the Legion.$B$BAllow me to explain how it's done...

english.title: Ascending Alchemy
english.objectives: Bring Funen $1oa Astral Glory, $2oa Primal Sargerite and an Infernal Alchemist Stone.
english.description: I've seen other alchemists come through our camp carrying interesting looking trinkets. I believe they refer to them as... "alchemist stones"?$b$bI can sense the power they radiate, but they appear fel-tainted. The herb that grows on this planet is particularly good at cleansing corruption. I use it to purify the primal sargerite that's often found amongst the herbs.$b$bI'm certain that if we used a purified sargerite with one of those stones, we could elevate the power within it.
english.progress: I know it's a lot of materials to ask for, but it's necessary.
english.completion: And there you have it! I believe this will be far more useful for you in your fight against the Legion.$B$BAllow me to explain how it's done...

text.title: 克罗米
text.objectives: 与龙骨荒野的克罗米的友谊达到“时空跃迁者”级别。
text.description: $n，是你吗？$b$b我相信时间线里出现了怪事。我需要你的帮助！$b$b到龙眠神殿来找我吧，就在龙骨荒野。我会亲自带你看看 。
text.completion: Despite her troubles, this has been a welcome reminder that, although our battle with the Legion remains at the forefront of our concerns, the rest of the world does not simply wait for us.

english.title: Chromie
english.objectives: Reach "Timehopper" friendship rank with Chromie in Dragonblight.
english.description: $n. Is that you?$b$bI'm convinced that something unusual has happened in the timelines. I need your help!$b$bCome find me at Wyrmrest Temple, in Dragonblight, and I'll show you.
english.completion: Despite her troubles, this has been a welcome reminder that, although our battle with the Legion remains at the forefront of our concerns, the rest of the world does not simply wait for us.

objectiveDetails.description: 与克罗米的友谊达到“时空跃迁者”级别。
（可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往龙眠神殿

text.title: 阿古斯之耀
text.objectives: 在阿古斯找到一个可以教你处理星辰之耀的人。
text.description: <你从地上摘起那朵花。如此纯净的东西竟然还能在这颗星球上生长，真是令人惊奇。你感觉到其中弥漫出微弱的力量，随后消散殆尽。>$b$b<随着它在手中凋零，你不禁思考，在这片被圣光遗忘的土地上，是否会有人知道该如何处理这种珍贵的草药。>
text.completion: So you were trying to gather astral glory I see. Yes, there is a method to doing it correctly.$B$BThe flower has a power to it, allowing it to protect itself from anything it thinks may seek to destroy it. If it feels truly threatened, it extinguishes itself.$B$BYou mustn't try to pick it with intent to harm, but to protect. It's an unfortunate irony as we eventually destroy it in the process of making items with it.$B$BHowever, this deception is necessary for it to yield itself to you.

english.title: The Glory of Argus
english.objectives: Find someone on Argus who might be able to train you on how to handle Astral Glory.
english.description: <Amazed that anything so pure could continue to grow on this planet, you pick the flower from the ground. You feel a small power radiate from it and then vanish.>$b$b<As it falls apart in your hands, you wonder if anyone on this Light-forsaken place knows how to handle this precious herb.>
english.completion: So you were trying to gather astral glory I see. Yes, there is a method to doing it correctly.$B$BThe flower has a power to it, allowing it to protect itself from anything it thinks may seek to destroy it. If it feels truly threatened, it extinguishes itself.$B$BYou mustn't try to pick it with intent to harm, but to protect. It's an unfortunate irony as we eventually destroy it in the process of making items with it.$B$BHowever, this deception is necessary for it to yield itself to you.

text.title: 年轻的抵抗
text.objectives: 询问弗恩，了解如何处理较为鲜嫩的星辰之耀。
text.description: <开始采集之后，你发现一些较为鲜嫩的花朵依然抵制你的接触，拒绝投降。也许弗恩知道该如何应对新开的花朵。>
text.completion: Indeed, the newer blooms are particularly stubborn and would rather give up their life than live in servitude to those who pick them.$B$BTo handle the herb in this form, one must coax the herb into submitting, as it can't quite fully read the intentions of those who wish to gather it.

english.title: Youthful Resistance
english.objectives: Ask Funen about how to handle the younger Astral Glories.
english.description: <As you begin to gather the flowers, you realize that some of the younger blooms are still resistant to your approach and refuse to yield. Perhaps Funen might know more about how to handle the herb in its adolescent stages.>
english.completion: Indeed, the newer blooms are particularly stubborn and would rather give up their life than live in servitude to those who pick them.$B$BTo handle the herb in this form, one must coax the herb into submitting, as it can't quite fully read the intentions of those who wish to gather it.

text.title: 它的心
text.objectives: 询问弗恩，了解星辰之耀的发光根茎。
text.description: <与星辰之耀打了一段时间的交道之后，你对它的根茎产生了兴趣。紧紧缠成茧形的根茎里，细小的光斑穿透裂隙照射出来，散发出莹莹微光。$b$b也许弗恩知道这种光芒是什么。>
text.completion: I see the glory has come to trust you fully. It is now exposing its heart to you.$B$BFocus your intentions here and you will gather it in its entirety.

english.title: The Heart of It
english.objectives: Ask Funen about the shimmering roots of the Astral Glory.
english.description: <Having handled astral glory for a while now, you've picked up on something interesting about its roots. Tightly wound in a cocoon, small flecks of light permeate through the cracks creating a shimmering effect.>$b$b<Perhaps Funen might be able to expand on the nature of these lights.>
english.completion: I see the glory has come to trust you fully. It is now exposing its heart to you.$B$BFocus your intentions here and you will gather it in its entirety.

english.title: FLAG - Well of Eternity Scene Seen

text.title: 天界金矿脉结块
text.objectives: 在维迪卡尔上找到一个可以教你开采天界金矿脉的人。
text.description: <你挖向矿石的时候，镐头发出一声巨响，一小块碎石掉落在地。按照这种速度，想从这处矿脉挖出足够的矿石，将需要花费一整天的时间。$b$b也许有人可以指导你如何正确地开采这种矿石？>
text.completion: Empyrium requires a precise strike to yield the best results. Aim your pick at the brightest bits of the ore, which also happen to be very small, hence the precision.$B$BThis will break the deposit apart faster and you'll be able to harvest ore quicker.

english.title: Empyrium Deposit Chunk
english.objectives: Find someone on the Vindicaar who might be able to train you on how to mine an empyrium deposit.
english.description: <As you swing your pickaxe into the ore, it hits with a resounding thud, sending a small chunk of it to the ground. At this rate, it would take you all day to get a sufficient amount of ore from this deposit.>$b$b<Perhaps someone can give you some insight into how to mine this deposit properly.>
english.completion: Залог продуктивной добычи эмпиреитовой руды – высокая точность при ударе киркой. Целься в самые яркие куски – они же обычно самые мелкие.$b$bЕсли несколько раз попадешь удачно, сможешь расколоть камень быстрее, а значит, добудешь больше руды.

text.title: 更精准的角度
text.objectives: 和卡米尔对话，了解是否有办法提高开采天界金矿脉的效率。
text.description: <看着挖掘矿脉后产生的天界金粉尘，你不禁思考，是否有办法能够防止矿脉在挖掘时碎裂。>$b$b<也许卡米尔可以和你分享一些经验。>
text.completion: As I mentioned before, precision is key with mining empyrium. You've learned to strike at the correct spots, now you must learn to strike at the correct angle.$B$BTake out your pick and I'll show you what I mean...

english.title: Angling For a Better Strike
english.objectives: Speak with Khamir and see if there's a better way to mine empyrium deposits.
english.description: <Looking at the empyrium dust from taking down this deposit, you wonder if there's a way to prevent part of the deposit from shattering with each impact.>$b$b<Perhaps Khamir will know something further that he can share with you.>
english.completion: As I mentioned before, precision is key with mining empyrium. You've learned to strike at the correct spots, now you must learn to strike at the correct angle.$B$BTake out your pick and I'll show you what I mean...

text.title: 完美精准
text.objectives: 和卡米尔对话，了解是否能够再提高开采天界金矿脉的效率。
text.description: <虽然你已经学会如何最大限度地开采矿脉，但矿脉的核心却总是无法使用。近距离观察之下，你发现你击打的地方就是核心开裂的地方。>$b$b<看来还需要再拜访卡米尔一次，以解决这个问题。>
text.completion: You've learned where to strike and at what angle to strike, but should you wish to leave the core intact to mine, you must finally learn how hard to strike.$B$BThe fractures you found in this core are the result of striking the ore too hard. As I'm sure you no doubt know by now, mining empyrium is not just a task, but an art.$B$BCome, let us practice your swing until it's just right.

english.title: Precision Perfected
english.objectives: Speak with Khamir and see if there's an even better way to mine empyrium deposits.
english.description: <While you've learned to extract as much of the deposit as you can, the core of the deposit is always left unusable. Looking closely, you can see where your strikes were causing fractures in its structure.>$b$b<One more lesson from Khamir might be needed to correct this problem.>
english.completion: You've learned where to strike and at what angle to strike, but should you wish to leave the core intact to mine, you must finally learn how hard to strike.$B$BThe fractures you found in this core are the result of striking the ore too hard. As I'm sure you no doubt know by now, mining empyrium is not just a task, but an art.$B$BCome, let us practice your swing until it's just right.

text.title: 天界金矿层结块
text.objectives: 在维迪卡尔上找到某个也许可以教你开采天界金矿层的人。
text.description: <一开始，你以为矿石表层是镜面，反射着头顶上的漫天繁星。挖下一大块之后，你发现原来矿石本身的质地便如星光一般。>$b$b<也许维迪卡尔上有人可以指导你如何更高效地开采这种矿层。>
text.completion: Empyrium is quite a sight to behold once it's been mined. And while the deposits of this ore require precision, the seams require exposure.$B$BIf you spend some time picking away the surrounding rock, you'll find much more ore to harvest.

english.title: Empyrium Seam Chunk
english.objectives: Find someone at the Vindicaar who might be able to train you on how to mine empyrium seams.
english.description: <At first you thought the ore to have a mirrored surface, reflecting the starry space above you. After breaking off a chunk, you realize that the ore itself has a starry quality all of its own.>$b$b<Perhaps someone back at the Vindicaar can give you some insight on how to better extract these seams more efficiently.>
english.completion: Empyrium is quite a sight to behold once it's been mined. And while the deposits of this ore require precision, the seams require exposure.$B$BIf you spend some time picking away the surrounding rock, you'll find much more ore to harvest.

text.title: 别闷头下镐
text.objectives: 与卡米尔对话，了解如何从天界金矿层中开采更多矿石。
text.description: <虽然你已经学会了暴露矿石，但大型结块似乎依然牢牢地嵌在周围的岩石中。开采这种矿石也许无法得到你所需要的纯净天界金。>$b$b<也许卡米尔可以告诉你该如何挖掘矿层中的这种矿石。>
text.completion: Empyrium seams can be tricky in that regard. The ore is very good at interweaving itself into the surrounding elements.$B$BI've found that striking those areas with the shaft of the pick loosens the empyrium's grip on it, so that when you pick at it, the rock should just fall away.

english.title: Don't Just Pick At It
english.objectives: Speak with Khamir about a way to extract more ore from empyrium seams.
english.description: <Even though you've learned to expose the ore, large chunks of it still seem to be embedded in the surrounding rock. Picking those pieces away may not result in the pure form of empyrium that you're looking for.>$b$b<Perhaps Khamir can show you a way to remove the ore from these sections of the seam.>
english.completion: Empyrium seams can be tricky in that regard. The ore is very good at interweaving itself into the surrounding elements.$B$BI've found that striking those areas with the shaft of the pick loosens the empyrium's grip on it, so that when you pick at it, the rock should just fall away.

text.title: 平衡力度
text.objectives: 与卡米尔对话，了解如何从天界金矿层中开采更多矿石。
text.description: <逐渐深入矿层底部之后，你只能找到小块矿石和碎片。虽然总和起来的话，数量应该够用。>$b$b<卡米尔也许有办法防止这种情况的发生。>
text.completion: Much like the deposit, empyrium requires a balanced extraction. Its core is its most fragile section.$B$BIf you swing too hard, it breaks, too soft and you'll be there forever. The same is true for loosening it from its surrounding rock.$B$BHere, let me show you a method which balances both.

english.title: Balancing the Break
english.objectives: Speak with Khamir about a way to extract even more ore from empyrium seams.
english.description: <Getting down to the root of the seam, you're left with nothing but small bits and pieces. Collectively though, they would have been enough to work with.>$b$b<Khamir might know a way to prevent this from happening.>
english.completion: Much like the deposit, empyrium requires a balanced extraction. Its core is its most fragile section.$B$BIf you swing too hard, it breaks, too soft and you'll be there forever. The same is true for loosening it from its surrounding rock.$B$BHere, let me show you a method which balances both.

text.title: 被污染的碎皮
text.objectives: 在维迪卡尔上找到某个也许可以教你剥制恶魔皮革的人。
text.description: <当你开始小心翼翼地剥皮时，你发现尸体的腐烂很快污染了皮毛。>$b$b<剥下皮后，你只能使用其中一小部分的皮革，而且气味非常难闻。也许维迪卡尔上有人知道这种恶臭皮毛的事情。>
text.completion: If you haven't already guessed, the key to skinning these creatures properly is speed. They're born of foul energies and those spill out once you begin to cut into the corpse.$B$BI would suggest training your hand to become faster at removing the hide.

english.title: Tainted Scraps
english.objectives: Find someone at the Vindicaar who might be able to train you on how to skin fiendish leather.
english.description: <As you begin to carefully remove the skin from the corpse, you notice it quickly becoming corrupted by the decay of the creature.>$b$b<Pulling away, you were only able to extract a small amount of leather and something foul smelling. Perhaps someone on the Vindicaar might know more about this foul hide.>
english.completion: If you haven't already guessed, the key to skinning these creatures properly is speed. They're born of foul energies and those spill out once you begin to cut into the corpse.$B$BI would suggest training your hand to become faster at removing the hide.

text.title: 大块皮革
text.objectives: 和恩斯特拉对话，学习更高效的恶魔皮革剥离方法。
text.description: <虽然你的剥皮速度快多了，但还是有很多皮革在剥下前被污染。>$b$b<恩斯特拉也许知道该如何在皮毛被污染前剥离出更多皮革。>
text.completion: So you've become faster, but you're still thinking in your old ways.$B$BInstead of cutting away small pieces at a time, try making one large cut and removing as much of the hide in as few cuts as possible. Move away from the corpse and begin cutting the large pieces into smaller, usable pieces.

english.title: A Larger Cut
english.objectives: Speak with Enstraa about a better way to remove fiendish leather.
english.description: <While you've become quicker at removing pieces of the hide, there is still much that is spoiled before you're able to remove it.>$b$b<Enstraa might have a better idea of how to remove more of the hide before it becomes tainted.>
english.completion: So you've become faster, but you're still thinking in your old ways.$B$BInstead of cutting away small pieces at a time, try making one large cut and removing as much of the hide in as few cuts as possible. Move away from the corpse and begin cutting the large pieces into smaller, usable pieces.

text.title: 操作顺序
text.objectives: 与恩斯特拉对话，学习更高效的阿古斯野兽解剖法。
text.description: <毛皮的数量充裕多了，但你只来得及收集到少数未被污染的牙齿和爪子。>$b$b<由于不知道该如何提高牙齿和爪子的收集效率，你还需要再找维迪卡尔的恩斯特拉谈一谈。>
text.completion: So it's just more teeth and claws you're after? This should be simple to explain then.$B$BThe teeth receive the greatest exposure to the creature's foul insides, so removing them first will still give you time to dissect the rest of the beast. Next, remove the hide. And lastly the claws, as those take the longest to take on any corruption.

english.title: Order of Operations
english.objectives: Speak with Enstraa about a better way to dissect the beasts of Argus.
english.description: <The skins have been more abundant, but you're only able to gather a couple teeth and claws before they take on the corruption.>$b$b<Unsure as to how to extract as many teeth and claws as possible, you find yourself wanting to have one last conversation with Enstraa back at the Vindicaar.>
english.completion: So it's just more teeth and claws you're after? This should be simple to explain then.$B$BThe teeth receive the greatest exposure to the creature's foul insides, so removing them first will still give you time to dissect the rest of the beast. Next, remove the hide. And lastly the claws, as those take the longest to take on any corruption.

text.title: 重压船锚
text.objectives: 将一箱邪能页岩带给暴风城港口的沃尔科特·桑顿。
text.description: $n，希望你能帮我一个小忙。暴风城港口的海军舰队订购了大量邪能页岩，用于船舰的补给。$b$b我现在正忙着指挥采集工作，而我的信使也都没回来。不知道你是否愿意帮我把这批货送去给他们？$b$b我听说达拉然的灰牙之地里开有通往暴风城的传送门，所以这段路应该不会太漫长什么的。
text.progress: Did Alard send you?
text.completion: Whaddya got for me?$B$BMore felslate, fantastic! This stuff weighs a ton, and is perfect for anchors.$B$BI see you have the arms of a blacksmith. Perhaps you'd like ta have a hand at making a few anchors as well, eh?

english.title: Weigh Anchor
english.objectives: Bring the Crate of Felslate to Walcott Sutton at Stormwind Harbor.
english.description: $n, I was hoping to ask you for a small favor. The naval fleet at Stormwind Harbor have been requesting large amounts of felslate to help construct supplies for their ships.$b$bI'm pretty busy here coordinating the gathering efforts and all my couriers are still out. I was wondering if you wouldn't mind taking that shipment over there to them?$b$bI heard there's a portal to Stormwind in the Greyfang Enclave here in Dalaran so it shouldn't be a long trip or anything.
english.progress: Did Alard send you?
english.completion: Whaddya got for me?$B$BMore felslate, fantastic! This stuff weighs a ton, and is perfect for anchors.$B$BI see you have the arms of a blacksmith. Perhaps you'd like ta have a hand at making a few anchors as well, eh?
