text.title: 天界金之力
text.objectives: 制作一件天界金胸甲。你可以通过阿古斯的矿石开采、与其他玩家交易或从拍卖行得到材料。
text.description: 看来我的护甲似乎引起了你的兴趣。这是由阿古斯最高级的材料：天界金打造的。我其实最擅长制作胸甲。$b$b我可以教你制作，但恐怕你必须自带材料。我们的矿石存量太少，而且不能平白消耗。$b$b但这是所需材料的清单，以便你去收集……
text.progress: I hope those plans weren't too complicated for you to understand.
text.completion: This is quality work. It appears you even solved an issue I was having with the spacing between the front and back chest plates.$B$BYou wouldn't mind if I kept this, would you? A fair trade for the recipe, yes?

english.title: Empyrial Strength
english.objectives: Craft an Empyrial Breastplate. You can find the materials from gathering the ore from Argus, from other players, or from the auction house.
english.description: I see my armor's caught your interest. It's made from the finest material on Argus: empyrium. I actually specialize in crafting breastplates.$b$bI could show you how to craft one, but you'll need to bring your own supplies, I'm afraid. Our stores of the ore are low and we need all that we have.$b$bBut here are the plans so you'll know what you need to find...
english.progress: I hope those plans weren't too complicated for you to understand.
english.completion: This is quality work. It appears you even solved an issue I was having with the spacing between the front and back chest plates.$B$BYou wouldn't mind if I kept this, would you? A fair trade for the recipe, yes?

text.title: 严厉的月亮
text.objectives: 帮助霍巴特在达拉然城内校准原型款减重便鞋。
text.description: 我之前思考着，要如何让大家在阿古尔还是那什么的星球上面自由行动呢？因为我觉得那里的重力应该和我们的不一样。于是我想出了一款装置，可以装在你的鞋子或者蹄子，或者你要在那里穿的其他东西上面。$b$b后来我听说，那个星球的重力……和我们这儿完全一样！$b$b不管如何，我想，我可以先把原型款做出来。你愿意搭把手吗？也许等我们做出来以后，你可以把它卖给孩子们什么的。
text.completion: That last jump looked about what I had in mind for how the gravity was gonna be.$B$B<Hobart scribbles some notes on the schematic.>$B$BAnd there ya have it. They'll only last ya a few minutes before they're spent, so use 'em wisely.

english.title: A Harsh Mistress
english.objectives: Help Hobart calibrate the Prototype Gravitational Reduction Slippers around Dalaran.
english.description: So there I was thinkin' about how to get everyone ready for movin' around Argul or whatever it's called, since I figure its gravity is different than ours, and I come up with a design for a device you slip onto your shoes, or hooves or whatever you're wearin' down there.$b$bNext thing I hear, the gravity on that planet? Completely the same as ours!$b$bRegardless, I figure I could get the prototype workin'. Mind givin' me a hand? Maybe when we're done you can like, sell 'em to kids or somethin'.
english.completion: That last jump looked about what I had in mind for how the gravity was gonna be.$B$B<Hobart scribbles some notes on the schematic.>$B$BAnd there ya have it. They'll only last ya a few minutes before they're spent, so use 'em wisely.

text.title: 外星探索
text.objectives: 在你的地图上标记的位置使用电离地理记录仪。完成后回去找蒂迪。
text.description: $n，我听说你已经去过天上那颗巨大的绿色星球了。据说那里也是恶魔肆虐。$b$b我在想，我们也许可以为它再组装一台虫洞发生器。让那颗星球上的快速移动变得更加容易。$b$b问题是我们必须获得地形的数据。虽然我愿意亲自去，但是，呃……我必须留在这里看店。不能把店铺留给这些蠢货。$b$b拿上这个，去给我记录点数据回来，行不？
text.completion: Oh, this is great stuff. That's some landscape up there! Let me just get this information written down...$B$B<Didi begins to scribble some notes on some blueprint paper.>$B$BThat should do it. As with all generators, you'll need to use local materials for it, so whatever you can find on that planet should work.

english.title: Extraterrestrial Exploration
english.objectives: Use the Ionized Geographical Recorder at the locations marked on your map. Return to Didi when you're finished.
english.description: $n, I hear you've been over to that large green planet in the sky already. Swarming with demons too, I hear.$b$bI was thinking maybe we could put together another wormhole generator for it. Make it easier to zip around the planet.$b$bProblem is we need to get readings on the landscape, and I'd go, but uh... well I need to stay here and run the shop. Can't leave it to these bozos to handle.$b$bHere, take this and get some readings for me, will ya?
english.completion: Oh, this is great stuff. That's some landscape up there! Let me just get this information written down...$B$B<Didi begins to scribble some notes on some blueprint paper.>$B$BThat should do it. As with all generators, you'll need to use local materials for it, so whatever you can find on that planet should work.

text.title: 钳子在呼唤
text.objectives: 去达拉然找钳工蒂迪。
text.description: $n，达拉然的钳工蒂迪正在找你。你最好去看看她近期的成果。据说挺高端的。
text.completion: $n, you came at the perfect time. I just finished creating this Ionized Geographical Recorder.$B$BNow, here's how you're gonna use it...

english.title: The Wrench Calls
english.objectives: Meet with Didi the Wrench in Dalaran.
english.description: $n, Didi the Wrench is looking for you back in Dalaran. You might want to see what she's working on. Pretty fancy stuff from what I heard.
english.completion: $n, you came at the perfect time. I just finished creating this Ionized Geographical Recorder.$B$BNow, here's how you're gonna use it...

text.title: 将我笼罩
text.objectives: 前往阿尔诺花园，找回凯拉的光纹织布机。
text.description: 赶到泽尼达尔的时候，我丢失了一件珍贵的工具，我的光纹织布机。没有它，我为盟友制作强力物品就得耗费更长的时间。$b$b但你很强大，比我强多了。也许你可以帮我个忙。如果你碰巧路过阿尔诺花园，是否可以帮忙找回我的织布机？$b$b届时我将非常乐意与你分享我的光纹布纺织技术。
text.progress: Any luck in finding my loom?
text.completion: You have no idea the time you've just saved me, $n. You have my utmost gratitude.$B$BAnd as promised, here is my most coveted design.

english.title: Looming Over Me
english.objectives: Go to the Arinor Gardens and retrieve Khaela's Lightweave Loom.
english.description: When I rallied to the Xenedar, I left behind a valuable tool. My lightweave loom. Without it, I'm forced to labor for much longer to make garments of power for our allies.$b$bBut you are powerful, much more so than I. Perhaps you could do me a favor. Should you happen to be in the Arinor Gardens, could you retrieve my loom and return it to me?$b$bI'd be more than willing to share my knowledge of sewing lightweave with you.
english.progress: Any luck in finding my loom?
english.completion: You have no idea the time you've just saved me, $n. You have my utmost gratitude.$B$BAnd as promised, here is my most coveted design.

text.title: 绚丽的钥匙
text.objectives: 前往沃雷尔的家，使用从天界金中选矿获得的六种宝石打开他的箱子。找到沃雷尔的珠宝加工书，并带回维迪卡尔交给他。
text.description: $n，听说你是个珠宝匠。我也是个切割大师，但我很怕我的设计会落入军团之手。$b$b我匆忙离开老家，原本还想着回去，但如今恐怕是没这个机会了。你瞧，我将我最珍贵的宝物——一本珠宝加工设计书落在家里了。$b$b但你不一样，你很强大，你可以一路披荆斩棘前往我的老家，找回我的书！$b$b不过我用一个特殊的箱子把它锁起来了，需要用这片大地上的宝石去解锁。每种宝石都需要一颗，才能打开箱子。
text.progress: The combination isn't that difficult, just put the gems in their appropriate settings.
text.completion: My book! And it doesn't appear to be damaged either, thank the Light.$B$BLook here, $n.$B$B$B$BHere are the designs for turning those gems into accessories of power.

english.title: A Colorful Key
english.objectives: Travel to Vorel's home and unlock his chest using each of the six gems that come from prospecting empyrium. Recover his jewelcrafting book and return to him on the Vindicaar.
english.description: $n, I hear you're a jewelcrafter. I too am a master cutter, but I fear my designs will be lost to the Legion.$b$bI hurried out of my home with the intention of returning, but I fear that may not be a possibility. You see, I left my most prized possession, a book of jewelcrafting designs.$b$bBut you, you're strong, you could fight your way into my home and recover my book!$b$bHowever, I locked it away in a special chest that requires the gems of this land to unlock. You'll need one of each to open it.
english.progress: The combination isn't that difficult, just put the gems in their appropriate settings.
english.completion: My book! And it doesn't appear to be damaged either, thank the Light.$B$BLook here, $n.$B$B$B$BHere are the designs for turning those gems into accessories of power.

text.title: 冠冕成就
text.objectives: 为沃雷尔打造一顶天界王冠。你可以通过采集阿古斯的矿石来选矿、与其他玩家交易、或者从拍卖行得到材料。
text.description: 差点永远失去这本书后，我意识到我不该将这些知识保存在一个地方。我愿意将它们传授给你，$n。$b$b我最近的几项设计尤其令我自豪。我将它们称为天界王冠。每顶皇冠都使用不同的宝石组合，从而实现不同的强大效果。$b$b我来教你怎么加工，以及不同的宝石组合如何获得不同的效果。
text.progress: Perhaps in time you too will find a student whom you may pass all your knowledge unto.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. Now, onto the different combinations...

english.title: A Crowning Achievement
english.objectives: Craft an Empyrial Crown for Vorel. You can find the materials from gathering and prospecting the ore from Argus, from other players, or from the auction house.
english.description: With my book nearly being lost forever, it occurs to me that I shouldn't keep all this knowledge in one place. I would like to pass it along to you, $n.$b$bMy most recent designs are ones that I am particularly proud of. I call them Empyrial Crowns. Each one uses a different combination of gems to render different effects of power.$b$bLet me show you how to construct one and then I'll show you how different combinations of gems create different results.
english.progress: Perhaps in time you too will find a student whom you may pass all your knowledge unto.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. Now, onto the different combinations...

text.title: 平衡力
text.objectives: 收集恶魔皮革和光纹布，然后使用恩斯特拉的制革油制作$1oa块净化的恶魔皮革。
text.description: 很久以前，我可以用这片大地上的野兽制作出精美的物品。但后来，燃烧军团的降临灭绝了所有那些神奇的动物。$b$b现在我只能使用它们被污染的皮毛来为盟友制作护甲。但我还是想出了净化污秽的办法。$b$b我们所使用的布料由灌注着圣光能量的线织成。我发明了一种油，搭配布料可以净化皮革，以供使用。$b$b拿上我的油，自己去试试吧。
text.progress: I often dream of working with unsullied leather again. But who knows when that will ever be...
text.completion: An interesting balance, but necessary. You may keep the oil, I have plenty.$B$BOh, and now that you know how to purify the leather, let me show you how to use it. Here are some shoulder patterns my allies ask for regularly.

english.title: Counterbalancing
english.objectives: Gather Fiendish Leather and Lightweave Cloth and use Enstraa's Tanning Oil to create $1oa Purified Fiendish Leather.
english.description: In the past, I was able to make glorious items from the beasts of this land. But then the Legion came and wiped out all those amazing beasts.$b$bNow I'm forced to use their polluted hides to craft armor for my allies. I have, however, found a way to remove their taint.$b$bThe cloth we use is made from special thread infused with Light energy. I devised an oil which when combined with the cloth purifies the leather and makes it usable.$b$bHere, take my oil and see for yourself.
english.progress: I often dream of working with unsullied leather again. But who knows when that will ever be...
english.completion: An interesting balance, but necessary. You may keep the oil, I have plenty.$B$BOh, and now that you know how to purify the leather, let me show you how to use it. Here are some shoulder patterns my allies ask for regularly.

text.title: 飘浮的废墟
text.objectives: 前往玛凯雷。
text.description: 我们本就知道燃烧军团是个可怕的敌人，但最近的事件表明，我们的力量还不够强大，难以支持下去。我们付出了如此巨大的代价，这样的关键时刻已不容失败。$b$b我知道我那古老的家乡玛凯雷有一件圣物，可能就是我们的出路。我们必须让维迪卡尔离开阿古斯星球表面，前往悬浮在上空的废墟。$b$b也许我们能在那里找到我们急需的出路。
text.completion: <Velen's gaze is drawn to the ruins spread out before him.>$B$BI am home.

english.title: A Floating Ruin
english.objectives: Travel to Mac'Aree.
english.description: We knew the Legion to be a formidable foe, but recent events demonstrate that we do not possess the necessary strength to continue. We have come too far to fail at this critical moment.$b$bI know of a relic on Mac'Aree, my ancient home, that may be our salvation. We must take the Vindicaar beyond the surface of Argus, to the floating ruin suspended above us.$b$bPerhaps there we will find the salvation we so desperately need.
english.completion: <Velena's gaze is chained to the ruins that lie before him. >$b$bI'm home.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用导航控制台前往玛凯雷
干扰阿尔诺花园中的军团部队

text.title: 启迪印记
text.objectives: 返回维迪卡尔，放置启迪印记。
text.description: 这件圣物太过强大，不能放在外面。$b$b我们必须立即将其送回维迪卡尔。先知明白该怎么做。$b$b我非常感谢你，$n。没有你的话，这一切都不会成功。夸拉姆绝不会让我靠近印记。也许某天，我可以跟你讲讲那个故事。
text.completion: We are that much closer to restoring the Crown of the Triumvirate to its former glory.

english.title: The Sigil of Awakening
english.objectives: Return to the Vindicaar and secure the Sigil of Awakening.
english.description: This relic is too powerful to keep it out in the open.$b$bWe must return to the Vindicaar at once. The Prophet will know what to do.$b$bI did want to thank you, $n. Without you this would not be possible. Quoram would have ensured I never got near the Sigil. Perhaps some day I will share that story with you.
english.completion: Подумать только, мы уже почти у цели! Скоро мы восстановим корону Триумвирата.

text.title: 灼燃之心
text.objectives: 使用导航控制台前往安托兰废土。
text.description:
泽拉的死是一次沉重的打击，对图拉扬来说尤其如此。但即使是圣光之母也不能强迫我们接受命运。

如果伊利丹换一种方式拒绝她就好了……但我其实也曾经面对过纳鲁强加给我的选择。

我们不能为此而分心，我们的使命还在等待我们。现在圣光军团的生还者加入了我们，我们可以加紧攻击了。

我们要在安托兰废土站稳脚跟，这样才能攻击燃烧王座。时候到了，绝不能让萨格拉斯的邪恶计划成功！
text.completion: I never imagined such destruction... such horror.

english.title: The Burning Heart
english.objectives: Use the Navigation Console to travel to the Antoran Wastes.
english.description:
The loss of Xe'ra is a blow, especially to Turalyon. But even the Light Mother could not be allowed to force destiny upon us.

I wish Illidan had found another way to refuse her... but I too have had choices imposed upon me by the naaru.

This must not distract us from our mission. Now that we have the Army of the Light survivors with us, it is time to press our attack.

We need a foothold on the Antoran Wastes from which we can assault the Burning Throne. It is time to deprive Sargeras of his prize!
english.completion: Я и представить не мог масштабы разрушения... Какая ужасная трагедия...

objectiveDetails.description: 使用导航控制台前往安托兰废土

text.title: 立足之地
text.objectives: 前往安托兰废土，放置光铸道标。
text.description: 我和奥蕾莉亚以前侦察过这片地区，当时身边还有几个精英战士。我们在目前位置的两侧扎下了营地，但我担心他们会受到猛烈攻击，需要援助。$b$b我们的首要任务是在维迪卡尔正下方设置一个传送道标。我们可以从那里前往两个作战前线。$b$b你准备好前往地面的话，就与罗姆尔谈一谈。
text.completion: Good. From here we can quickly access and reinforce each of the encampments.

english.title: Securing a Foothold
english.objectives: Travel to the Antoran Wastes and place the Lightforged Beacon.
english.description: Alleria and I have scouted this area before, alongside some of our best soldiers. We stationed encampments on either side of our current position, but I fear they will have come under heavy attack. They need reinforcements.$b$bOur first order of business is to set up a teleportation beacon directly below the Vindicaar. From there, we will have access to both fronts.$b$bSpeak to Romuul when you are ready to head down to the surface.
english.completion: Хорошо. Отсюда мы сможем оперативно отправлять подкрепление в любой из наших лагерей.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）：与罗姆尔谈一谈，前往地表

text.title: 增援圣光据点
text.objectives: 与圣光据点的奥蕾莉亚谈一谈。
text.description: 既然我们已经站稳脚跟，就可以与战场上的士兵汇合了。$b$b我们在南面有座圣光军团的营地，燃烧军团把他们最强的战士储藏在那附近，并让他们处于某种静滞状态。$b$b奥蕾莉亚去侦察那片区域了。找到她，看看她收集到了什么情报。
text.completion: We have a foothold here... for now.$B$BI am unsure how long it could hold out against a sustained assault.

english.title: Reinforce Light's Purchase
english.objectives: Speak with Alleria at Light's Purchase.
english.description: Now that we have established a foothold, we need to rendezvous with our soldiers in the field.$b$bWe have an Army of the Light encampment to the south, near where the Legion is keeping their strongest warriors in some sort of stasis.$b$bAlleria went to scout the area. Find her, and see what information she has gathered.
english.completion: У нас есть плацдарм. По крайней мере, пока.$b$bНе знаю, долго ли он продержится под атакой.

objectiveDetails.description: 在圣光据点与奥蕾莉亚谈一谈

text.title: 支援隐匿洞穴
text.objectives: 与隐匿洞穴的伊利丹谈一谈。
text.description: 有了你建立的据点，我们就能与战地特工接洽了。$b$b我们上次到这里来执行任务时，在东北方建立了一个堡垒，目前应该还能起到防御的作用，但战场局势瞬息万变。$b$b伊利丹已经过去查看形势了。我建议你也过去，看看他需不需要你帮忙。
text.completion: So many demons. So much work to do.

english.title: Reinforce the Veiled Den
english.objectives: Speak with Illidan at the Veiled Den.
english.description: The foothold you established allows us to check in with our field operatives.$b$bOn our last mission here, we set up a bastion to the northeast. It should be defensible for now, but that could change at any moment.$b$bIllidan has gone ahead to assess the situation. I suggest you go there and see if he needs a hand.
english.completion: Столько демонов. Столько работы.

objectiveDetails.description: 与隐匿洞穴的伊利丹谈一谈。

text.title: 燃烧王座
text.objectives: 在安托兰废土上方使用执政团之冠打开通往安托鲁斯的道路。
text.description: 时机成熟了，$n，可以开始攻打安托鲁斯了。我们多年的奋斗，以及亲友所作出的牺牲，终于让我们走到了今天。$b$b我们会用圣光裁决者轰开这座诅咒堡垒的高墙，踏平他们的权力中心。我们会成为燃烧军团的终结者。$b$b你在这场战争中居功至伟，这份荣耀应该属于你。激活执政团之冠吧，让我们一起完成这份使命。
text.completion: After so many years... so many sacrifices... victory is finally within our grasp.

english.title: The Burning Throne
english.objectives: Use the Crown of the Triumvirate while above the Antoran Wastes to open the way to Antorus.
english.description: The time has come, $n, to begin our assault upon Antorus. Everything we have fought for, everything our friends and family have sacrificed, has brought us to this moment.$b$bWe will fire Light's Judgment upon the walls of the accursed citadel and storm their seat of power. We will end the Legion.$b$bAfter all you have done, it is fitting that you have the honor. Activate the Crown of the Triumvirate and let us finish our mission.
english.completion: After so many years... so many sacrifices... victory is finally within our grasp.

objectiveDetails.description: 在安托兰废土上方激活执政团之冠

text.title: 过去的碎片
text.objectives: 将发光的钥匙碎片交给法瑞娅队长。
text.description:
<你的目光被一块散发着微弱光芒的水晶碎块所吸引。检查碎块后，你发现它的表面上还残留着镌刻的符文。

这块碎片似乎与圣光军团用来为军械供能的阿古尼特水晶类似。这块水晶会不会属于那个很久以前，为逃出阿古斯而战的艾瑞达？

也许法瑞娅队长知道更多关于这块水晶的情况。>
text.completion: <Fareeya examines the crystal fragment.>$B$BThis is old... very old. It is a piece of an elaborate key, the sort my people use to secure our most prized and sacred places.$B$BI wonder...

english.title: Fragment of the Past
english.objectives: Take the Glowing Key Fragment to Captain Fareeya.
english.description:
<Your eye is drawn to the faint glow of the crystalline fragment. Examining the piece, you trace the partial pattern of a rune that had been inscribed upon its surface.

The fragment appears similar to the argunite crystals used by the Army of the Light to power their armaments. Could this crystal have belonged to the eredar who fought to escape Argus so long ago?

Perhaps Captain Fareeya would be able to tell you more about the crystal.>
english.completion:
<Pharia studies the crystal fragment. >

It's old... Very old. It's part of a complex key - one of those that my people lock up everything of great value.

It's interesting...

text.title: 执政团护甲
text.objectives: 获得圣光护甲并将它交给档案员伊欧纳。
text.description:
这把重铸的钥匙可以打开执政团之座里面的军械库。

锁在里面的是执政团护甲。这套护甲是在萨格拉斯毁灭我们的世界之前打造的。绝不能让虚空的势力偷走这套护甲。

拿到护甲后，请交给档案员伊欧纳。他把我们最珍贵的圣物都存放在这条路尽头的洞窟里。他一定会很乐意接受这套护甲。

english.title: Armor of the Triumvirate
english.objectives: Secure the Armor of the Light and bring it to Archivist Ionaa.
english.description:
This reforged key will grant entry into the armory inside the Seat of the Triumvirate.

Locked away inside is the Armor of the Triumvirate, crafted in the days before Sargeras brought ruin to our world. We cannot let this armor be stolen by the Void's forces.

Once the armor is in your possession, please bring it to Archivist Ionaa. He has collected our most sacred relics in the cave just up the path. No doubt he would be very glad to receive it.

objectiveDetails.description: 获得进入军械库的许可

text.title: 重铸能量
text.objectives: 获得大量枝蔓晶簇。
text.description:
我是用太古阿古尼特水晶打造的这把钥匙。不幸的是，现在剩下的水晶都被用在圣光军团的防御工事上了。

唔……枝蔓晶簇大概也能行。玛凯雷的精英经常用它们来给简易的设备供能。如果还可以找到完整的城市废墟，那么我猜那里的堕落法师或破碎者身上可能还带着一些。 

当然，我们需要许多这种晶簇才能重铸钥匙。看来又到你出马的时候了。
text.progress: Were you able to find enough clusters?
text.completion: Ah, yes. Combined, these clusters should provide just enough power for me to fuse the key fragments back together.

english.title: The Power to Reforge
english.objectives: Obtain a stockpile of Dendrite Clusters.
english.description:
I forged the key using a pristine argunite crystal. Unfortunately, the only ones remaining are used by the Army of the Light's defenses.

Hmm... dendrite clusters might be an alternative. They were used by the elite of Mac'Aree to power simple devices. If enough of the city ruins are still intact, I'd wager the fallen magi or the broken may still have some in their possession. 

Of course, I would need a great many clusters to reforge the key. It seems you have your work cut out for you.
english.progress: Удалось найти дендрит?
english.completion: О да. Этого дендрита мне вполне хватит, чтобы восстановить ключ.

text.title: 找回碎片
text.objectives: 从执政团之座周围的虚灵身上找到丢失的钥匙碎片。
text.description:
你找到的只是一块钥匙碎片，恐怕其他碎片落在了你说的那些虚灵生物手上……就是那些“影卫虚灵”。

我们必须把碎片全都找回来。执政团之座内外的影卫虚灵首领和副官手上很可能就有这些碎片。

去把那些钥匙碎片找回来，$n……无论采取什么手段。
text.progress: Did you find all the fragments?
text.completion: Nice work, Huntmaster. Those ethereals stood no chance against you.$B$BNow that we have the fragments, I can prepare them for reforging.

english.title: Recovering the Pieces
english.objectives: Secure the missing key fragments from the ethereals around the Seat of the Triumvirate.
english.description:
The fragment you found is only one part of the key. I fear the other pieces have fallen into the hands of these ethereal beings you speak of... the Shadowguard. 

We must recover them all. The Shadowguard leaders and lieutenants in and around the Seat of the Triumvirate may well have the fragments in their possession.

Get those key fragments, $n... any way you have to.
english.progress: Ты нашла все фрагменты?
english.completion:
Супер, |3-6(Повелительница Пустоты). У этих эфириалов не было против тебя ни единого шанса.

Теперь, когда у нас есть все фрагменты, я могу приступить к делу.

text.title: 恐惧幻象
text.objectives: 与麦格尼一起见证阿古斯的幻象。
text.description:
我做到了，$G小伙子:丫头;。我又联系上他了！ 

哦，但真的好痛苦。好痛苦！他的情况不妙，极其不妙！

你必须和我一起倾听才能明白。
text.completion: The Pantheon has been dead for thousands of years... I fear this plan has been in the works for a very, very long time.

english.title: Visions of Fear
english.objectives: Witness Argus' vision with Magni.
english.description:
I've done it, $Glad:lass;. I've reached him again! 

Oh, but it's so painful. So painful! He's not doin' well, not one bit!

You'll have to listen on in with me to understand.
english.completion: Пантеон мертв много тысяч лет... Боюсь, что этот план разрабатывается уже очень давно...

text.title: 代言人的倾听
text.objectives: 与克罗库营地的麦格尼见面。
text.description:
麦格尼又要你去克罗库营地了。他在尝试联系阿古斯方面似乎取得了新进展。

我建议你立即去见他。他的上一个幻象预言了阿格拉玛的到来，我们对于萨格拉斯的计划还所知甚少。
text.completion: Thank ye fer joinin' me, lad. There's somethin' ye have to see.
text.completed: 与克罗库营地的麦格尼见面。

english.title: The Speaker Listens
english.objectives: Meet Magni in the Krokul Hovel.
english.description:
Magni has sent for you in Krokul Hovel once more. He seems to have made a new breakthrough in trying to reach Argus.

I suggest you find him immediately. His last vision foretold Aggramar's coming, and there is still so much we do not know of Sargeras' plans.
english.completion: Спасибо, что $gпришел, дружище:пришла, подруга;. Тебе непременно нужно это увидеть.
english.completed: Meet Magni in the Krokul Hovel.

objectiveDetails.description: 在克罗库营地与麦格尼见面

text.title: 代言人的寻找
text.objectives: 与克罗库营地的麦格尼见面。
text.description:
我们的部队已经做好战斗准备，但我们依然不知道艾欧娜尔的灵魂在哪里。

你最好立即去见麦格尼，看看我们是否还有机会找到她。如果她已经堕落，那么我们召集再多人手也不可能对抗萨格拉斯。
text.completion: Ye came just in the nick of time.
text.completed: 与克罗库营地的麦格尼见面。

english.title: The Speaker Seeks
english.objectives: Meet Magni in the Krokul Hovel.
english.description:
Our forces are ready for battle, but we still do not know where Eonar's spirit lies.

You should seek Magni out at once and see if you can find her while we still have a chance. If she falls, nothing we muster will be able stand against Sargeras.
english.completion: Ты очень вовремя.
english.completed: Meet Magni in the Krokul Hovel.

objectiveDetails.description: 在克罗库恩与麦格尼见面

text.title: 另一位的幻象
text.objectives: 与麦格尼一起见证阿古斯的幻象。
text.description:
无论现在想要联系我们的人是谁，都有可能带来寻找艾欧娜尔所需的线索。

我们必须立即去看看情况！
text.completion: Our answer lies in the Legion's own portal network in the heart of Antorus.

english.title: Visions of Another
english.objectives: Witness Argus' vision with Magni.
english.description:
Whoever's tryin' to reach us now might give us the information we need to find Eonar.

We need to see what's goin' on right away!
english.completion: Сеть порталов Легиона в сердце Анторуса даст ответы на все наши вопросы.

english.title: Work Order: Tears of the Naaru

text.title: 出问题了
text.objectives: 在奥秘学宫与图拉扬见面。
text.description: 我们遇到一个麻烦，$n。燃烧军团已经来到玛凯雷。$b$b当你拿到启迪印记的时候，就等于向整个阿古斯宣告我们的存在。安托鲁斯的视线已经聚焦到我们身上。$b$b等等。还有更糟的。$b$b维伦带着法瑞娅队长和她的部队进入阿尔诺花园，去寻找知识桂冠。据我所知，他们现在都被困在敌人的兵线后方。$b$b和我一起去奥秘学宫。我们必须把维伦和其他人带回来，否则就迟了。
text.completion: There is no room for error here, $n.

english.title: We Have a Problem
english.objectives: Meet Turalyon at the Conservatory of the Arcane.
english.description: We have a problem, $n. The Legion has come to Mac'Aree.$b$bWhen you claimed the Sigil it was as if we announced our presence to all of Argus. The eyes of Antorus are firmly upon us.$b$bJust wait. It gets worse.$b$bVelen took Captain Fareeya and her forces into the Arinor Gardens area to search for the Crest of Knowledge. To my knowledge, they are all now behind enemy lines.$b$bCome with me to the Conservatory. We need to bring Velen and the others back before it is too late.
english.completion: Сейчас у нас нет права на ошибку, $n.

text.title: 塔尔加斯的部队
text.objectives: 杀死12名塔尔加斯的部队成员。
text.description: 我必须继续寻找知识桂冠，我的朋友。只有完整的执政团之冠才能扭转我们所面临的战争颓势。$b$b塔尔加斯的部队是我们实现目标的阻碍。我需要你去清出一条道路。$b$b我们绝不允许任何人挡在面前。即使是塔尔加斯也不行。
text.completion: <Velen does not seem to notice your presence.>

english.title: Talgath's Forces
english.objectives: Slay 12 of Talgath's forces.
english.description: I must continue to seek the Crest of Knowledge, my friend. Nothing short of the whole Crown of the Triumvirate can turn the tide in the battle we face.$b$bTalgath's forces stand between us and that goal. I will need you to clear a path.$b$bWe can let nothing stand in our way. Not even Talgath.
english.completion: <Velen seems to be missing your presence. >

text.title: 步入夜色
text.objectives: 登上维迪卡尔，前往阿古斯。
text.description:
我们今天所做的一切，都是为了艾泽拉斯。为了死在燃烧军团邪恶远征之下的无数亡魂。

等你准备好以后，我们会将维迪卡尔开进军团的最核心。

阿古斯等待着你。
text.completion: We must act quickly!
text.completed: 与阿古斯的维迪卡尔上的先知维伦谈一谈。

english.title: Into the Night
english.objectives: Travel to Argus aboard the Vindicaar.
english.description:
What we do this day, we do for Azeroth. For the countless souls lost to the Legion's foul crusade.

Once you are ready we will take the Vindicaar into the very heart of the Legion.

Argus awaits.
english.completion: Мы должны действовать быстро!
english.completed: Speak to Prophet Velen aboard the Vindicaar on Argus.

text.title: 堕暗岭遗留物资
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“堕暗岭物资”。
text.description:
我的骑士们有塔布羊，但我的人民需要物资，比如食品、工具和武器。

数千年来，我们不断在一座座简陋的小屋之间辗转，每次被军团发现都要搬迁。我们无法带着财物逃跑，所以只能将它们留在原地。

你很强大，你的追随者也能力非凡，但你并不了解阿古斯。这里的环境会像军团一样无情地杀死你。去堕暗岭找回我们的物资，我会派我的人来指引你的部队穿越阿古斯废土。
text.completion: You have recovered our supplies. As promised, we will aid your forces on Argus.

english.title: Remnants of Darkfall Ridge
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Darkfall Ridge Supplies".
english.description:
My riders have talbuk, but my people need supplies. Food. Tools. Weapons.

For millennia, we have migrated from one hovel to the next, moving each time the Legion discovered us. Never able to flee with our possessions, we left them behind.

You are powerful, your followers are capable, but you do not know Argus. The landscape will dispatch you as mercilessly as the Legion. Recover our supplies from Darkfall Ridge, and I will order my people to guide your forces through the Argus Wastes.
english.completion: Ты вернул наши припасы. Как и было обещано, мы окажем твоим бойцам любую помощь на Аргусе.

text.title: 纳斯拉克斯要塞：准备
text.objectives: 将6名勇士的装备等级提升到900。
text.description:
被带往纳斯拉克斯要塞的克罗库囚犯只有两种命运：接受邪能，自愿成为无穷无尽的燃烧军团的一员；或者变异，成为丑陋的怪物——乌祖尔。

趁着圣光军团吸引了燃烧军团的注意力，我现在有机会拯救我的人民。希望你能帮助我。

在我们出发之前，你的部队必须做好充分准备。
text.progress: Твои воины готовы к предстоящей битве, $n?
text.completion: Soon, the krokul will raid Nath'raxas Hold. My people are anxious to begin.

english.title: Nath'raxas Hold: Preparations
english.objectives: Raise 6 Champions to 900 Item Level.
english.description:
One of two fates await krokul prisoners taken to Nath'raxas Hold. Consume the fel, and become a willing soldier in the infinite army, or be mutated into a disfigured abomination. An ur'zul.

While the Army of the Light occupies the Legion's attention, I am presented with an opportunity to save my people. I ask for your aid.

Before we begin, your forces must be adequately equipped.
english.progress: Твои воины готовы к предстоящей битве, $n?
english.completion: Soon, the krokul will raid Nath'raxas Hold. My people are anxious to begin.

objectiveDetails.description: 将6名追随者的物品等级提升到900

text.title: 纳斯拉克斯要塞：救援任务
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“纳斯拉克斯越狱”。
text.description: 你的部队已经做好了充分准备，足以从纳斯拉克斯手中解救我的人民。派遣你的勇士支援我的突袭，我们将联手打破军团对这片地区的控制。
text.completion: We were a great civilization, once. But, now?... Thank you, $n. Our combined forces freed many from Nath'raxas. With fewer slaves, and the Army of the Light on their doorstep, the Legion's influence over this region will be greatly diminished.

english.title: Nath'raxas Hold: Rescue Mission
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Nath'raxas Breakout".
english.description: Your forces are adequately equipped for the mission to save my people from Nath'raxas. Order your champions to bolster my assault, and together we will dismantle the Legion's stranglehold over the region.
english.completion: We were a great civilization, once. But, now?... Thank you, $n. Our combined forces freed many from Nath'raxas. With fewer slaves, and the Army of the Light on their doorstep, the Legion's influence over this region will be greatly diminished.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成任务”纳斯拉克斯越狱“。

text.title: 奥罗纳尔废墟
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“疯狂边缘”。
text.description:
许多克罗库在下方城市中徘徊，浑身笼罩着暗影。但我相信他们还有救。

阿坎恩曾经是一位领袖。他的一些追随者可能仍然居住在奥罗纳尔的废墟里，在理智和湮灭的边缘挣扎。请你的组织伸出援手，在废墟中搜寻还有救的人。
text.completion: Your champions discovered someone living in a cave beneath Oranaar. He is hiding from the Void-Touched, and he appears lucid.

english.title: The Ruins of Oronaar
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Inches from Madness."
english.description:
Many krokul wander the city below, shrouded in shadow. I will not accept that they are all beyond redemption.

Arkhaan was a leader, once. Some among his followers may still reside in the ruins of Oranaar, straddling the thin divide between reason and oblivion. Enlist the aid of your order. Scour the ruins for any that can be saved.
english.completion: Your champions discovered someone living in a cave beneath Oranaar. He is hiding from the Void-Touched, and he appears lucid.

text.title: 古代艾瑞达圣物
text.objectives: 将6名勇士的装备等级提升到925。
text.description:
我曾令阿坎恩失望。我不会再重蹈覆辙。 

只要将虚灵赶出玛凯雷，就有希望解放克罗库。鲁拉已被击败，但虚空依然在影卫入侵营地附近弥漫。

我们出发之前，请确保你的部队不会受到暗影的伤害。你的勇士最好去附近的废墟里寻找一些远古艾瑞达军械。
text.completion: The voidcallers roaming the Shadowguard Incursion must be extinguished. Your people are sufficiently armed for the coming encounter.

english.title: Relics of the Ancient Eredar
english.objectives: Raise 6 Champions to 925 Item Level.
english.description:
I failed Arkhaan. I won't fail again. 

If there is to be any hope of freeing the krokul, the ethereal threat must be removed from Mac'Aree. L'ura has been vanquished, but the void clings heavily near the Shadowguard Incursion.

Before we commence, ensure your forces are protected from the shadow. Your champions should seek ancient eredar armaments in the nearby ruins.
english.completion: The voidcallers roaming the Shadowguard Incursion must be extinguished. Your people are sufficiently armed for the coming encounter.

objectiveDetails.description: 将6名追随者的物品等级提升到925

text.title: 驱赶影卫
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“驱赶影卫”。
text.description: 希望你们的组织再次助我一臂之力，这样我们也许有机会彻底终结影卫的威胁。当你们迎战军团时，我们将与虚空对抗。等你的部队抵达后就开始进攻。
text.completion: With L'ura defeated, and the voidcallers eliminated, the Shadowguard's dominance over the city has been crippled. if our campaign against the Legion is successful, there could be a future for the creatures living here.

english.title: Shadowguard Dispersion
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Shadowguard Dispersion".
english.description: Lend me the aid of your order once again, that we might end the Shadowguard threat permanently. While you confront the Legion, we will face the void. The attack commences once your forces arrive.
english.completion: With L'ura defeated, and the voidcallers eliminated, the Shadowguard's dominance over the city has been crippled. if our campaign against the Legion is successful, there could be a future for the creatures living here.

text.title: 阻截军团的战争机器
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“废土行动”。
text.description:
$ct，我需要你的帮助。圣光军团正在策划一场针对炼魂熔炉、终端船坞和塑造者高台的袭击，以削弱军团在安托兰废土以外发动战争的能力。但我们的士兵数量不足以在守卫据点的同时执行这项计划。

你是否可以代表我们去联系$cs？如果他们与我们并肩作战，这个计划就能够成功。我们也就能令燃烧军团的战争机器瘫痪。
text.completion: Three Legion facilities decimated in a single operation. Extraordinary.

english.title: Hindering the Legion War Machine
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Gambit in the Wastes."
english.description:
$ct, I could use your help. The Army of the Light is coordinating an attack against the Spirit Crucible, Terminus, and Shaper's Rise to cripple the Legion's ability to wage war outside of the Antoran Wastes. We do not have enough soldiers to defend our footholds and execute this operation.

Will you approach the $cs on our behalf? This gambit could succeed with them fighting by our side. We can paralyze the Legion war machine.
english.completion: Three Legion facilities decimated in a single operation. Extraordinary.

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: 在石化森林杀死$1oa名艾瑞达仪祭师和莎拉扎德夫人。
text.description: 你可能已经看到了，这座森林里的仪祭师绑架了我们的人民，并用他们施展可怕的仪式。死者们的灵魂如今化为扭曲的怪物，四处徘徊。他们的罪恶必须得到严惩。尽可能多杀几个仪祭师，但一定要击杀领导他们的黑暗恶魔。
text.completion: You've been a great asset to my wranglers here. Please take this as a token of our gratitude.

english.title: Strike Back
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Eredar ritualists and Lady Shahrazad in the Petrified Forest.
english.description: As you may have seen, the ritualists in this forest kidnap our people and perform heinous rituals on them. The souls of our fallen now roam as twisted creatures. This sin cannot go unpunished. Kill as many ritualists as you are able, but be sure to strike at the dark demon that leads them.
english.completion: Твоя помощь для нас просто неоценима. Прими это в знак благодарности.

text.title: 暮影豹问题
text.objectives: 在石化森林里击杀$1oa头影豹。
text.description:
这座森林里依然游荡着塔布羊和影豹。但平衡已被打破，如今影豹几乎要将塔布羊捕食殆尽。为保障它们的存活，我们必须削减影豹的数量。

不要让它们痛苦太久。干脆的死亡就是最大的仁慈。
text.completion: Keeping balance within the forest ensures its longevity.

english.title: Duskcloak Problem
english.objectives: Kill $1oa panthara within the Petrified Forest.
english.description:
Here in this forest, species of talbuk and panthara still roam. However, the balance has been disrupted and now the panthara risk hunting the talbuk to extinction. To ensure their survival, we must decrease the number of panthara.

Do not let their suffering linger. A swift death is the most merciful.
english.completion: Мы поддерживаем в лесу равновесие и тем самым продлеваем дни его благоденствия.

text.title: 骑兵
text.objectives: 与石化森林的首席骑兵贾伊德对话。
text.description:
阿古斯有许多邪恶的存在，而我们的森林里就住着其中最可怕的几个。我的骑兵们正在森林边缘等待增援。也就是在等你。

找到首席骑兵贾伊德，他会详细说明。
text.completion: I fear the forest may be lost.

english.title: The Wranglers
english.objectives: Speak to Lead Rider Jerek in the Petrified Forest.
english.description:
Great evil exists on Argus and our forests house some of the worst of it. My wranglers are at the edge of the forest and are waiting for reinforcements. That would be you.

Seek out Lead Rider Jerek, he will tell you more.
english.completion: I'm afraid this forest can no longer be saved.

text.title: 出其不意
text.objectives: 进入一个侵入点，击败一个军团指挥官。
text.description:
军团的狂热远征导致他们兵力分散。趁着他们将重心放在阿古斯的防御上，我们可以前往其他世界削弱他们的兵力。

穿过阿古斯上的一个侵入点，让军团知道他们已经在劫难逃。
text.completion: So many Legion worlds are ripe for the taking...

english.title: Where They Least Expect It
english.objectives: Enter an Invasion Point and defeat a Legion Commander.
english.description:
The Legion's fanatical crusade leaves them spread thin. As they focus their defenses on Argus, we are free to tear into their forces on other worlds.

Travel through an Invasion Point on Argus and show the Legion that there is no hiding from death.
english.completion: Столько миров Легиона только и ждут, чтобы их захватили...

text.title: 陌生人的请求
text.objectives: 治疗$1oa名邪缚苦工。
text.description:
我的人民……被奴役……

被折磨……命悬一线……

<戴着兜帽的人虚弱地抬起双臂,向你递来一份药膏。>

帮帮……我们……
text.completion: A cowled figure... and it did not attack you?$B$BMost curious.
text.completed: 与毁灭之冠的先知维伦见面。

english.title: A Stranger's Plea
english.objectives: Heal $1oa Felbound Drudges.
english.description:
My people... enslaved...

Beaten... within death's grasp...

<The cowled figure weakly raises his arm, handing you a small liquid skin.>

Help... us...
english.completion: Незнакомец в капюшоне, говоришь? И он не пытался напасть на тебя?$B$BЛюбопытно.
english.completed: Meet Prophet Velen at the Crown of Destruction.

text.title: 片刻喘息
text.objectives: 与维迪卡尔上的技师席拉娜、塞布斯·锥点和高阶女祭司伊莎娜对话。
text.description:
我们经历了这么多，必须谨记，绝不能沉湎于过去，而是要向前看，为未来做好准备。

你也趁此机会熟悉一下维迪卡尔。
text.progress: May the Light illuminate your path.
text.completion: Are you ready to continue on our journey?

english.title: A Moment of Respite
english.objectives: Speak with Artificer Shela'na, Thelbus Wimblenod and High Priestess Ishanah.
english.description:
For all we have seen, we must remember not to dwell on the past, but to look forward and prepare for what is to come.

Take this opportunity to familiarize yourself with the Vindicaar.
english.progress: May the Light illuminate your path.
english.completion: $gReady:Ready; ready to go?

objectiveDetails.description: 与高阶女祭司伊莎娜谈一谈

text.title: 命运之手
text.objectives: 在暴风城港口与前往埃索达的护送者见面。
text.description:
自从燃烧军团入侵埃索达以来，德莱尼人一直在努力，时刻准备返回阿古斯。终于，他们打造出了一艘能够带我们前往那里的飞船。

通往那个可怕世界的通道已经打开，这是我们最好的反攻机会。先知维伦特别要求你加入突击队。

你最好立刻赶去暴风城港口。我们已经安排好船只带你前往秘蓝岛。
text.completion: I'm glad you were among those called for the expedition to Argus. There will be plenty of fighting ahead.

english.title: The Hand of Fate
english.objectives: Meet your escort to the Exodar at Stormwind Harbor.
english.description:
Ever since the Legion invaded the Exodar, the draenei have been hard at work preparing to return to Argus. At long last they have a vessel that can take us there.

With the way to that dreadful world open, we simply could not ask for a better opportunity to strike. Prophet Velen called for you quite specifically to join the assault force.

You should make your way to Stormwind Harbor right away. Arrangements have been made for a ship there to take you to Azuremyst.
english.completion: I'm glad you were among those called for the expedition to Argus. There will be plenty of fighting ahead.

objectiveDetails.description: 在暴风城港口与护送者见面
（可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往暴风城

text.title: 命运之手
text.objectives: 在刃拳海湾与前往埃索达的护送者见面。
text.description:
自从燃烧军团入侵埃索达以来，德莱尼人一直在努力，时刻准备返回阿古斯。终于，他们打造出了一艘能够带我们前往那里的飞船。

通往那个可怕世界的通道已经打开，这是我们最好的反攻机会。先知维伦特别要求你加入突击队。

你最好立刻赶去刃拳海湾。我们已经安排好船只带你前往秘蓝岛。
text.completion: I knew you would be among those called to fight. It will be an honor to fight by your side.

english.title: The Hand of Fate
english.objectives: Meet your escort to the Exodar at Bladefist Bay.
english.description:
Ever since the Legion invaded the Exodar, the draenei have been hard at work preparing to return to Argus. At long last they have a vessel that can take us there.

With the way to that dreadful world open, we simply could not ask for a better opportunity to strike. Prophet Velen called for you quite specifically to join the assault force.

You should make your way to Bladefist Bay right away. Arrangements have been made for a ship there to take you to Azuremyst.
english.completion: I knew you would be among those called to fight. It will be an honor to fight by your side.

objectiveDetails.description: 在刃拳海湾与护送者见面
（可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往奥格瑞玛

text.title: 攻击侵入点
text.objectives: 完成3个侵入点。
text.description: 侵入点是切断燃烧军团往阿古斯运送援军的关键。击败次级传送门里的军团部队能够让我们袭击更加大型的侵入点，并消灭那里的军团部队。
text.completion: The Legion's defeat is at hand.

english.title: Invasion Point Offensive
english.objectives: Complete 3 Invasion Points.
english.description: The invasion points are key to cutting off Legion reinforcements to Argus. Defeating their armies within the lesser portals will allow us to assault larger invasion points and extinguish the Legion presence within.
english.completion: Наша победа над Легионом уже близка.

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: 在石化森林击杀$1oa名艾瑞达仪祭师和莎拉扎德夫人。
text.description: 这张卷轴详细记述了一个黑暗法术，可以窃取附近克罗库的灵魂，用以制造新的恶魔：乌祖尔。卷轴上有莎拉扎德夫人的签名。
text.completion: You've been a great asset to my wranglers here. Please take this as a token of our gratitude.

english.title: Strike Back
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Eredar ritualists and Lady Shahrazad in the Petrified Forest.
english.description: The scroll details a dark spell which steals the souls from the neighboring Krokul to create a new demon, the Ur'zul. The scroll is signed by Lady Shahrazad.
english.completion: You've been a great asset to my wranglers here. Please take this as a token of our gratitude.

text.title: 哇，真快！
text.objectives: 向克罗库营地的酋长哈顿复命。
text.description:
$n，非常感谢。接下来就交给我的驯兽师吧。不知你是否还能帮我一个小忙，给酋长哈顿带条口信？告诉他森林再次安全了。我相信他肯定会感谢你的辛勤付出。

我会把我们最快的岩羊借给你赶路。穿过森林外的小路时记得两边看看，那边有巨大的军团歼灭者在巡逻。祝你好运！
text.completion: The Wranglers are essential for our survival here. Any assistance you have given them must be repaid.

english.title: Woah, Nelly!
english.objectives: Return to Chieftain Hatuun in Krokul Hovel.
english.description:
$n, you have my thanks. My Wranglers should be able to take it from here. If I can ask one more favor, would you pass a message to Chieftain Hatuun? Tell him the forest is secure once again. I'm sure he will reward you for all of your effort.

I'll loan you one of my fastest Cragscalers for the trip. Make sure to look both ways before crossing that path outside this forest, there's a giant Legion Obliterator that patrols there. Good luck!
english.completion: We can't survive here at all without shepherds. So your help won't be without a reward.

text.title: 圣光的礼物
text.objectives: 将圣光精华融入虚空之光熔炉。
text.description:
我感觉到了，这就是泽拉的崇高心灵。她对燃烧军团坚持不懈的抵抗。就让这成为她留给人们的财富吧。

建造维迪卡尔时，我们修筑了虚空之光熔炉，以驾驭弥漫在阿古斯强大的能量。我相信泽拉的精华是我们达到这一目标的关键之一。

但是光有圣光还不够。没有平衡，就没有和谐，也没有力量的聚集。

把这个精华放进熔炉吧，勇士。要想获得终结燃烧的远征的力量，这是第一步。
text.completion: An important first step, $n.$B$BIf we can bring balance to the Netherlight Crucible, I believe it will make your weapon even more powerful.

english.title: An Offering of Light
english.objectives: Infuse the Essence of Light into the Netherlight Crucible.
english.description:
I sense it. The nobility in Xe'ra's heart. Her relentless defiance of the Legion. Let this be her legacy.

In building the Vindicaar, we fashioned the Netherlight Crucible to harness the tremendous powers at play on Argus. I believe Xe'ra's essence is one key to that potential.

Yet the Light alone is not enough. Without balance, there can be no harmony, no cohesion.

Infuse this essence into the crucible, champion. It is the first step in unlocking the strength needed to end the Burning Crusade.
english.completion: Это первый и очень важный шаг, $n.$b$bЕсли уравновесить энергии в тигле света Пустоты, мы сможем еще больше усилить твое оружие.

objectiveDetails.description: 将圣光精华注入虚空之光熔炉

text.title: 暗影的礼物
text.objectives: 将暗影精华灌注进虚空之光熔炉。
text.description:
你感觉到了吗，$n？这精华中的黑暗之力非常明显。

如果是在过去，我可能会对这种力量退避三舍，甚至否定它的存在。但如果说我们在漫长的斗争中学到了什么的话，那就是光与影必须共存。

这可能就是我们需要的东西，有了它，虚空之光熔炉就能获得平衡。我们就能在对抗军团的战斗中获得优势。

把这份精华灌注进熔炉吧，勇士。这样一来，距离发掘你武器的全部潜能就又近了一步。
text.completion: Ah, yes. Balance is key, just as the Prophet said.

english.title: An Offering of Shadow
english.objectives: Infuse the Essence of Shadow into the Netherlight Crucible.
english.description:
Can you sense it, $n? The darkness within this essence is palpable.

In the past, I might have shunned such power, even denied its very existence. But what have we learned throughout our long struggle, if not that Light and shadow must coexist?

This may prove to be exactly what we need to bring balance to the Netherlight Crucible. To give us the edge we need against the Legion.

Infuse this essence into the crucible, champion. Draw one step closer to realizing your weapon's full potential.
english.completion: О да! Равновесие – ключ ко всему, как не раз говорил Пророк.

objectiveDetails.description: 将暗影精华注入虚空之光熔炉
获得光铸战争机甲的控制权

text.title: 挫其锐气
text.objectives: 将6名勇士的装备等级提升到950。
text.description:
从安托鲁斯涌出的恶魔都在邪火军械库领取装备。我们必须摧毁那些武器。你的$cs是否会再次与圣光军团并肩作战？

在发动攻击前，先收集材料。我的铁匠会为你的士兵制造更为强大的护甲。军团不可能束手就擒，乖乖交出邪火军械库。
text.completion: One step closer to defeating the Legion.

english.title: Take the Edge Off
english.objectives: Raise 6 Champions to 950 Item Level.
english.description:
The demons streaming out of Antorus equip themselves at Felfire Armory. We need to deny those weapons. Will your $cs fight alongside the Army of the Light once again?

Before the assault, gather materials. My smiths will craft your soldiers more powerful armor. The Legion won't give up Felfire without a fight.
english.completion: One step closer to defeating the Legion.

objectiveDetails.description: 将6名追随者的物品等级提升到950

text.title: 粉碎邪火
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“突袭邪火军械库”。
text.description:
恶魔小径上有几座单薄的石桥，连接起燃烧裂口与邪火军械库。你的部队进攻军械库本体的时候，圣光军团会阻挡住军团的援军。

动作一定要快。
text.completion: There's nothing more beautiful than a lightburst charge erupting in a Legion stronghold. Your people afforded themselves well.

english.title: Felfire Shattering
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Assault on Felfire Armory."
english.description:
A thin series of stone bridges connects the Burning Breach to Felfire Armory over Fiend's Run. The Army of the Light will stem Legion reinforcements while your people deal with the armory itself.

Work swiftly.
english.completion: There's nothing more beautiful than a lightburst charge erupting in a Legion stronghold. Your people afforded themselves well.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成任务“突袭邪火军械库”

text.title: 指挥官之陨
text.objectives: 完成一个大型侵入点场景战役。
text.description: 燃烧军团的勇士在侵入点里会变得不堪一击！把它找出来干掉，别让它回到阿古斯战斗。
text.completion: Their commanders fall before us!

english.title: Commander's Downfall
english.objectives: Complete a Greater Invasion Point scenario.
english.description: A champion of the Legion is vulnerable within an invasion point! Track it down and destroy it before it can return to fight on Argus.
english.completion: Мы сразили их командира!

text.title: 深入补给克罗库恩
text.objectives: 收集$1oa点职业大厅资源。
text.description:
这个地方过于贫瘠，几乎没有什么产出。我的人民时刻都在温饱线上挣扎。如果我有更多补给，就可以再给你一个山岭猎手。

外乡人，你意下如何？
text.progress: You seek the aid of another ridgestalker?
text.completion: You must value our aid greatly, to part with such a bounty.

english.title: Further Supplying Krokuun
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Order Hall Resources.
english.description:
This desolate place offers little for my people. Every hour is spent scraping together enough to survive. If I had more supplies, I could offer you another ridgestalker.

What say you, offworlder?
english.progress: Тебе нужна помощь еще одного горного охотника?
english.completion: You must value our aid greatly, to part with such a bounty.

text.title: 更多虚空接种
text.objectives: 收集100块浓缩的虚空碎片。
text.description:
所有被暗影触摸过的东西都会在被击败后留下虚空的痕迹，如果你能在城市中收集到足够的虚空物质，就回来找我。我可以把它们提纯。 

我们可以拯救更多族人。
text.progress: Many of my brethren are deeply touched by shadow. It will take a tremendous effort to free them. Will you help?
text.completion: I am humbled by your generosity.

english.title: More Void Inoculation
english.objectives: Collect 100 Fragments of Condensed Void.
english.description:
All entities touched by shadow leave behind traces of void when they are defeated, If you collect enough in your travels through the city, return to me, and I will distill it into its undiluted form. 

We can save more of my kin.
english.progress: Многих моих собратьев Тьма изменила до неузнаваемости. Их освобождение будет стоить немалых трудов. Ты поможешь?
english.completion: I am humbled by your generosity.

text.title: 扶助安托兰战役
text.objectives: 完成10个侵入点。
text.description: 军团需要从他们征服的世界中收集原料，为远征提供物资。穿过军团传送门，消灭你遇到的恶魔，不让他们获取维持战争机器所需的资源。
text.progress: War is costly work. Have you gathered additional supplies for our efforts here?
text.completion: Another lightforged to fight alongside your forces.

english.title: Fueling the Antoran Campaign
english.objectives: Complete 10 Invasion Points.
english.description: The Legion requires raw materials from conquered words to fuel their crusade. Travel through Legion portals, destroy demons you encounter, and deny them the resources required to maintain their war machine.
english.progress: War requires considerable expenses. Did you manage to collect additional supplies for our troops?
english.completion: Another lightforged to fight alongside your forces.

text.title: 圣光军团
text.objectives: 在阿古斯完成4个圣光军团世界任务。
text.description: 完成4个世界任务，协助圣光军团。
text.completion: The Army of the Light thanks you.
text.completed: 返回阿古斯的维迪卡尔，与守备官嘉兰娜谈一谈。

english.title: Army of the Light
english.objectives: Complete 4 Army of the Light world quests on Argus.
english.description: Assist the Army of the Light by completing 4 world quests.
english.completion: The Army of the Light thanks you.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Jaelaana at the Vindicaar on Argus.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成4个圣光军团世界任务

text.title: 抗魔联军
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩完成任意4个世界任务。
text.description: 完成4个世界任务，协助抗魔联军。
text.completion: The Armies of Legionfall thank you, mate.
text.completed: 返回破碎海滩，去找指挥官钱伯斯。

english.title: Armies of Legionfall
english.objectives: Complete any 4 world quests on the Broken Shore.
english.description: Assist the Armies of Legionfall by completing 4 world quests.
english.completion: The Armies of Legionfall thank you, mate.
english.completed: Return to Commander Chambers on the Broken Shore.

objectiveDetails.description: 在破碎海滩完成4个世界任务

text.title: 阿古斯防卫军
text.objectives: 在阿古斯完成任意4个阿古斯防卫军世界任务。
text.description: 完成4个世界任务，协助阿古斯防卫军。
text.completion: The Argussian Reach thank you.
text.completed: 向维迪卡尔的可敬的托兰复命。

english.title: Argussian Reach
english.objectives: Complete any 4 Argussian Reach world quests on Argus.
english.description: Assist the Argussian Reach by completing 4 world quests.
english.completion: The Argussian Reach thank you.
english.completed: Return to Toraan the Revered at the Vindicaar on Argus.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成4个阿古斯防卫军世界任务

text.title: 奥罗纳尔之下
text.objectives: 与奥罗纳尔下方的克罗库谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在奥罗纳尔下方找到的克罗库不愿意离开。$n，你能和他谈谈吗？说服他登上维迪卡尔。
text.completion: I told the others; I will not abandon my people. I must remain here, but maybe you can help? I have discovered a way to purge the shadow from the void-addled.

english.title: Beneath Oronaar
english.objectives: Speak with the krokul beneath Oranaar.
english.description: The krokul we found beneath Oranaar did not wish to leave. Could you speak with him, $n? Convince him to board the Vindicaar.
english.completion: I told the others; I will not abandon my people. I must remain here, but maybe you can help? I have discovered a way to purge the shadow from the void-addled.

objectiveDetails.description: 替换军团反舰弹的引线

text.title: 光铸道标：城市中心
text.objectives: 激活维迪卡尔道标。
text.description: 你好，朋友！$b$b法瑞娅队长派我们先行清理这片地区。我们刚准备放置道标，并向维迪卡尔汇报。$b$b如果你能帮助我们完成任务，我们将不胜荣幸。$b$b信号道标只需要轻轻一点就可以了。大技师会接手余下的工作。
text.completion: This beacon will be added to the Navigation Console.$B$BA contingent of the Army of the Light will remain to hold this location for future use.

english.title: Lightforged Beacon: City Center
english.objectives: Activate the Vindicaar Beacon.
english.description: Hail, friend!$b$bCaptain Fareeya sent us ahead to secure this area. We were just about to call down a beacon and report back to the Vindicaar.$b$bWe would be honored if you would help us complete our mission.$b$bThe signal beacon just needs a light touch. The Grand Artificer will do the rest.
english.completion: This beacon will be added to the Navigation Console.$B$BA contingent of the Army of the Light will remain to hold this location for future use.

objectiveDetails.description: 驾驶战争机甲飞入安托鲁斯

text.title: 废墟世界的燃料
text.objectives: 从阿古斯的侵入点、稀有怪物或宝藏处收集$1oa颗太古阿古尼特水晶。
text.description: 这片废土上有一种珍贵的资源，$n。$b$b阿古尼特水晶曾经在阿古斯随处可见。它的神奇特性帮助艾瑞达文明走向了繁荣。比起留给军团，还是让我们自己来好好使用这些水晶吧。$b$b请尽力寻找太古阿古尼特水晶，勇士。你找到的每一颗水晶都会对我们的事业有所帮助。
text.progress: Victory requires every resource we can muster.
text.completion: A good start, hero. There is plenty more where that came from.

english.title: Fuel of a Doomed World
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Pristine Argunite from Invasion Points, Rare encounters, or treasure chests on Argus.
english.description: There is a rare and precious resource to be found in these wastes, $n.$b$bArgunite was once abundant on Argus. Its magical properties helped eredar civilization thrive. Far better for us to make use of its power than the Legion.$b$bSeek out all the pristine argunite you can, champion. Every bit you recover will aid our cause.
english.progress: We'll need all the resources to win.
english.completion: Хорошее начало, $gгерой:воительница;. Наверняка там его много.

text.title: 铸造通往过去的钥匙
text.objectives: 旁观盖尔重铸军械库钥匙。
text.description: 军械库的钥匙碎片已经集齐，枝蔓晶簇也可以提供足够的能量来重铸钥匙。$b$b这应该不会花多久的时间……应该会成功的。我已经很久没有做过这种东西了！
text.completion: Success! It is nice to know I haven't lost my touch.$B$BHere you go, $n; it is as good as new.

english.title: Forging a Key to the Past
english.objectives: Watch as Gaal reforges the Armory Key.
english.description: The armory key fragments are gathered, and the dendrite clusters should provide just enough power to reforge the key.$b$bThis should not take long... assuming it works. It has been a long time since I made one of these!
english.completion:
Получилось! Руки-то – они помнят!

Держи, $n. Как новенький.

text.title: 破碎者铁匠
text.objectives: 找到铁匠盖尔。
text.description:
$C，这可能是执政团军械库的钥匙碎片。我们在逃离阿古斯时把它锁上了。我最后一次见到这把钥匙时，我的副官阿塔拉还带领着一支部队守护军械库呢。那都是好久之前了……

我虽然不确定，但还有一个人或许也知道这件事。铸造这把钥匙的工匠叫做盖尔。听说克罗库恩还有幸存的破碎者，说不定他也在其中。
text.completion: I am glad to hear Fareeya is well.$B$BShe is right... this is a fragment of the armory key I forged her so long ago.

english.title: The Broken Blacksmith
english.objectives: Find the blacksmith Gaal.
english.description:
$C, I believe this may be a piece of the key to the Armory of the Triumvirate. We locked it behind us as we made our escape from Argus. The last time I saw it, my second in command, Atalaa, was leading a force to secure the armory. That was so long ago...

I cannot be certain, but there may be another who would know. The smith who forged the key was called Gaal. With the reports of broken surviving on Krokuun, he may still live.
english.completion:
Рад, что у Фарии все хорошо.

Совершенно верно... Это фрагмент ключа от арсенала, который я выковал для нее в ту давнюю пору.

text.title: 补给克罗库恩
text.objectives: 收集$1oa点职业大厅资源。
text.description:
这个地方过于贫瘠，几乎没有什么产出。我的人民时刻都在温饱线上挣扎。如果我有更多补给，就可以再给你一个山岭猎手。

外乡人，你意下如何？
text.progress: This desolate place offers little for my people. Every hour is spent scraping together enough to survive. If I had more resources, I could offer you a ridgestalker.$B$BI can only part with a Krokul-Ridgestalker for this few resources once per week. Next week, I will offer you this trade again.
text.completion: What say you, offworlder?

english.title: Supplying Krokuun
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Order Hall Resources.
english.description:
This desolate place offers little for my people. Every hour is spent scraping together enough to survive. If I had more supplies, I could offer you another ridgestalker.

What say you, offworlder?
english.progress:
In this devastated land we do not live, but barely survive. All my free time is spent in search of poor food. If we had more resources, I could give you a mountain hunter to help you.

For such a small amount of resources, I can only let a mountain hunter go to you once a week. Come back next week and I can let go of another one.
english.completion: What say you, offworlder?

text.title: 虚空接种
text.objectives: 收集100块浓缩的虚空碎片。
text.description:
所有被暗影触摸过的东西都会在被击败后留下虚空的痕迹，如果你能在城市中收集到足够的虚空物质，就回来找我。我可以把它们提纯。 

我们可以拯救更多族人。
text.progress: If you bring the necessary supplies, I can begin the distillation process, $n.$B$BI can only free one of the Void-Touched with this few resources once per week.
text.completion: Another soul freed from the cruelty of the void.

english.title: Void Inoculation
english.objectives: Collect 100 Fragments of Condensed Void.
english.description:
All entities touched by shadow leave behind traces of void when they are defeated, If you collect enough in your travels through the city, return to me, and I will distill it into its undiluted form. 

We can save more of my kin.
english.progress:
Когда принесешь все необходимое, я смогу начать дистилляцию, $n.

С таким небольшим количеством ресурсов я могу освободить только одного отмеченного Бездной в неделю.
english.completion: Another soul freed from the cruelty of the void.

text.title: 支援安托兰战役
text.objectives: 完成10个侵入点。
text.description: 军团需要从他们征服的世界中收集原料，为远征提供物资。穿过军团传送门，消灭你遇到的恶魔，不让他们获取维持战争机器所需的资源。
text.progress: The campaign against the Legion has taxed our existing resources heavily. Bring me supplies and I will place a lightforged under your command.$B$BI can only spare a lightforged for this few resources once per week.
text.completion: A lightforged soldier can wade through a sea of demons. They will serve you well.

english.title: Supplying the Antoran Campaign
english.objectives: Complete 10 Invasion Points.
english.description: The Legion requires raw materials from conquered words to fuel their crusade. Travel through Legion portals, destroy demons you encounter, and deny them the resources required to maintain their war machine.
english.progress:
The campaign against the Legion requires more resources. If you bring me supplies, I will single out one illumined under your command.

In exchange for such a quantity of supplies, I can let you illumined once a week.
english.completion: A lightforged soldier can wade through a sea of demons. They will serve you well.

text.title: 估量对手
text.objectives: 与图拉扬谈一谈。
text.description:
如果你的大主教得知我们没有足够的资源来突袭安托鲁斯的话，一定会很焦躁的。他引以为傲的圣光军团居然会战力不足，这对他来说恐怕很难接受。

但他的自尊心与我无关。在他策划下一步行动的同时，我会用恶魔的鲜血来洗刷这片土地。

去吧。要获得最终的胜利，我们还有很多事情要做。
text.completion: <Turalyon listens in grim silence.>

english.title: Sizing Up The Opposition
english.objectives: Speak with Turalyon.
english.description:
No doubt your High Exarch will fret at the news that we lack the resources to assault Antorus. He is not used to believing his vaunted Army of the Light to be inadequate.

His pride is no concern of mine. While he plots a new strategy, I will bathe the ground in demon blood.

Go. There is much to be done before we can achieve our final victory.
english.completion: <Turalyon listens in grim silence.>

text.title: 制造虚无行者的传送门发生器
执政团之座：黑暗召唤者
泰坦之血
text.objectives: 把寂灭者阿古斯的血交给达拉然的卡德加。
text.description:
<就在你眼皮底下，一滴血从死去的泰坦阿古斯身上流了下来，凝结成了一颗完美无瑕的宝石。你把它握在掌心，感觉到里面散发出深不可测的力量……以及久久不息的痛苦和悲伤。

这是这场本来毫无胜算的战斗的最后残留，是根本不可能完成的成就。而且，就跟所有胜利一样，它也伴随着惨痛的代价。

你立刻意识到应该把这份战利品交给谁。>
text.completion: Champion, you have returned... and not a moment too soon.$B$BThe object you hold in your hands is but one of many mysteries unfolding before us.

english.title: Blood of a Titan
english.objectives: Bring the blood of Argus the Unmaker to Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description:
<Before your eyes, a trickle of blood from the fallen titan Argus congeals into a flawless gemstone. Holding it in your palm, you sense an almost unfathomable power emanating from within... along with echoes of pain and sorrow.

It is the last remnant of a battle that should not have been winnable. An impossible achievement. Yet, as with all victories, this one came at tremendous cost.

You realize immediately to whom you must convey this prize.>
english.completion: Champion, you have returned... and not a moment too soon.$B$BThe object you hold in your hands is but one of many mysteries unfolding before us.

text.title: Seat of the Triumvirate: Dark Fissures

english.title: Seat of the Triumvirate: Dark Fissures

text.title: 阿古斯防卫军的典范
text.objectives: 与维迪卡尔的可敬的托兰谈一谈。
text.description: 你在阿古斯防卫军的盟友请求你前去他们那里。他们想酬谢你对他们长久以来的帮助。
text.completion: Greetings, $n.$B$BLong have we awaited this day. Argus was all but lost, its true denizens forced to remain hidden lest we perish. Your efforts on our behalf have allowed us to once again live free from fear. Please accept these trophies as a symbol of our gratitude.

english.title: Paragon of Argussian Reach
english.objectives: Speak with Toraan the Revered on the Vindicaar.
english.description: Your allies among the Argussian Reach have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued efforts on their behalf.
english.completion: Greetings, $n.$B$BLong have we awaited this day. Argus was all but lost, its true denizens forced to remain hidden lest we perish. Your efforts on our behalf have allowed us to once again live free from fear. Please accept these trophies as a symbol of our gratitude.

text.title: 圣光军团的典范
text.objectives: 与维迪卡尔的守备官嘉兰娜谈一谈。
text.description: 你在圣光军团的盟友想感谢你长久以来对他们的帮助。他们正在维迪卡尔上等你。
text.completion: Krona ki cristorr, champion!$B$BYour presence among the Army of the Light has been a singular boon to our cause. Gratitude is not all that we may offer. Please accept these trophies as a tribute to your unwavering support.$B$BTogether we will bring about the Legion's end.

english.title: Paragon of the Army of the Light
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Jaelaana on the Vindicaar.
english.description: Your allies in the Army of the Light would like to thank you for your continued support. They await you on the Vindicaar.
english.completion: Krona ki cristorr, champion!$B$BYour presence among the Army of the Light has been a singular boon to our cause. Gratitude is not all that we may offer. Please accept these trophies as a tribute to your unwavering support.$B$BTogether we will bring about the Legion's end.

text.title: 阿古斯防卫军的物资
text.objectives: 与维迪卡尔的可敬的托兰谈一谈。
text.description:
$ct，多亏了你的努力，我们的军队从战场上成功找到了这些资源，没让它们落入燃烧军团的手中。

只要你继续帮助我们，我们就可以提供额外的资源。
text.completion: Highlord, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.$B$BThe more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

english.title: Supplies From the Argussian Reach
english.objectives: Speak with Toraan the Revered on the Vindicaar.
english.description:
$ct, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to locate resources and prevent them from falling into the Legion's hands.

With your continued assistance, we will be able to provide additional resources.
english.completion: Highlord, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.$B$BThe more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

text.title: 圣光军团的物资
text.objectives: 与维迪卡尔的守备官嘉兰娜谈一谈，领取你的奖励。
text.description:
Archenon poros，勇士。

圣光军团希望感谢你帮忙对抗燃烧军团在阿古斯的部队。

这些物资代表着我们的谢意，请收下吧。在你的不懈努力下，我们距离终极目标铲除军团又近了一步。
text.completion: Archenon poros, champion.$B$BThe Army of the Light wishes to thank you for your aid against the Legion's forces on Argus.$B$BPlease accept these supplies with our gratitude. Your continued support brings us ever closer to our ultimate goal of eradicating the Legion once and for all.

english.title: Supplies From the Army of the Light
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Jaelaana on the Vindicaar for your reward.
english.description:
Archenon poros, champion.

The Army of the Light wishes to thank you for your aid against the Legion's forces on Argus.

Please accept these supplies with our gratitude. Your continued support brings us ever closer to our ultimate goal of eradicating the Legion once and for all.
english.completion: Archenon poros, champion.$B$BThe Army of the Light wishes to thank you for your aid against the Legion's forces on Argus.$B$BPlease accept these supplies with our gratitude. Your continued support brings us ever closer to our ultimate goal of eradicating the Legion once and for all.

objectiveDetails.description: 阻止燃烧军团的采掘行动

text.title: 指挥官登场！
text.objectives: 使用维沙克斯的传送门。
text.description: <设备开始轰鸣，你可以进入中队指挥官维沙克斯在安托兰废土的传送门了。>

english.title: Commander on Deck!
english.objectives: Use Vishax's Portal.
english.description: <The device hums to life, ready to provide you with access to Squadron Commander Vishax's portal in the Antoran Wastes.>

objectiveDetails.description: 使用维沙克斯的传送门

text.title: 燃烧王座
text.objectives: 在安托兰废土上方与大技师罗姆尔谈一谈，打开通向安托鲁斯的道路。
text.description: 时机成熟了，$n，可以开始攻打安托鲁斯了。我们多年的奋斗，以及亲友所作出的牺牲，终于让我们走到了今天。$b$b我们会用圣光裁决者轰开这座诅咒堡垒的高墙，踏平他们的权力中心。我们会成为燃烧军团的终结者。$b$b你在这场战争中居功至伟，这份荣耀应该属于你。跟罗姆尔谈一谈，让我们一起完成这份使命。
text.completion: After so many years... so many sacrifices... victory is finally within our grasp.

english.title: The Burning Throne
english.objectives: Speak with Grand Artificer Romuul while above the Antoran Wastes to open the way to Antorus.
english.description: The time has come, $n, to begin our assault upon Antorus. Everything we have fought for, everything our friends and family have sacrificed, has brought us to this moment.$b$bWe will fire Light's Judgment upon the walls of the accursed citadel and storm their seat of power. We will end the Legion.$b$bAfter all you have done, it is fitting that you have the honor. Speak to Romuul and let us finish our mission.
english.completion: После стольких лет... стольких жертв... наконец-то мы в шаге от победы.

objectiveDetails.description: 在安托兰废土上方与罗姆尔谈一谈

text.title: 泰坦陨落
text.objectives: 击败安托鲁斯，燃烧王座的阿古斯之魂。
text.description: 语言无法表达我的痛苦，我的愤怒。萨格拉斯的所作所为……$b$b阿古斯，我的家园，拥有泰坦之魂。它已经被扭曲，被腐化，完全无法救赎。它的力量被奴役，作为燃烧军团无尽大军的燃料。$b$b我们必须完成这个不可能完成的任务……突破安托鲁斯的深渊，切断燃烧军团与世界之魂的联系。$b$b求求你，$n，终结它的痛苦。消灭阿古斯的黑暗之心后，我们就可以击败燃烧军团……并为我的世界的灵魂带去救赎。

english.title: The Death of a Titan
english.objectives: Strike down the soul of Argus in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
english.description: There is no way to express the depth of my sorrow. My rage. What Sargeras has done...$b$bArgus, my home world, holds the soul of a titan. It has been twisted and corrupted beyond redemption, its power harnessed to fuel the Legion's infinite army.$b$bWe must do the impossible... breach the depths of Antorus and sever the Legion's connection to the world soul.$b$bPlease, $n. End its pain, its suffering. In striking down the dark heart of Argus, we will defeat the Legion... and redeem the soul of my world.

text.title: 黑暗通道
text.objectives: 从安托鲁斯，燃烧王座的猎魂者伊墨纳尔身上收集4枚通行符文（普通难度）。
text.description:
尽管阿古斯的核心散发着危险的能量，猎魂者却可以在燃烧王座随意走动。我们的斥候报告说他的舰船拥有恶魔符文的力量，可以抵达安全抵达邪能圣堂。

如果我们能得到这些符文，维迪卡尔就可以使用这条航线。这可以为我们的部队节省宝贵的时间。

english.title: Dark Passage
english.objectives: Collect 4 Runes of Passage from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal Difficulty.
english.description:
Despite the dangerous energies pulsing out from the heart of Argus, the Soulhunter travels unhindered through the Burning Throne. Our scouts report that his vessel harnesses the power of demonic runes to safely reach the Hallowed Felworks.

If we obtain those runes, it would allow the Vindicaar to follow the same route. This could save our forces valuable time.

If we obtain those runes, it would allow the Vindicaar to follow the same route. This could save our forces valuable time.

text.title: 反思之时
text.objectives: 带着伊利丹的水晶去找他最亲近的人和最熟悉的地方。
text.description:
<这块水晶召唤着你，它正在与巫术魔法共鸣。

当你握住它时，听到了里面留下的信息，那是伊利丹交给你的任务。>

english.title: Moments of Reflection
english.objectives: Bring Illidan's crystal to the people and places closest to him.
english.description:
<The crystal calls to you, resonating with sorcerous magic.

As you take hold of it, you hear the echo of a message left behind, a duty Illidan entrusted to you.>

objectiveDetails.description: 将伊利丹的水晶带去海加尔山

text.title: 阿古斯之心
text.objectives: 从安托鲁斯，燃烧王座的阿格拉玛身上收集4枚黑暗泰坦印记（普通难度）。
text.description:
哈顿告诉我，阿古斯陷落后，萨格拉斯就下令在星球的核心深处建造了一座黑暗神殿。我们对这座神殿知之甚少，因为只有黑暗泰坦最忠实的亲信才能获得进入那里的印记。

如果我们能得到印记，就可以把它们灌注进维迪卡尔。这样我们的部队就可以直接进攻阿古斯的腐化之心了。

english.title: The Heart of Argus
english.objectives: Collect 4 Sigils of the Dark Titan from Aggramar in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal Difficulty.
english.description:
Hatuun tells me that after Argus fell, Sargeras ordered a temple of darkness to be built deep within the planet's core. Little is known of it, for only the titan's most devoted acolytes are given sigils that permit entrance.

If we lay claim to these sigils, they could be infused into the Vindicaar. This would allow our forces to stage a direct assault upon the fetid heart of Argus.

text.title: 圣光之母的精华
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份圣光残迹。
text.description:
这是个关键时刻，$n。不能让这件事影响我们的士气。

虽然泽拉已经逝去，但我依然能感觉到，她的精华就在我们身边。她心中闪耀的圣光依然能成为我们力量的源泉，为我们的事业提供帮助。

毫无疑问，泽拉的死在图拉扬心中留下了一道伤疤。我会尽自己所能，安慰他痛苦的心。同时，请你去收集一下这位纳鲁遗留下来的残迹。
text.progress: Though Xe'ra is gone, her essence can still aid us in our struggle.
text.completion: Ah yes, I sense the Light within these fragments. Do not lose hope, $n!

english.title: Essence of the Light Mother
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Vestiges of Light.
english.description:
This is a crucial moment, $n. Our campaign must not lose momentum.

Though she has fallen, I still sense Xe'ra's presence all around us. The Light that shone within her heart can yet be a source of strength for our cause.

No doubt the loss of Xe'ra has deeply wounded Turalyon. I will do what I can to ease his troubled spirit while you gather the vestiges of the naaru that remain.
english.progress: Ze'ang is gone, but her essence can still help in our struggle.
english.completion: О да, я чувствую силу Света в этих крупицах. Не теряй надежду, $n!

text.title: 大型侵入点：深渊领主维尔姆斯

english.title: Greater Invasion Point: Pit Lord Vilemus

text.title: 虚空之光熔炉
text.objectives: 使用虚空之光熔炉给一个圣物灌注坚韧虚空之光。
text.description:
熔炉发出了能量充沛的鸣响。很快我们的武器就可以像群星一样闪亮！

如果要击败燃烧军团，我们就得获取那份力量。

$n，你承受了许多苦难才带领我们走到现在。优先吸取熔炉力量的荣耀应该属于你。
text.completion: As your weapon increases in strength we will be able to infuse it with even greater power, but its new strength should be more than enough for now.

english.title: The Netherlight Crucible
english.objectives: Imbue a relic with Netherlight Fortification using the Netherlight Crucible.
english.description:
The crucible thrums with power. Soon our weapons will shine like the stars themselves!

We will need that strength if we are to have any hope of defeating the Legion here.

$n, you have endured great hardship to bring us to this moment. The honor of first tapping the crucible's power must be yours.
english.completion: По мере того как твое оружие набирает силу, мы сможем наделить его еще большей мощью, но пока и этого более чем достаточно.

objectiveDetails.description: 给一个圣物灌注坚韧虚空之光

text.title: 突击入侵
text.objectives: 完成3个普通侵入点。
text.description: 我们不能把任何一个世界让给军团。继续攻击侵入点，将军团碾碎。
text.completion: The Legion's defeat is at hand.

english.title: Invasion Onslaught
english.objectives: Complete 3 standard Invasion Points.
english.description: We must not yield even a single world to the Legion. Continue our Invasion Point offensive and crush the Legion beneath your heel.
english.completion: Наша победа над Легионом уже близка.

text.title: 泰坦级研究
text.objectives: 将$1oa个觉醒精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
text.description:
伊利丹或许是推动了命运之手，但将阿古斯拉到距离艾泽拉斯这么近的地方，加速了暗夜井的坍塌触发的某种反应。

我认为军团在阿古斯的行动让我们从未知来源汲取多年的那种力量更加不稳定了。

显然我们还需要进一步研究。
text.progress: Illidan may believe that no price is too high to pay for banishing the Legion, but fate might prove him wrong.
text.completion: The changes this substance has undergone since the Vindicaar departed for Argus are alarming.$B$BWhat will the outcome mean for Azeroth? I fear this to be an ill omen, $n.

english.title: A Titanic Effort
english.objectives: Bring $1oa Wakening Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
english.description:
Illidan may have forced fate's hand, but bringing Argus so near to Azeroth has accelerated the reaction triggered by the Nightwell's collapse.

I believe the Legion's actions on Argus are further destabilizing the powers we've drawn upon unknowingly for many years.

It is clear that further studies are required.
english.progress: Illidan believes that there cannot be too high a price for expelling the Legion. But fate can prove him wrong.
english.completion: The changes this substance has undergone since the Vindicaar departed for Argus are alarming.$B$BWhat will the outcome mean for Azeroth? I fear this to be an ill omen, $n.

text.title: 泰坦级研究
text.objectives: 将$1oa个觉醒精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
text.description:
这种反应的剧烈程度正在与日俱增。我们虽然战胜了燃烧军团，但或许反而输掉了一些对我们极为重要的东西。

这会是某种大规模剧变的征兆吗？我们的世界到底会变成什么样，$n？

我会向我的熔炉寻求答案，我一辈子都在做这件事。而你的答案，我怀疑还在其他地方。
text.progress: If I do not soon discover the underlying cause of this disturbance, I fear we may find ourselves too far down the path to turn back.
text.completion: Take this. May it aid your efforts to stop the Legion... and to save our world.

english.title: A Titanic Effort
english.objectives: Bring $1oa Wakening Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
english.description:
The reaction's intensity is accelerating by the day. We may win the fight against the Legion only to lose something very dear to us.

Is this a portent of some greater upheaval to come? What fate awaits our world, $n?

I will seek answers at my forge, as I have done all my life. Your answers, I suspect, lie elsewhere.
english.progress: If I do not soon discover the underlying cause of this disturbance, I fear we may find ourselves too far down the path to turn back.
english.completion: Take this. May it aid your efforts to stop the Legion... and to save our world.

text.title: 诅咒碎片
text.objectives: 前往位于破碎群岛的达拉然，将诅咒碎片交给奥法工匠维迪尔。
text.description: <一块异样的金属碎片吸引了你的目光，你发现它正在变换着色彩。当你触碰到它时，碎片的一头突然膨胀，然后又熔化了。金属液滴落在地上，发出滋滋声。跟着，一股有毒的臭气侵袭了你的鼻腔。$b$b达拉然的某位金属工匠或许能告诉你它的情况。>
text.completion: The Betrayer lives up to his name once more.

english.title: The Cursed Shard
english.objectives: Bring the Cursed Shard to Arcanomancer Vridiel in Dalaran on the Broken Isles.
english.description: <A unnatural metallic shard catches your eye as it shifts from color to color. At your touch, one end of the shard swells in size before melting away. Droplets hit the ground with a hiss and a noxious stench invades your nostrils.$b$bSomeone in Dalaran who works with metals should be able to tell you more.>
english.completion: The Betrayer lives up to his name once more.
